features.name: Academie van Bouwkunst
features.opening: The Academy of Architecture of Amsterdam (Dutch: Academie van Bouwkunst Amsterdam) is a Dutch postgraduate school in architecture located in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Teachers were practicing architects who were also members of the Architectura et Amicitia association.
facts.sourceQuote: The teachers, who generally were also members of A et A, were practising architects and only students with practical experience were admitted.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The teachers, who generally were also members of A et A, were practising architects and only students with practical experience were admitted.

facts.text: Urban design education was included in the curriculum at a time when it was a relatively new discipline.
facts.sourceQuote: Thus at the conception of the academy, education in urban design was already provided. At that time this was a relatively new discipline, and the curriculum was unique at that time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thus at the conception of the academy, education in urban design was already provided. At that time this was a relatively new discipline, and the curriculum was unique at that time.

facts.text: Academie van Bouwkunst means Academy of Architecture in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: The Academy of Architecture of Amsterdam (Dutch: Academie van Bouwkunst Amsterdam) is a Dutch postgraduate school in architecture located in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Academy of Architecture of Amsterdam (Dutch: Academie van Bouwkunst Amsterdam) is a Dutch postgraduate school in architecture located in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The school serves as the architecture division for the Amsterdam University of the Arts.
facts.sourceQuote: This school is the architecture division of the Amsterdam University of the Arts, the city's vocational university of arts.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This school is the architecture division of the Amsterdam University of the Arts, the city's vocational university of arts.

features.name: Martin Luther King
features.opening: The Image of Martin Luther King is an artistic work of art in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: The final bronze monument stands 1.20 meters tall and was secured using a concrete drill.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze waren intens, want het beeld moest met behulp van een betonboor op zijn plaats vastgezet worden. Het beeld is 1,20 meter hoog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These were intense, because the image had to be fixed in place using a concrete drill. The image is 1.20 meters high.

features.name: Madame Tussauds Amsterdam
features.opening: Madame Tussauds Amsterdam is a wax museum situated in Amsterdam, the capital city of the Netherlands.

facts.text: The concept came from Josephine Tussaud, the great-great-granddaughter of founder Marie Tussaud.
facts.sourceQuote: Museum The idea to establish a wax museum in Amsterdam came from Josephine Tussaud (1900–1985), businesswoman and great-great-granddaughter of Madame Tussauds founder Marie Tussaud.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Museum The idea to establish a wax museum in Amsterdam came from Josephine Tussaud (1900–1985), businesswoman and great-great-granddaughter of Madame Tussauds founder Marie Tussaud.

facts.text: Madame Tussauds Amsterdam opened in 1970 as the first mainland European branch of the British institution.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded in 1970, it was the first Madame Tussauds that was opened in mainland Europe as well as being the first foreign branch of the British institution.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded in 1970, it was the first Madame Tussauds that was opened in mainland Europe as well as being the first foreign branch of the British institution.

features.name: Samen Spelen Samen Leven
features.opening: War memorial in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: On November 3, 1941, German occupiers seized this playground for a Jewish-only market.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 3 november 1941 vorderde de Duitse bezetter de speeltuin. Zij werd ingericht voor een Markt voor Joden; zij mochten alleen hier nog kopen en verkopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On November 3, 1941, the German occupiers occupied the playground. It was set up for a Markt for Joden; they were only allowed to buy and sell here.

facts.text: Neighbors and local groups funded the artwork after a two-year creation process.
facts.sourceQuote: De kosten van het beeld, er werd gekozen uit werk van vier kunstenaars, de maak duurde twee jaar, werden bijeengebracht door buurtbewoners, gemeente alsmede de Vereniging van Marktkooplieden/voor Ambulante handel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cost of the image, four artists' works were chosen, the creation took two years, was collected by neighbors, municipality as well as the Association of Market Sellers/for ambulatory trade.

features.name: De hongerwinter
features.opening: De hongerwinter is a war monument on the Eastern Islands in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: The original statue was created by artist Hildo Krop and originally stood on the street side.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat in twee versies: Het origineel, van de hand van Hildo Krop, is geplaatst in de Oosterkerk. Dit was eerst aan de straatzijde aangebracht, maar in de loop der jaren aangevreten door weersinvloeden en roetaanslag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It exists in two versions: The original, by Hildo Krop, is located in the Oosterkerk. This was initially applied on the street side, but over the years has been eaten away by weather influences and rust.

facts.text: Food for starving residents was secretly transported by ship from Groningen and Friesland farmers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Interkerkelijk Comité Levensmiddelenvoorziening voor De Eilanden zamelde voedsel in bij Groningse en Friese boeren, dat heimelijk per schip naar Amsterdam werd vervoerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Interchurch Committee for Food Supply for the Islands collected food from Groningse and Friese farmers, which was secretly transported by ship to Amsterdam.

features.name: AFAS Live
features.opening: AFAS Live (formerly known as the Heineken Music Hall) is a concert hall in Amsterdam, Netherlands, near the Johan Cruyff Arena.

facts.text: AFAS Live takes its name from sponsor AFAS Software BV, where the acronym stands for Applications for Administrative Solutions.
facts.sourceQuote: It is named after the venue's partner and sponsor AFAS Software BV (the acronym stands for Applications for Administrative Solutions) a business software developer in Leusden, the Netherlands with 450 employees.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is named after the venue's partner and sponsor AFAS Software BV (the acronym stands for Applications for Administrative Solutions) a business software developer in Leusden, the Netherlands with 450 employees.

facts.text: The venue's aluminum facade spells out AFAS Live using 70,000 blue caps.
facts.sourceQuote: The name AFAS Live is spelt out on the aluminum facade with 70,000 blue caps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name AFAS Live is spelt out on the aluminum facade with 70,000 blue caps.

facts.text: A smaller Beat Box room exists specifically for hosting after-parties with 700 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: The big hall, named "Black Box" has a capacity of 6,000 and is 3000 m2; a smaller hall for after parties (Beat Box) has a capacity of 700.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The big hall, named "Black Box" has a capacity of 6,000 and is 3000 m2; a smaller hall for after parties (Beat Box) has a capacity of 700.

features.name: Co-kathedrale Basiliek van Sint Nicolaas
features.opening: The Co-cathedral Basilica of Saint Nicholas (Dutch: Co-kathedrale Basiliek van de Heilige Nicolaas) is located in the Old Centre district of Amsterdam,…

facts.text: Architect Adrianus Bleijs designed it using Neo-Baroque and neo-Renaissance styles.
facts.sourceQuote: The architect Adrianus Bleijs (1842-1912) designed the church based on a combination of several revival styles: the most prominent being the Neo-Baroque and neo-Renaissance.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Adrianus Bleijs (1842-1912) designed the church based on a combination of several revival styles: the most prominent being the Neo-Baroque and neo-Renaissance.

facts.text: A relic of Saint Nicholas's rib arrived in December 2021 after staying at Egmond Abbey since 1087.
facts.sourceQuote: In December 2021, the basilica received a relic of St. Nicholas from Egmond Abbey. Said to be a fragment of the saint's rib, the bone had been in the custody of the abbey since 1087.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In December 2021, the basilica received a relic of St. Nicholas from Egmond Abbey. Said to be a fragment of the saint's rib, the bone had been in the custody of the abbey since 1087.

facts.text: Saint Nicholas serves as the patron saint for both this church and the entire city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Saint Nicholas is the patron saint of both the church and the city of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Saint Nicholas is the patron saint of both the church and the city of Amsterdam.

features.name: Multatuli Museum
features.opening: The Multatuli Museum (also Multatuli House/Huis) is a 17th-century museum in the Jordaan neighbourhood of Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Eduard Douwes Dekker, known by the pen name Multatuli, was born in this house.
facts.sourceQuote: Eduard Douwes Dekker was born in the Multatuli House and he died 67 years later in Ingelheim am Rhein, Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Eduard Douwes Dekker was born in the Multatuli House and he died 67 years later in Ingelheim am Rhein, Germany.

facts.text: A separate, unaffiliated Multatuli Museum opened in Rangkasbitung, Indonesia in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2018, another (unaffiliated) Multatuli Museum has also opened in Rangkasbitung, Indonesia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2018, another (unaffiliated) Multatuli Museum has also opened in Rangkasbitung, Indonesia.

facts.text: Multatuli died on a distinctive red couch that remains in the house today.
facts.sourceQuote: These items include his globe, his desk, his library and the red couch on which he died.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These items include his globe, his desk, his library and the red couch on which he died.

facts.text: Over five thousand of his manuscripts are preserved separately at the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Elsewhere, more than 5000 of Multatuli's manuscripts are preserved in the Special Collections at the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Elsewhere, more than 5000 of Multatuli's manuscripts are preserved in the Special Collections at the University of Amsterdam.

features.name: Ravensbrück memorial
features.opening: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on the Museumplein in Amsterdam commemorating the Dutch victims of Ravensbrück, the Nazi concentration camp for…

facts.text: The monument honors Dutch women who perished in the Nazi camp Ravensbrück.
facts.sourceQuote: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is een monument op het Museumplein in Amsterdam ter nagedachtenis van de Nederlandse slachtoffers van het voor vrouwen opgezette nazi-concentratiekamp Ravensbrück in Duitsland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Vrouwen van Ravensbrück 1940-1945 is a monument on Museumplein in Amsterdam in memory of the Dutch victims of the Nazi concentration camp Ravensbrück set up for women in Germany.

facts.text: The initiative for this war monument was taken in 1972 by the Vrouwen Committee of Ravenbrück.
facts.sourceQuote: Het initiatief voor dit oorlogsmonument werd genomen in 1972, toen het Comité Vrouwen van Ravenbrück een opdracht naar kunstenaars zond voor een ontwerp van een artistiek kunstwerk ter herinnering aan Nederlandse slachtoffers van concentratiekamp Ravensbrück.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The initiative for this war monument was taken in 1972, when the Vrouwen Committee of Ravenbrück sent an order to artists for a design of an artistic work in memory of Dutch victims of the Ravensbrück concentration camp.

facts.text: Eleven stainless steel panels arranged in a semicircle reflect light and sound from a central pillar.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit licht en geluid wordt opgevangen en weerkaatst door elf steeds groter wordende roestvast stalen panelen in een halve cirkel gezet rondom de ronde zuil van hetzelfde materiaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This light and sound is captured and reflected by eleven increasingly larger stainless steel panels arranged in a semicircle around the round pillar of the same material.

facts.text: Light flashes symbolizing searchlights are separated by moments of silence between signals.
facts.sourceQuote: De lichtflitsen doen denken aan de zoeklichten rond het kamp. Tussen deze signalen bevindt zich een moment van stilte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The light flashes remind me of the searchlights around the camp. Between these signals is a moment of silence.

features.name: Spanjemonument
features.opening: The Spanjemonument is an artistic work and war memorial in Amsterdam-Noord.

facts.text: The ground features concentric circles in red, yellow, and purple representing the International Brigades flag.
facts.sourceQuote: De eeuwige beweging van het beeld vond haar weerspiegeling in de ondergrond met concentrische cirkels rondom het beeld, ontworpen door Harm van Weerden. Die cirkels waren origineel in de kleuren rood, geel en paars (de kleuren van de vlag van de Internationale Brigades).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The eternal movement of the image found its reflection in the ground with concentric circles around the image, designed by Harm van Weerden. Those circles were original in the colors red, yellow and purple (the colors of the flag of the International Brigades).

facts.text: Inscriptions in Dutch and Spanish commemorate those who fought in the Spanish Civil War from 1936 to 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

facts.text: Three columns display the slogan No Pasaran alongside messages of vigilance against fascism for modern people.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

features.name: Meervaart Theater
features.opening: Meervaart is a theater and a convention center in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: A children's film festival called Cinekid began holding events here in 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1986 begon hier het kinderfilmfestival Cinekid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1986, the children's film festival Cinekid began here.

features.name: Portugese Synagoge
features.opening: The Portuguese Synagogue, also known as the Esnoga, or Snoge, is an Orthodox Jewish congregation and synagogue, located at Mr. Visserplein 3 in Central…

facts.text: Many Jewish-origin New Christians secretly practiced Judaism as marranos while publicly professing Catholicism.
facts.sourceQuote: Many in fact did continue to practice Judaism behind closed doors while publicly professing to be Catholics; in Spanish and Portuguese these were called marranos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many in fact did continue to practice Judaism behind closed doors while publicly professing to be Catholics; in Spanish and Portuguese these were called marranos.

facts.text: Leo Palache and volunteers convinced Nazis to spare the site from becoming a deportation center.
facts.sourceQuote: During the Nazi campaign to systematically murder Jews in the Holocaust, the facility was slated to become a deportation center for Jews, but Leo Palache and a team of volunteers managed to dissuade the Nazis from this plan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Nazi campaign to systematically murder Jews in the Holocaust, the facility was slated to become a deportation center for Jews, but Leo Palache and a team of volunteers managed to dissuade the Nazis from this plan.

facts.text: The sanctuary ceiling and attic floor hid Jewish ritual items for deported Jews during the war.
facts.sourceQuote: Instead, the building concealed Jewish ritual items for deported Jews in the sanctuary ceiling and attic floor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instead, the building concealed Jewish ritual items for deported Jews in the sanctuary ceiling and attic floor.

facts.text: Executive director Salomon Coutinho kept a diary detailing the synagogue's protective efforts.
facts.sourceQuote: The World War II diary of executive director Salomon Coutinho was discovered in Amsterdam and details the synagogue's works and efforts to protect the building during the war.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The World War II diary of executive director Salomon Coutinho was discovered in Amsterdam and details the synagogue's works and efforts to protect the building during the war.

features.name: National Holocaust Museum
features.opening: The Dutch National Holocaust Museum (Dutch: Nationaal Holocaust museum) is the first official museum on the Holocaust in the Netherlands.

facts.text: During the Nazi occupation, 102,000 Dutch Jews were killed, representing three-quarters of the country's Jewish population.
facts.section: History of the Jews in Amsterdam
facts.sourceQuote: Three-quarters of the country's Jews, the highest percentage in Western Europe, in total 102,000 people, were killed during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands during 1940–1945.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three-quarters of the country's Jews, the highest percentage in Western Europe, in total 102,000 people, were killed during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands during 1940–1945.

facts.text: Scholars cite the high death rate partly to the cooperation of Dutch authorities and the local Jewish Council in Amsterdam.
facts.section: History of the Jews in Amsterdam
facts.sourceQuote: Scholars see the concentration of the Jewish population in one place, the single-mindedness of Nazi policies to separate Jews from the general Dutch population and then to eliminate them, the cooperation of Dutch authorities, as well as the Jewish Council in Amsterdam as factors resulting in the high percentage of Jewish deaths.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scholars see the concentration of the Jewish population in one place, the single-mindedness of Nazi policies to separate Jews from the general Dutch population and then to eliminate them, the cooperation of Dutch authorities, as well as the Jewish Council in Amsterdam as factors resulting in the high percentage of Jewish deaths.

facts.text: Postwar society initially seemed uninterested in Jewish suffering, yet the museum now invites visitors to immerse themselves in that history.
facts.section: History of the Jews in Amsterdam
facts.sourceQuote: The postwar Dutch population was seemingly not interested in the suffering of its Jewish population under the Nazis, but the museum now invites visitors to "Immerse yourself in the history of the persecution of the Jews."
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The postwar Dutch population was seemingly not interested in the suffering of its Jewish population under the Nazis, but the museum now invites visitors to "Immerse yourself in the history of the persecution of the Jews."

facts.text: Stories focus on individual men, women, and children rather than abstract statistics or dates.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum tells the story of the Holocaust through the lives of individual victimised men, women, and children.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum tells the story of the Holocaust through the lives of individual victimised men, women, and children.

features.name: Amstel Academie
features.opening: The Amstel Academie is a Dutch academy that specializes in training in the medical sector.

facts.text: The institution began in 1961 as a nursing school to train nurses for the VU Hospital.
facts.sourceQuote: De Amstel Academie is in 1961 opgericht als zogenaamde verpleegstersschool, later ook wel de School voor Verpleegkundigen genoemd. Het doel bij de oprichting was destijds dat het toenmalig Ziekenhuis der Vrije Universiteit haar eigen verpleegkundigen zou opleiden, die een diploma zouden ontvangen met een landelijke erkenning en registratie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amstel Academie was founded in 1961 as a so-called nursing school, later also called the School for Nurses. The goal at the time of its establishment was that the then Ziekenhuis der Vrije Universiteit would train its own nurses, who would receive a diploma with national recognition and registration.

facts.text: In 2005, the academy relocated from Uilenstede to the OZW building on De Boelelaan.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2005 verhuisde de Amstel Academie van Uilenstede naar het OZW-gebouw aan de De Boelelaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2005, the Amstel Academie moved from Uilenstede to the OZW building on De Boelelaan.

facts.text: The academy operates as part of a larger Institute for Education and Training alongside two other VUmc schools.
facts.sourceQuote: De Amstel Academie vormt samen met VUmc School of Medical Sciences en de VUmc Academie het Instituut voor Onderwijs en Opleiden (IOO).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amstel Academie together with VUmc School of Medical Sciences and the VUmc Academy forms the Institute for Education and Training (IOO).

features.name: Nationaal monument Slavernijverleden
features.opening: The Nationaal Monument Slavernijverleden is a monument in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam to commemorate the abolition of slavery in the Dutch Kingdom.

facts.text: The sculpture is cast in bronze while its foundation consists of concrete.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld is van brons en de sokkel is van beton.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image is made of bronze and the base is made of concrete.

facts.text: Abstract images were rejected because they would create too much distance for descendants recognizing their past.
facts.sourceQuote: Abstracte beelden zouden de afstand te groot maken, was de mening.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Abstract images would make the distance too great, was the opinion.

features.name: waterdraagster
features.opening: Sculpture in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: The central bronze figure was stolen in 1977 and replaced with a new cast in 1981.
facts.sourceQuote: Het centrale beeld werd in 1977 ontvreemd. Aan de hand van een gelijk beeld in Arnhem werd onder initiatief van medekunstenaar Harry Visser (Beroepsvereniging van Beeldende Kunstenaars) een nieuw afgietsel gemaakt en in 1981 geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The central image was stolen in 1977. Based on a similar image in Arnhem, a new cast was made and placed in 1981 at the initiative of fellow artist Harry Visser (Professional Association of Visual Artists).

facts.text: Although called the largest image, the central bronze woman is only 84 cm high.
facts.sourceQuote: Het grootste beeld (eigenlijk beeldje, 84 cm hoog)) bestaat uit een bronzen vrouw in lang gewaad die een waterkruik draagt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The largest image (actually a small image, 84 cm high)) consists of a bronze woman in a long robe carrying a water jug.

features.name: Willem de Zwijgerkerk
features.opening: The Willem de Zwijgerkerk is a Protestant church on Olympiaweg in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Stained glass windows by Kees Kuiler depict Christmas, Easter, and Pentecost.
facts.sourceQuote: De glas-in-loodramen in de kerk, ontworpen door Kees Kuiler, verbeelden de kerkelijke feesten Kerstmis, Pasen en Pinksteren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stained glass windows in the church, designed by Kees Kuiler, depict the church festivals Christmas, Easter and Pentecost.

facts.text: Gerrit van Leeuwen built the organ, which was restored in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel is gebouwd door Gerrit van Leeuwen en in 2008 gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ was built by Gerrit van Leeuwen and restored in 2008.

features.name: Van Gendt Hallen
features.opening: The Hallen van Stork, Van Gendthallen or Werkspoorhallen are five interconnected halls of the former Werkspoor-Stork factory in Oostenburg in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Halls four and five partially burned down in 1922 before being restored to their original design.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1922 brandden hal 4 en 5 gedeeltelijk af. Ze werden direct naar oorspronkelijk ontwerp hersteld, onder leiding van G.J.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1922, halls 4 and 5 partially burned down. They were restored directly to original design, under the leadership of G.J.

facts.text: Large light covers span the entire length of each hall.
facts.sourceQuote: De hallen hebben grote lichtkappen over de gehele lengte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The halls have large light covers throughout the entire length.

features.name: Tranen
features.opening: Tranen for the Resistance or Two Tears is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the center of Amsterdam.

facts.text: A resistance group led by Gerrit van der Veen robbed the detention center on May 1, 1944 to free prisoners.
facts.sourceQuote: Een verzetsgroep onder leiding van Gerrit van der Veen pleegde op 1 mei 1944 een overval op het Huis van Bewaring in een poging gevangengenomen verzetsleden te bevrijden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A resistance group led by Gerrit van der Veen carried out a robbery of the Detention Center on May 1, 1944 in an attempt to free captured resistance members.

facts.text: Mayor Ed van Thijn unveiled the work in 1993 alongside widows of resistance members Dirk Walda and Gerrit van der Veen.
facts.sourceQuote: Tranen voor het verzet werd op 25 februari 1993 onthuld door burgemeester Ed van Thijn in aanwezigheid van de weduwen van Dirk Walda (lid van het comité Februaristaking bij de Ford-fabrieken) en Gerrit van der Veen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Tranen voor het verzet was unveiled on February 25, 1993 by Mayor Ed van Thijn in the presence of the widows of Dirk Walda (member of the February Strike Committee at the Ford factories) and Gerrit van der Veen.

facts.text: In 1944, two robberies occurred here in attempts to free political prisoners.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor velen was dit het eerste station op de weg naarconcentratiekampen, Duitse gevangenissen en plaatsen waar zij,die zich tegen bezetter te weer stelden, ter dood werden gebracht.In 1944 zijn twee overvallen op dit gebouw gepleegd in eenpoging hen te bevrijden. De eerste overval stond onder leiding vanGerrit Jan van der Veen. De tweede werd geleid door Johannes Post.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For many, this was the first station on the way to concentration camps, German prisons and places where those who resisted the occupiers were executed. In 1944, two robberies were committed against this building in an attempt to free them. The first robbery was led by Gerrit Jan van der Veen. The second was led by Johannes Post.

facts.text: Gerrit Jan van der Veen led the first robbery attempt against this building.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste overval stond onder leiding vanGerrit Jan van der Veen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first robbery was led by Gerrit Jan van der Veen.

features.name: Gerrit Rietveld Academie
features.opening: The Gerrit Rietveld Academie, also known as Rietveld School of Art & Design and Rietveld Academy, is an art academy in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: The school was renamed in 1968 to honor architect Gerrit Rietveld after his building opened.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1968, following the completion of the Rietveld Building, the school was renamed to Gerrit Rietveld Academie, in honor of Gerrit Rietveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1968, following the completion of the Rietveld Building, the school was renamed to Gerrit Rietveld Academie, in honor of Gerrit Rietveld.

facts.text: Director Mart Stam infused the curriculum with De Stijl and Bauhaus ideas between 1939 and 1960.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1939 to 1960, the education provided was influenced by the functionalist and socially critical ideas of De Stijl and the Bauhaus, partly due to the role of the socialist architect Mart Stam as Director of Education.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1939 to 1960, the education provided was influenced by the functionalist and socially critical ideas of De Stijl and the Bauhaus, partly due to the role of the socialist architect Mart Stam as Director of Education.

facts.text: A new campus designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects was completed in 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2003, the Benthem Crouwel Building, designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects, was completed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2003, the Benthem Crouwel Building, designed by Benthem Crouwel Architects, was completed.

facts.text: The institution was established in the year 1924.
facts.sourceQuote: It was founded in 1924 and offers programs in fine arts and design.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded in 1924 and offers programs in fine arts and design.

facts.text: Gerrit Rietveld Academie is also known as the Rietveld School of Art & Design.
facts.sourceQuote: The Gerrit Rietveld Academie, also known as Rietveld School of Art & Design and Rietveld Academy, is an art academy in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Gerrit Rietveld Academie, also known as Rietveld School of Art & Design and Rietveld Academy, is an art academy in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

features.name: Micropia
features.opening: Micropia is a museum in Amsterdam based on the idea of distributing information about microbes, which are often associated with illness and disease despite…

facts.text: A Kiss-O-Meter exhibit measures the number of microbes shared during a kiss.
facts.sourceQuote: The Kiss-O-Meter, for example, measures how many microbes are shared between two people as they kiss.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Kiss-O-Meter, for example, measures how many microbes are shared between two people as they kiss.

features.name: Laurenskerk
features.opening: The Grote or Laurenskerk is a church building on Kerkstraat/Nieuwstraat in the center of the North Holland town of Weesp.

facts.text: Construction of the late Gothic structure took place between 1429 and 1462.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd tussen 1429 en 1462 als laatgotische kruiskerk gebouwd, op de plek waar eerder een romaanse kerk had gestaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built between 1429 and 1462 as a late Gothic cruciform church, on the site where a Romanesque church had previously stood.

facts.text: A professional choir with paid singers was attached to the church starting in 1489.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1489 was aan de kerk een zeven-getijdencollege verbonden met betaalde en professionele zangers. .
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1489, a seven-season college was attached to the church with paid and professional singers. .

facts.text: The tower houses a carillon cast in 1671 by the famous bellfounder Pieter Hemony.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven in de romaanse toren, een restant van de eerdere kerk, bevindt zich een carillon, dat in 1671 werd gegoten door de beroemde klokkengieter Pieter Hemony uit Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the top of the Romanesque tower, a remnant of the earlier church, there is a carillon, which was cast in 1671 by the famous bellfounder Pieter Hemony from Amsterdam.

features.name: Mint Tower
features.opening: The Munttoren (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʏnˌtoːrə(n)]; "Mint Tower") or Munt ([mʏnt]) is a tower in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Cinema organists played weekly on its bells after a 1961 renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Just after the renovation around 1961, cinema organist played weekly on the Munt bells and even made a recording of the bells together with the City Theater orchestra directed by Lex van Weren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Just after the renovation around 1961, cinema organist played weekly on the Munt bells and even made a recording of the bells together with the City Theater orchestra directed by Lex van Weren.

facts.text: Scale models of the tower are displayed at Madurodam and Mini-Europe.
facts.sourceQuote: Scale models of the tower are exhibited at Madurodam in The Hague and at Mini-Europe in Brussels.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scale models of the tower are exhibited at Madurodam in The Hague and at Mini-Europe in Brussels.

facts.text: The Mint Tower earned its name because its guard house temporarily minted coins during the war year of 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: The name of the tower refers to the fact that the guard house on the side of it was used to mint coins in the 17th century. In the Rampjaar ("year of disaster") of 1672, when both England and France declared war on the Dutch Republic and French troops occupied much of the country, silver and gold could no longer be safely transported to Dordrecht and Enkhuizen (where coins were normally minted), so the guard house of the Munttoren was temporarily used to mint coin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the tower refers to the fact that the guard house on the side of it was used to mint coins in the 17th century. In the Rampjaar ("year of disaster") of 1672, when both England and France declared war on the Dutch Republic and French troops occupied much of the country, silver and gold could no longer be safely transported to Dordrecht and Enkhuizen (where coins were normally minted), so the guard house of the Munttoren was temporarily used to mint coin.

facts.text: Only the western tower survived the 1618 fire that destroyed the original gate structure.
facts.sourceQuote: After the gate went up in flames in a 1618 fire, only the guard house and part of the western tower remained standing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the gate went up in flames in a 1618 fire, only the guard house and part of the western tower remained standing.

features.name: Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten
features.opening: The Amsterdam University of the Arts (Dutch: Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten) is a Dutch institute for higher professional education located in…

facts.text: Notable alumni include Dutch opera director Lotte de Beer and actress Carice van Houten.
facts.sourceQuote: The following is a list of notable former students: Lotte de Beer – Dutch opera director Linda-Maria Birbeck – Swedish photographer Bojan Đorđev – Serbian theater director Anne Hartkamp – German singer Jens Hoffmann – Costa Rican writer and educator Florentina Holzinger – Austrian choreographer, director and performance artist Chantal Janzen – Dutch actress, singer and presenter Simone Kleinsma – actress Piet Zwart (1885–1977) – graphic designer, industrial designer and typographer Carice van Houten – actress Jeroen van Koningsbrugge – actor, comedian, presenter Mohammed Azaay – actor Tjitske Reidinga – actress, comedian Elise Schaap – actress

facts.text: Graphic designer Piet Zwart, who lived from 1885 to 1977, is a distinguished former student.

facts.text: Amsterdamse Hogeschool voor de Kunsten includes the Breitner Academy, named after painter George Hendrik Breitner.
facts.sourceQuote: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies

facts.text: The institution houses the Netherlands Film Academy, a dedicated school for film education.
facts.sourceQuote: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university consists of: Academy of Architecture Academy of Theatre and Dance Breitner Academy – education in arts Conservatorium van Amsterdam – music academy Netherlands Film Academy Reinwardt Academy – museology studies

features.name: Equestrian statue of Queen Wilhelmina
features.opening: The equestrian statue of Queen Wilhelmina in Amsterdam is located on Rokin street, at the corner with Langebrugsteeg alley.

facts.text: Sculptor Theresia van der Pant specialized in animals, influencing her choice to depict the queen riding a horse.
facts.sourceQuote: Also, Van der Pant was most experienced sculpting animals. She therefore decided on a statue of the younger queen, riding horseback.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Also, Van der Pant was most experienced sculpting animals. She therefore decided on a statue of the younger queen, riding horseback.

features.name: Pancratiuskerk
features.opening: The Sint-Pancratiuskerk is a Roman Catholic church in the village of Sloten.

facts.text: After being rebuilt as Protestant, Roman Catholics were expelled and used farmer's barns for decades.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk te Sloten werd in de 17e eeuw als protestantse kerk herbouwd, dit werd de Sloterkerk. De rooms-katholieken waren verdreven uit de kerk van Sloten en moesten enige decennia lang gebruikmaken van boerenschuren die als schuilkerk dienstdeden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church in Sloten was rebuilt in the 17th century as a Protestant church, this became the Sloterkerk. The Roman Catholics were expelled from the church of Sloten and had to use farmer's barns as a church of refuge for several decades.

facts.text: A local football club named Pancratius once played on a field opposite the church before relocating.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is daardoor ook nog steeds een voetbalclub Pancratius, die vroeger op een veld speelde tegenover de Slotense Pancratiuskerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result, there is still a football club Pancratius, which used to play on a field opposite the Slotense Pancratiuskerk.

facts.text: Catholics in Badhoevedorp established their own parish in 1937 with a dedicated church building.
facts.sourceQuote: De katholieken in Badhoevedorp hebben sinds 1937 een eigen parochie (H.H. Engelbewaarderskerk) met een kerkgebouw aan de Pa Verkuyllaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Catholics in Badhoevedorp have had their own parish since 1937 (H.H. Angel Guardians Church) with a church building on the Pa Verkuyllaan.

features.name: West India House
features.opening: The West-Indisch Huis ("West India House") is the former headquarters of the Dutch West India Company in Amsterdam.

facts.text: A bronze statue of Peter Stuyvesant, governor of New Netherland, stands in the courtyard fountain.
facts.sourceQuote: In the courtyard, a fountain was placed with a bronze statue of Peter Stuyvesant, governor of New Netherland, the Dutch colony on the east coast of what is now the United States.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the courtyard, a fountain was placed with a bronze statue of Peter Stuyvesant, governor of New Netherland, the Dutch colony on the east coast of what is now the United States.

facts.text: The John Adams Institute resides here to promote cultural exchange between the Netherlands and the U.S.
facts.sourceQuote: The John Adams Institute, which aims to further cultural exchange between The Netherlands and the U.S., is housed in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The John Adams Institute, which aims to further cultural exchange between The Netherlands and the U.S., is housed in the building.

features.name: Banpaal
features.opening: The Banpaal Spaarnwouderdijk is a banpole from 1624, which has stood since then on the Spaarndammerdijk outside Amsterdam.

facts.text: Rembrandt sketched the pole but removed its head in his final etching.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij schetste de gehele paal, maar onthoofdde hem op de definitieve ets Landschap met een obelisk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He sketched the entire pole, but beheaded it in the final etching Landscape with an obelisk.

features.name: Rialto
features.opening: Rialto is a cinema at Ceintuurbaan in the De Pijp neighborhood in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée commissioned the building's creation in 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: The building that Rialto occupies was built in 1920 and was designed by the architect Jan van Schaik commissioned by film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building that Rialto occupies was built in 1920 and was designed by the architect Jan van Schaik commissioned by film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée.

facts.text: Architect Jan van Schaik designed the structure that now houses this cinema.
facts.sourceQuote: The building that Rialto occupies was built in 1920 and was designed by the architect Jan van Schaik commissioned by film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building that Rialto occupies was built in 1920 and was designed by the architect Jan van Schaik commissioned by film enthusiast Anton Pieter du Mée.

facts.text: The Stichting Amsterdams Filmhuis has operated the theatre since 1982.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 1982, the theatre has been in use by the Stichting Amsterdams Filmhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1982, the theatre has been in use by the Stichting Amsterdams Filmhuis.

features.name: Sint-Gertrudiskerk
features.opening: The Sint-Gertrudiskerk is a former Roman Catholic church building in the village of Ruigoord in the municipality of Amsterdam in the Dutch province of North…

facts.text: Inside stands a statue of Gertrudis holding a staff with mice.
facts.sourceQuote: In de kerk staat een beeld van Gertrudis met een staf met muizen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the church there is a statue of Gertrudis with a staff with mice.

features.name: Royal Tropical Institute
features.opening: The KIT building is a complex of buildings in Amsterdam-Oost, built from 1915 to 1926 for the accommodation of the Colonial Institute and museum.

facts.text: Architect Johannes van Nieukerken died before completion, leaving the project to his sons Johan and Marie Adrianus.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect Johannes van Nieukerken heeft het gebouw ontworpen. Na zijn dood in 1913 werd het vervolgens voltooid door zijn zoons Johan en Marie Adrianus van Nieukerken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Johannes van Nieukerken designed the building. After his death in 1913, it was then completed by his sons Johan and Marie Adrianus van Nieukerken.

facts.text: The complex was financed by contributions from Shell, the Amsterdam Chamber of Commerce, and the Department of Colonies.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd gefinancierd door bijdragen van onder meer de Bataafse Petroleum Maatschappij (Shell), de Overzeese Gas- en Elektriciteitsmaatschappij N.V., de Handelsvereniging Amsterdam (HVA), en het departement van Koloniën.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was financed by contributions from among others the Bataafse Petroleum Maatschappij (Shell), the Overseas Gas and Electricity Company N.V., the Amsterdam Chamber of Commerce (HVA), and the Department of Colonies.

facts.text: A rare marble entrance hall provides access to auditoriums and a library.
facts.sourceQuote: Het instituutsgebouw heeft een grote entreehal van zeldzaam marmer vanwaar toegangen zijn naar een grote en een kleine aula en verschillende cursusruimten, bestuurskamers en bibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The institute building has a large entrance hall of rare marble from which access is provided to a large and a small auditorium and several course rooms, boardrooms and library.

facts.text: The institute building connects to the museum via a quarter-circle structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Het instituutsgebouw is verbonden aan het museumgebouw door een kwartrond gebouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The institute building is connected to the museum building by a quarter-circle building.

features.name: Hofkerk
features.opening: The Parish Church of the Holy Martyrs of Gorkum is a Roman Catholic church in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer.

facts.text: Architect Kropholler designed the church, showing clear influence from Berlage.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat Kropholler sterk beïnvloed is door de architect Berlage komt ook sterk tot uiting in de kerk; er zijn duidelijke verwijzingen naar de Beurs van Berlage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fact that Kropholler has been strongly influenced by the architect Berlage is also strongly reflected in the church; there are clear references to the Berlage Building.

facts.text: The massive structure uses large red bricks and red tiled roofs with a closed front facade.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk, opgebouwd uit grote rode bakstenen (waalformaat) en afgedekt met rode pannendaken, is een massief ogend gebouw. De voorzijde is, op de drieledige ingangsportiek en de dubbele boog in de toren na, geheel gesloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church, built from large red bricks (walley size) and covered with red tiled roofs, is a massive looking building. The front is completely closed, except for the three-part entrance portico and the double arch in the tower.

facts.text: Architect Alexander Kropholler designed the entire Linnaeushof complex that houses this church.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij maakt als "Hofkerk" deel uit van het door architect Alexander Kropholler ontworpen complex van de Linnaeushof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As "Hofkerk", it is part of the complex of the Linnaeushof designed by architect Alexander Kropholler.

features.name: Afrikahuis
features.opening: The Afrikahuis is the former church of the Roman Catholic Sint Willibrordus parish in the De Pijp district of Amsterdam.

facts.text: The new church replaced a demolished predecessor and held only 900 seats instead of the original 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk was bedoeld als vervanging voor Sint-Willibrorduskerk buiten de Veste die gesloopt werd. Omdat het aantal kerkgangers was afgenomen kwamen er in het nieuwe gebouw 900 in plaats van de eerdere 2000 zitplaatsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was intended as a replacement for the St. Willibrordus Church outside the Veste that was demolished. Because the number of churchgoers had decreased, 900 seats were installed in the new building instead of the previous 2000 seats.

facts.text: French limestone facades sit atop a concrete base while the roof floats freely above them.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de betonnen plint die soms als 'tafel' is vormgegeven, staan gevels van Frans kalksteen. Het dak zweeft vrij boven de gevels, waardoor licht kan invallen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the concrete base that is sometimes designed as a 'table', there are facades of French limestone. The roof floats freely above the facades, allowing light to enter.

facts.text: Glass building block strips were originally set into the concrete base before being sealed with steel grilles.
facts.sourceQuote: In de betonnen plint waren stroken van glazen bouwstenen opgenomen, deze zijn later dichtgezet met stalen roosters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Strips of glass building blocks were incorporated into the concrete base, these were later sealed with steel grilles.

features.name: Huis Bartolotti
features.opening: Het Huis Bartolotti (also Het Bonte Huis) is a canal house at Herengracht 170-172 in Amsterdam.

facts.text: A major restoration between 1968 and 1971 rebuilt the simplified upper facade.
facts.sourceQuote: In de periode 1968-1971 vond een spectaculaire restauratie plaats. Het bovenste deel van de topgevel, op lelijke wijze versoberd in het begin van de 19e eeuw, is gereconstrueerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A spectacular restoration took place in the period 1968-1971. The upper part of the main facade, ugly simplified at the beginning of the 19th century, has been reconstructed.

facts.text: Willem van den Heuvel built this house after receiving a large inheritance in 1617.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is circa 1617 gebouwd voor Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, een van de rijkste Amsterdammers in die tijd, die veel geld had geërfd van een kinderloze aangetrouwde oom, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, koopman uit Bologna.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built around 1617 for Willem van den Heuvel tot Beichlingen, one of the richest Amsterdamers of that time, who had inherited a lot of money from a childless brother-in-law, Giovanni Battista Bartolotti, a merchant from Bologna.

facts.text: A daughter named Jacoba Victoria was born here in 1639.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1639 werd Jacoba Victoria, dochter van Guillelmo (1602-1658), in het huis geboren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1639, Jacoba Victoria, daughter of Guillelmo (1602-1658), was born in the house.

features.name: Compagnietheater
features.opening: The Compagnietheater is housed in the former church of the Reformed Lutheran church on the Kloveniersburgwal in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The organ moved to Arnhem in 1961 after the Battle of Arnhem destroyed that city's instrument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel (1794-1796) van orgelbouwer Johannes Stephanus Strümphler, beschouwd als diens belangrijkste instrument en van 1898 tot 1937 het vaste orgel van Jan Zwart, werd in 1961 verplaatst naar de weer opgebouwde Eusebiuskerk in Arnhem, die na de verwoestingen van de Slag om Arnhem geen orgel meer had.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ (1794-1796) by organ builder Johannes Stephanus Strümphler, considered his most important instrument and from 1898 to 1937 the permanent organ of Jan Zwart, was moved in 1961 to the rebuilt Eusebius Church in Arnhem, which had no organ after the destruction of the Battle of Arnhem.

facts.text: Amsterdam carpenter Jan Smit was entrusted with executing the construction work.
facts.sourceQuote: De uitvoering berustte bij de Amsterdamse timmerbaas Jan Smit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The execution was entrusted to the Amsterdam carpenter Jan Smit.

facts.text: A motto about apostolic doctrine once stood under the pediment before vanishing when the church closed.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder het fronton stond geschreven; Zij bleven volstandig in de leere der Apostelen. Deze spreuk is van het pand verdwenen, toen het zijn kerkelijke functie verloor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the pediment it was written; They remained completely in the doctrine of the apostles. This saying disappeared from the building when it lost its ecclesiastical function.

facts.text: Francine Houben of Mecanoo converted the building into a theater between 1995 and 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1995-1996 is het pand door Francine Houben van architectenbureau Mecanoo verbouwd tot theater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1995-1996, the building was converted into a theater by Francine Houben of architectural firm Mecanoo.

facts.text: A 2014 renovation restored the facade, sculptural group, and roof while adding a kitchen.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer van 2014 is het Compagnietheater gerenoveerd. De buitengevel is opnieuw gevoegd, de beeldengroep is gerestaureerd en het dak is gerenoveerd. Bovendien is de entree vernieuwd en er zijn extra faciliteiten gekomen (van daglichtsysteem in de Grote Zaal tot een keuken op de begane grond).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer of 2014, the Compagnietheater was renovated. The facade has been re-joined, the sculptural group has been restored and the roof has been renovated. In addition, the entrance has been renovated and additional facilities have been added (from daylight system in the Great Hall to a kitchen on the ground floor).

features.name: Oude Lutherse Kerk
features.opening: The Oude Lutherse Kerk at Singel 411, corner Spui, in Amsterdam is a Lutheran church, built on the site where the Lutheran congregation hall used to stand.

facts.text: Doric columns support the roof while Ionic and Tuscan columns hold up the surrounding galleries.
facts.sourceQuote: Het inwendige is rechthoekig van vorm, omgeven door galerijen die rusten op Ionische en Toscaanse zuilen. Dorische zuilen dragen de dakconstructie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The interior is rectangular in shape, surrounded by galleries resting on Ionic and Tuscan columns. Doric columns support the roof structure.

facts.text: Architects Wessel Becker and Willem van Daelen directed its construction between 1632 and 1633.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is in de periode 1632-1633 onder leiding van Wessel Becker en Willem van Daelen gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built between 1632 and 1633 under the direction of Wessel Becker and Willem van Daelen.

features.name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
features.opening: The Vondelpark Open-Air Theater in Amsterdam has been organizing concerts and performances by amateurs and professional performers in the field of cabaret,…

facts.text: Attendees pay no entry fee, though a voluntary donation is requested for the free summer shows.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorstellingen zijn gratis toegankelijk, wel wordt een vrije gift gevraagd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The performances are free to attend, but a voluntary donation is requested.

facts.text: The theater has hosted amateur and professional performances every summer since 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Vondelpark Openluchttheater in Amsterdam organiseert sinds 1974 iedere zomer concerten en optredens door amateurs en professionele uitvoerenden op het gebied van cabaret, dans, kindervoorstellingen en muziek in het hart van het Vondelpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1974, the Vondelpark Openluchttheater in Amsterdam has been organizing concerts and performances by amateurs and professional performers in the field of cabaret, dance, children's shows and music in the heart of the Vondelpark every summer.

features.name: De Vriendschap
features.opening: De Vriendschap is a windmill built in 1900 on the site of a mill that burned down in 1899.

facts.text: The mill was renamed De Vriendschap in 1817 after a swap with another Weesp mill.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1813 veranderde de naam in Het Anker en in 1817, als gevolg van een molenruil in Weesp, in De Vriendschap.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1813 the name was changed to Het Anker and in 1817, as a result of a mill exchange in Weesp, to De Vriendschap.

facts.text: A lightning strike destroyed the original structure on September 23, 1899.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 23 september 1899 brandt de oude molen af als gevolg van blikseminslag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On September 23, 1899, the old mill burns down as a result of lightning strike.

facts.text: Miller Wouterus van den Akker purchased the site in 1860, starting an eighty-year family ownership.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1860 koopt molenaar Wouterus van den Akker, destijds molenaar op molen ‘t Haantje, de molen. De familie blijft tachtig jaar eigenaar, maar op 31 december 1940 wordt De Vriendschap verkocht aan C.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1860, miller Wouterus van den Akker, then miller at mill 't Haantje, buys the mill. The family remains the owner for eighty years, but on December 31, 1940, De Vriendschap is sold to C.

facts.text: Welded steel spokes were crafted in 1976 by manufacturer Derckx.
facts.sourceQuote: De gelaste stalen roeden zijn gemaakt in 1976 door de fabrikant Derckx te Beegden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The welded steel spokes were made in 1976 by the manufacturer Derckx in Beegden.

features.name: Begijnhof
features.opening: The Begijnhof is one of the oldest hofjes in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Two distinct churches now stand within the quiet courtyard: the Catholic Miracle Church and the English Reformed Church.
facts.sourceQuote: Today it is also the site of two churches, the Catholic Miracle Church and the English Reformed Church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today it is also the site of two churches, the Catholic Miracle Church and the English Reformed Church.

features.name: Sint-Franciscus Xaveriuskerk
features.opening: De Krijtberg Kerk is a Roman Catholic church in Amsterdam, located at the Singel.

facts.text: A Jesuit church has stood on this site since 1654, replacing earlier clandestine versions.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 1654 there has been a Jesuit church at this location. The original clandestine church was replaced by another one in 1677.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1654 there has been a Jesuit church at this location. The original clandestine church was replaced by another one in 1677.

facts.text: Architect Alfred Tepe designed the current Neo-Gothic structure to be unusually tall due to space limits.
facts.sourceQuote: The current Neo-Gothic church was built on the same space in 1881. Space limitations urged architect Alfred Tepe to design an unusually tall church with a monumental front.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current Neo-Gothic church was built on the same space in 1881. Space limitations urged architect Alfred Tepe to design an unusually tall church with a monumental front.

facts.text: The interior was furnished by members of the Guild of St. Bernulphus, notably the Mengelberg firm.
facts.sourceQuote: The interior was provided by members of the Guild of St. Bernulphus, most notable the Mengelberg firm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The interior was provided by members of the Guild of St. Bernulphus, most notable the Mengelberg firm.

facts.text: Alfred Tepe designed this church, which opened its doors in 1883.
facts.sourceQuote: The church was designed by Alfred Tepe and was opened in 1883.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was designed by Alfred Tepe and was opened in 1883.

facts.text: Friedrich Wilhelm Mengelberg created the exuberant interior decoration.
facts.sourceQuote: The exuberant interior was made by Friedrich Wilhelm Mengelberg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The exuberant interior was made by Friedrich Wilhelm Mengelberg.

features.name: Van Buurenmonument
features.opening: The Van Buurenmonument is a memorial in Amsterdam commemorating Lucas van Buuren.

facts.text: The globe rests on a compass rose, a motif recurring in architect Piet Kramer's work.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bolvormig monument heeft een korte voet die rust op een kompasroos. Die kompasroos is een terugkerend onderdeel bij Piet Kramer, zie bijvoorbeeld zijn brug 543 in het Amsterdamse Bos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The spherical monument has a short base that rests on a compass rose. That compass rose is a recurring element at Piet Kramer's work, see for example his bridge 543 in the Amsterdamse Bos.

features.name: Old Church
features.opening: The Oude Kerk (English: Old Church) is a Reformed church in Amsterdam, Netherlands, being the oldest parish church in the city.

facts.text: North and south transepts were added around 1460 to create a cross-shaped floor plan.
facts.sourceQuote: Not long after the turn of the 15th century, north and south transepts were added to the church creating a cross formation. Work on these renovations was completed in 1460, though it is likely that progress was largely interrupted by the great fires that besieged the city in 1421 and 1452.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Not long after the turn of the 15th century, north and south transepts were added to the church creating a cross formation. Work on these renovations was completed in 1460, though it is likely that progress was largely interrupted by the great fires that besieged the city in 1421 and 1452.

facts.text: Following the Reformation in 1578, the site converted to a Calvinist church that remains today.
facts.sourceQuote: After the Reformation in 1578, it became a Reformed (Calvinist) church, which it remains today.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Reformation in 1578, it became a Reformed (Calvinist) church, which it remains today.

features.name: Moco Museum
features.opening: The Moco Museum (Modern Contemporary Museum) is an independent art museum with locations in Amsterdam, Barcelona, and London, dedicated to exhibiting modern…

facts.text: Kim Logchies-Prins and Lionel Logchies founded the museum in 2016 as an independent initiative.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was founded in 2016 by Kim Logchies-Prins and Lionel Logchies as an independent initiative aiming “to make modern and contemporary art more accessible to a wider audience beyond traditional collectors and institutions”.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded in 2016 by Kim Logchies-Prins and Lionel Logchies as an independent initiative aiming “to make modern and contemporary art more accessible to a wider audience beyond traditional collectors and institutions”.

facts.text: The Amsterdam location opened in 2016 inside a historic townhouse.
facts.sourceQuote: Moco Museum in Amsterdam opened in 2016 on Museumplein, in the historic Villa Alsberg, a townhouse designed in 1904 by Eduard Cuypers the nephew of Pierre Cuypers, designer of Amsterdam Central Station and the Rijksmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Moco Museum in Amsterdam opened in 2016 on Museumplein, in the historic Villa Alsberg, a townhouse designed in 1904 by Eduard Cuypers the nephew of Pierre Cuypers, designer of Amsterdam Central Station and the Rijksmuseum.

facts.text: Eduard Cuypers designed the building, being the nephew of Pierre Cuypers.
facts.sourceQuote: Moco Museum in Amsterdam opened in 2016 on Museumplein, in the historic Villa Alsberg, a townhouse designed in 1904 by Eduard Cuypers the nephew of Pierre Cuypers, designer of Amsterdam Central Station and the Rijksmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Moco Museum in Amsterdam opened in 2016 on Museumplein, in the historic Villa Alsberg, a townhouse designed in 1904 by Eduard Cuypers the nephew of Pierre Cuypers, designer of Amsterdam Central Station and the Rijksmuseum.

features.name: Willet-Holthuysen
features.opening: Museum Willet-Holthuysen is a located on the Herengracht in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Jacob Hop, who served as mayor of Amsterdam, originally commissioned the house around 1685.
facts.sourceQuote: The house was built for Jacob Hop, mayor of Amsterdam, around 1685.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was built for Jacob Hop, mayor of Amsterdam, around 1685.

facts.text: The exterior was redesigned in 1739 to reflect the fashionable Louis XIV style of that era.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1739 the outside was redesigned to look as it does today, in the then fashionable Louis XIV style.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1739 the outside was redesigned to look as it does today, in the then fashionable Louis XIV style.

facts.text: Louisa Holthuysen bequeathed the property to Amsterdam in 1895, naming it after herself and her husband Abraham Willet.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1895, its owner, Louisa Holthuysen, bequeathed the building and its contents, including the art collected by her and her husband, Abraham Willet, to the city of Amsterdam on condition that it became a museum bearing their names.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1895, its owner, Louisa Holthuysen, bequeathed the building and its contents, including the art collected by her and her husband, Abraham Willet, to the city of Amsterdam on condition that it became a museum bearing their names.

facts.text: The garden and kitchen were restored in 1972.
facts.sourceQuote: Three floors are open to the public, the souterrain, with the kitchen and garden (restored in 1972), the first floor (bel-etage with long hallway), and the top floor, with one bedroom on display and rooms for exhibitions.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three floors are open to the public, the souterrain, with the kitchen and garden (restored in 1972), the first floor (bel-etage with long hallway), and the top floor, with one bedroom on display and rooms for exhibitions.

facts.text: Flower paintings by Amsterdam artist Adriana Johanna Haanen hang on the walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Flower paintings are on display by various Amsterdam painters, such as Adriana Johanna Haanen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Flower paintings are on display by various Amsterdam painters, such as Adriana Johanna Haanen.

features.name: P.W. Janssen
features.opening: The Monument Peter Wilhelm Janssen is a monument on Bellamyplein in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: The bronze bust was sculpted by Bart van Hove and unveiled in 1908.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld gemaakt door Bart van Hove werd 29 mei 1908 onthuld door Jacob Theodoor Cremer, oud-minister van koloniën en tevens voorzitter van het comité, die een nagedachtenis wilde van Peter Wilhelm Janssen, ondernemer, filantroop en medeoprichter van de Deli Maatschappij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue made by Bart van Hove was unveiled on May 29, 1908 by Jacob Theodoor Cremer, former minister of colonies and also chairman of the committee, who wanted to commemorate Peter Wilhelm Janssen, entrepreneur, philanthropist and co-founder of the Deli Maatschappij.

facts.text: A tapered base of Norwegian granite supports the four-meter tall monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gedenkteken bestaat uit een taps toelopende sokkel van Noors graniet, met daarop het bronzen borstbeeld van Janssen. Het heeft een totale hoogte van vier meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument consists of a tapered base of Norwegian granite, with the bronze bust of Janssen on it. It has a total height of four meters.

facts.text: Janssen's statue was temporarily removed between 1954 and 1955 during a fountain replacement.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld werd enige tijd weggehaald toen in 1954/1955 de grote fontein in het middel van het plantsoen vervangen werd door een pierenbad. Op 13 mei 1955 werd het weer op zijn plaats getakeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue was removed for a while when in 1954/1955 the large fountain in the middle of the lawn was replaced by a pier bath. On May 13, 1955, it was again brought back into place.

features.name: Meerpadkerk
features.opening: The Meerpadkerkje is a small white-painted wooden Mennonite meeting house in Nieuwendam, now part of Amsterdam-Noord, built in 1843 by the Nieuwendam carpenter…

facts.text: Since 1970, the building has held official status as a national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1970 wordt het gebouw beschermd als rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1970, the building has been protected as a national monument.

features.name: Dominicuskerk
features.opening: The Dominicuskerk is a neo-Gothic church building on Spuistraat in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Architect Pierre Cuypers designed the current structure after being commissioned in 1878.
facts.sourceQuote: Tielens O.P. gaf in 1878 aan architect Pierre Cuypers de opdracht om een kerk te ontwerpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1878, Tielens O.P. commissioned architect Pierre Cuypers to design a church.

features.name: Oost-Indisch Huis
features.opening: The Oost-Indisch Huis (Dutch for "East India House") is an early 17th-century building in the centre of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Completed in 1606, the Oost-Indisch Huis was the first structure built specifically for the East India Company.
facts.sourceQuote: This building, completed in 1606, was called the Oost-Indisch Huis ("East India House") and was the first building especially built for the East India Company.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This building, completed in 1606, was called the Oost-Indisch Huis ("East India House") and was the first building especially built for the East India Company.

facts.text: Architect Hendrick de Keyser likely designed the building featuring Amsterdam Renaissance style facades.
facts.sourceQuote: A gate with Tuscan-style pilasters and a small tunnel lead to an inner courtyard with elegant facades in Amsterdam Renaissance style, a style closely identified with the architect Hendrick de Keyser, who was most likely responsible for designing the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A gate with Tuscan-style pilasters and a small tunnel lead to an inner courtyard with elegant facades in Amsterdam Renaissance style, a style closely identified with the architect Hendrick de Keyser, who was most likely responsible for designing the building.

facts.text: After the company dissolved in 1798, the site served as the colonial government seat until 1808.
facts.sourceQuote: After the East India Company was dissolved in 1798, the building served until 1808 as the seat of the colonial government of the Batavian Republic.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the East India Company was dissolved in 1798, the building served until 1808 as the seat of the colonial government of the Batavian Republic.

facts.text: The adjacent Bushuis was demolished in 1891 to make way for a new eastern wing along the inner courtyard.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1891, the adjacent Bushuis was demolished and a new eastern wing, designed by Cornelis Peters, was added along the inner courtyard.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1891, the adjacent Bushuis was demolished and a new eastern wing, designed by Cornelis Peters, was added along the inner courtyard.

facts.text: The name Oost-Indisch Huis translates to East India House.
facts.sourceQuote: The Oost-Indisch Huis (Dutch for "East India House") is an early 17th-century building in the centre of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Oost-Indisch Huis (Dutch for "East India House") is an early 17th-century building in the centre of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Today, the building holds the official status of a listed Dutch national heritage site.
facts.sourceQuote: It is a listed Dutch national heritage site (rijksmonument).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a listed Dutch national heritage site (rijksmonument).

features.name: Melkweg
features.opening: Melkweg (Dutch for "Milky Way") is a music venue and cultural center on Lijnbaansgracht, near Leidseplein in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Cor Schlösser helped reopen the venue as a cultural center in July 1970.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was closed for a year, but reopened by Cor Schlösser and others as a cultural center, with its first event on July 17, 1970.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was closed for a year, but reopened by Cor Schlösser and others as a cultural center, with its first event on July 17, 1970.

facts.text: The Max hall opened in 1995 with a capacity of 1,000 people.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1995, The Max opened, first with a capacity of 1,000 people, expanded to 1,500 in 2007.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1995, The Max opened, first with a capacity of 1,000 people, expanded to 1,500 in 2007.

facts.text: U2 played their first concert outside Ireland and the UK here in October 1980.
facts.sourceQuote: In October 1980, U2 played their first concert outside of Ireland and the United Kingdom at the Melkweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In October 1980, U2 played their first concert outside of Ireland and the United Kingdom at the Melkweg.

facts.text: Prince performed a surprise show in 2011 with tickets sold just one hour prior.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2011, Prince played a surprise show at the venue, with tickets going on sale one hour before the show started.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2011, Prince played a surprise show at the venue, with tickets going on sale one hour before the show started.

features.name: Hollandsche Schouwburg
features.opening: The Hollandsche Schouwburg (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔlɑntsə ˈsxʌubʏr(ə)x]; English: Hollandic Theatre) is a museum in Amsterdam in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Nazi occupiers reclassified the theater as a Jewish venue in 1941 before using it as a deportation center.
facts.sourceQuote: Originally, the Hollandsche Schouwburg was a Dutch theatre, but it was deemed a Jewish theatre in 1941 by Nazi occupiers, and it was later used as a deportation center during the Holocaust in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the Hollandsche Schouwburg was a Dutch theatre, but it was deemed a Jewish theatre in 1941 by Nazi occupiers, and it was later used as a deportation center during the Holocaust in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Teenager Lydia Riezouw secretly photographed prisoners, including her friend Greetje Velleman, from her window in 1942.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1942, teenaged Lydia Riezouw took five photographs from her home window of the Jewish prisoners being held at Hollandsche Schouwburg, which included her Jewish friend Greetje Velleman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1942, teenaged Lydia Riezouw took five photographs from her home window of the Jewish prisoners being held at Hollandsche Schouwburg, which included her Jewish friend Greetje Velleman.

features.name: De Papegaai
features.opening: De Papegaai is the lesser of the two parochial churches in the St Nicholas Roman Catholic parish in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The nickname De Papegaai (The Parrot) recalls its hiding spot behind a bird-trader's garden during Catholic persecution.
facts.sourceQuote: It is nicknamed "De Papegaai" (The Parrot) because it was originally hidden in a garden behind a regular housefront that belonged to a bird-trader in the days when Catholicism could not be practised publicly.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is nicknamed "De Papegaai" (The Parrot) because it was originally hidden in a garden behind a regular housefront that belonged to a bird-trader in the days when Catholicism could not be practised publicly.

facts.text: A narrow Neo-Gothic facade features statues of Saint Joseph and a perched parrot flanking the entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: Today there is a narrow, Neo-Gothic facade flanked by statues of Saint Joseph and a perched parrot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today there is a narrow, Neo-Gothic facade flanked by statues of Saint Joseph and a perched parrot.

facts.text: Gregoriana Amsterdam, a vocal ensemble, calls this church home while celebrating Latin Mass with Gregorian chant.
facts.sourceQuote: The church is on the busy Kalverstraat just south of Dam Square, and invites people in for quiet, as well as celebrating Sunday Mass (Post-Vatican II Mass) in Latin with Gregorian chant. It is the home of the vocal ensemble Gregoriana Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is on the busy Kalverstraat just south of Dam Square, and invites people in for quiet, as well as celebrating Sunday Mass (Post-Vatican II Mass) in Latin with Gregorian chant. It is the home of the vocal ensemble Gregoriana Amsterdam.

features.name: De Dolphijn
features.opening: The house De Dolphijn is a canal house at Singel 140-142 in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Hendrick de Keyser's original facade design was simplified by removing classicist pilasters and cornices.
facts.sourceQuote: Er bestaat een ontwerptekening van de voorgevel door Hendrick de Keyser, maar dit ontwerp is niet geheel uitgevoerd: de gevel is versoberd door het schrappen van classicistische elementen als pilasters en kroonlijsten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a design drawing of the facade by Hendrick de Keyser, but this design has not been fully executed: the facade has been simplified by removing classicist elements such as pilasters and cornices.

features.name: Kriterion
features.opening: Film theater Kriterion, officially the Association for Mutual Student Support Kriterion (V.O.S.S. Kriterion), is a student-run cinema and student association…

facts.text: Pediatrician Hein Fiedeldij Dop helped hide Jewish children by using police contacts to spot raids.
facts.sourceQuote: De Amsterdamse Studenten Groep rond Wouter van Zeytveld en Piet Meerburg wist met hulp van de kinderarts Hein Fiedeldij Dop, die door contacten bij de politie op de hoogte was van op handen zijnde razzia's op Joden, kinderen onder te brengen bij onderduikadressen buiten de stad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the help of pediatrician Hein Fiedeldij Dop, who was aware of impending raids on Jews and children through contacts with the police, the Amsterdam Student Group around Wouter van Zeytveld and Piet Meerburg was able to place children at hiding addresses outside the city with the help of the child psychiatrist Hein Fiedeldij Dop.

facts.text: About a thousand children were saved from the nursery school opposite the Hollandsche Schouwburg.
facts.sourceQuote: Samen met andere verzetsgroepen redde men ongeveer duizend Joodse kinderen uit de crèche tegenover de Hollandsche Schouwburg aan de Plantage Middenlaan, waar de kinderen verbleven in afwachting van transport naar Duitsland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Together with other resistance groups, about a thousand Jewish children were saved from the nursery school opposite the Hollandsche Schouwburg on Plantage Middenlaan, where the children were staying in anticipation of transport to Germany.

features.name: Oosterparkkerk
features.opening: The Oosterparkkerk stands on the west side of the Oosterpark in Amsterdam, in the Oosterparkbuurt.

facts.text: Architect Abraham Salm designed the church in an eclectic style influenced by Jugendstil.
facts.sourceQuote: Salm ontwierp voor 1900 vooral in een eclectische stijl. Daarna werd hij beïnvloed door nieuwere stijlen zoals de jugendstil, die bij de Doopsgezinde Oosterparkkerk ook is toegepast.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Salm designed mainly in an eclectic style before 1900. After that, he was influenced by newer styles such as Jugendstil, which was also applied to the Baptist Oosterparkkerk.

facts.text: Salm often used natural stone and varied arch shapes for the wall openings.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebruik van verschillende boogvormen in de muuropeningen is in meerdere werken van Salm terug te zien. Vaak maakte hij gebruik van natuursteen in zijn ontwerpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The use of different arch shapes in the wall openings can be seen in several works by Salm. He often used natural stone in his designs.

facts.text: The Baptist congregation held a simple opening ceremony on a working day to prevent disorder.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat de doopsgezinde gemeente uit 5.000 leden bestond, ”had de kerkenraad, teneinde wanordelijkheden en teleurstelling te voorkomen, goedgevonden de eenvoudige plechtigheid op een werkdag en in besloten kring te doen plaats hebben.” Zowel de Kleine Courant als de Zondagsbode berichten over de opening.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the Baptist church consisted of 5,000 members, "in order to prevent disorder and disappointment, the church council decided to hold the simple ceremony on a working day and in a closed circle." Both the Kleine Courant and the Zondagsbode report on the opening.

facts.text: Brown glazed brick bands and natural stone frames enliven the church's brick facades.
facts.sourceQuote: De bakstenen gevels zijn verlevendigd met banden van bruin verglaasde bakstenen en natuurstenen lijsten en ornamenten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The brick facades are enlivened with bands of brown glazed bricks and natural stone frames and ornaments.

facts.text: The corner facades sit slightly behind the roofline to create a small courtyard between the building and fences.
facts.sourceQuote: De vrije gevels op de hoek liggen iets achter de rooilijn, zodat een kleine 'voorhof' ontstaat tussen de smeedijzeren hekken en het gebouw.
