facts.sourceQuote: The zoo is commonly referred to as Artis, because the zoo has three gates with the words 'Natura', 'Artis', and 'Magistra' written above each of them, respectively, which combined formed its actual name. More often than not, only the middle gate was open, so that people who walked through it, seeing that 'Artis' was written above it, believed that the zoo was just called Artis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The zoo is commonly referred to as Artis, because the zoo has three gates with the words 'Natura', 'Artis', and 'Magistra' written above each of them, respectively, which combined formed its actual name. More often than not, only the middle gate was open, so that people who walked through it, seeing that 'Artis' was written above it, believed that the zoo was just called Artis.

facts.text: Artis holds the title of the oldest zoo in the Netherlands and the fifth oldest still operating worldwide.
facts.sourceQuote: It is the oldest zoo in the Netherlands and fifth oldest zoo in the world that is still operating.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is the oldest zoo in the Netherlands and fifth oldest zoo in the world that is still operating.

features.name: Arcam
features.opening: Amsterdam Centre for Architecture (Arcam) is an organisation that was founded in 1986 that "concentrates its activities in Amsterdam and the surrounding area."…

facts.text: The organization relies on support from donors, sponsors, and the Stimuleringsfonds voor Architectuur.
facts.sourceQuote: Arcam's work is made possible by donors, sponsors, several services of the municipality of Amsterdam and the Stimuleringsfonds voor Architectuur (English: Support Foundation for Architecture).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Arcam's work is made possible by donors, sponsors, several services of the municipality of Amsterdam and the Stimuleringsfonds voor Architectuur (English: Support Foundation for Architecture).

features.name: Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk
features.opening: The Tichelkerk or Tichel is a church building at the corner of the Lijnbaansgracht and the Tichelstraat in the Amsterdamse Jordaan.

facts.text: In 2005 the site became known as Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk, or Saint Nicholas of Myra Church.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2005 werd het de Russisch-orthodoxe Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2005 it became the Russian Orthodox Heilige Nikolaas van Myrakerk.

facts.text: Following the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, this parish left the Moscow Patriarchate to join Constantinople.
facts.sourceQuote: Naar aanleiding van de Russische invasie van Oekraïne in 2022 scheidde de parochie zich af van het Patriarchaat Moskou en sloot zich aan bij het Orthodox Aartsbisdom van België, Exarchaat van Nederland en Luxemburg onder het Oecumenisch patriarchaat van Constantinopel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Following the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the parish separated from the Patriarchate of Moscow and joined the Orthodox Archdiocese of Belgium, Exarchate of the Netherlands and Luxembourg under the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople.

facts.text: The Capuchin order purchased the land in 1910 for just 2,200 guilders to build a chapel.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1910 kocht de kapucijner-orde voor 2200 gulden het terrein omdat ze er een hulpkerk wilden bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1910, the Capuchin order bought the land for 2200 guilders because they wanted to build a chapel there.

features.name: Jeruzalemkerk
features.opening: The Jeruzalemkerk is a Protestant church on the Jan Maijenstraat in the West borough of Amsterdam, in the De Baarsjes district near the Mercatorplein.

facts.text: The name Jeruzalemkerk honors Jerusalem, a city without a temple since the year 70.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze is ontleend aan de inzamelingsactie Stad zonder Tempel die gehouden werd om de kerk te financieren. Omdat Jeruzalem sinds het jaar 70 een stad zonder tempel is, was deze naam toepasselijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This is taken from the City without Temple fundraising campaign held to finance the church. Because Jerusalem has been a city without a temple since the year 70, this name was appropriate.

facts.text: Planners originally intended to call it Nieuwe Westerkerk before choosing its final name.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk wilde men de kerk de Nieuwe Westerkerk noemen, vanwege haar ligging in het Plan West, maar uiteindelijk koos men voor de naam Jeruzalemkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the church was intended to be called the Nieuwe Westerkerk, due to its location in the Plan West, but in the end, the name Jeruzalemkerk was chosen.

facts.text: Unlike most churches, this building runs north-south rather than the traditional east-west orientation.
facts.sourceQuote: De Jeruzalemkerk is noord-zuid gericht, terwijl de meeste kerken oost-west gericht zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Jeruzalemkerk is north-south oriented, while most churches are east-west oriented.

facts.text: Architect Jantzen deliberately attached the structure directly to existing houses to symbolize God living with people.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was een bewuste keuze van de architect Jantzen om de kerk aan woningen vast te bouwen. Dit drukt uit dat God bij de mensen wil wonen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was a deliberate choice of the architect Jantzen to build the church onto houses. This expresses that God wants to live with people.

features.name: Rembrandt van Rijn statue
features.opening: The Rembrandt monument is a 19th-century memorial to the painter Rembrandt van Rijn on the Rembrandtplein in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The statue depicts Rembrandt sitting on a box with initials RVR, holding a pencil and sketchbook.
facts.sourceQuote: In zijn ontwerp beeldde hij Rembrandt zittend en tekenend af, met in zijn linkerhand een schetsboek en in zijn rechterhand een tekenstift. Rembrandt zit op een kist, met de initialen RVR, waar een palet met penselen tegenaan staat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In his design, he depicted Rembrandt sitting and drawing, with a sketchbook in his left hand and a drawing pencil in his right hand. Rembrandt is sitting on a box, with the initials RVR, where a palette of brushes is standing against it.

facts.text: Louis Royer secured the commission in July 1842 despite an intended design competition.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zou een ontwerpwedstrijd worden uitgeschreven, maar Louis Royer kreeg het via zijn relaties voor elkaar dat hij in juli 1842 de opdracht kreeg een standbeeld te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A design competition would have been announced, but Louis Royer managed through his connections to get the commission to make a statue in July 1842.

features.name: Herdenkingsmonument
features.opening: Herdenkingsmonument, also known as Commemoration and remembrance, is an artistic work of art in the Gijsbrecht van Amstelpark, Buitenveldert, Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Artist Mischa Rakier created the work in 2014 after a commission from Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld van kunstenaar Mischa Rakier (geboren Delft 1970) is in 2014 geplaatst na een opdracht van de gemeente Amsterdam en het Stadsdeel Zuid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image of artist Mischa Rakier (born Delft 1970) was placed in 2014 after an order from the municipality of Amsterdam and the South District.

facts.text: The diamond-shaped sculpture is crafted from ceramic-polished stainless steel with a matte finish.
facts.sourceQuote: Het herdenkingsteken is gemaakt van keramisch gepareld roestvast staal en heeft de vorm van een liggende diamant. Die bewerking zorgt ervoor dat het staal enigszins mat is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The commemorative sign is made of ceramic-polished stainless steel and has the shape of a lying diamond. That processing ensures that the steel is somewhat matte.

facts.text: A quote by Elie Wiesel about memory appears on the monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld is voorzien van de tekst If you could remember what I remember you would understand. Die tekst sprak Elie Wiesel uit toen hij de Nobelprijs voor de Vrede op 10 december 1986 in Oslo kreeg overhandigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image is provided with the text If you could remember what I remember you would understand. That text was spoken by Elie Wiesel when he received the Nobel Peace Prize on December 10, 1986 in Oslo.

features.name: Museum Amsterdam Noord
features.opening: Museum Amsterdam Noord is a Dutch cultural history museum on the corner of Zamenhofstraat and Meeuwenlaan in Amsterdam-North.

facts.text: Garden village houses originally lacked bathrooms, making this bathhouse a necessity.
facts.sourceQuote: De woningen in dit tuindorp hadden geen badkamer en dus was een badhuis noodzakelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The houses in this garden village did not have a bathroom and so a bathhouse was necessary.

features.name: Ketelhuis
features.opening: Het Ketelhuis is a Dutch film theater that has been located in the Westergasfabriek cultural park in Amsterdam since 1999.

facts.text: Founders Ton Schippers and Marc van Warmerdam secured a three-year temporary permit from the city.
facts.sourceQuote: Theater- en filmproducenten Ton Schippers en Marc van Warmerdam kregen toestemming van de gemeente Amsterdam om zolang de toekomstplannen van de Westergasfabriek nog niet bekend waren er voor drie jaar een tijdelijke bioscoop in te richten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Theater and film producers Ton Schippers and Marc van Warmerdam received permission from the municipality of Amsterdam to set up a temporary cinema for three years as long as the future plans of the Westergasfabriek were not yet known.

facts.text: The original temporary venue featured reclining benches instead of traditional cinema seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De tijdelijke locatie kenmerkte zich door het gebruik van (lig)banken in plaats van bioscoopstoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The temporary location was characterized by the use of (reclining) benches instead of cinema seats.

facts.text: The venue screens Dutch productions, European arthouse cinema, documentaries, and family films.
facts.sourceQuote: Er worden Nederlandse films, Europese arthousefilms, documentaires en familiefilms vertoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dutch films, European arthouse films, documentaries and family films are shown.

features.name: Felix Meritis
features.opening: Felix Meritis ('Happy through Merit') is the name of an intellectual society in Amsterdam, but subsequently used for their building on the Keizersgracht.

facts.text: Five sculptures on the façade represent the society's five departments: arts, literature, trade, sciences, and music.
facts.sourceQuote: The classical temple façade with its colossal Corinthian pilasters and pediment represent the society's five departments with five sculptures representing the visual arts and architecture, literature, trade, natural sciences and music.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The classical temple façade with its colossal Corinthian pilasters and pediment represent the society's five departments with five sculptures representing the visual arts and architecture, literature, trade, natural sciences and music.

facts.text: A fire destroyed part of the structure in 1932.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1932 part of the building was destroyed in a fire.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1932 part of the building was destroyed in a fire.

facts.text: On November 4, 1956, the building was stormed by protesters against the Soviet invasion of Hungary.
facts.sourceQuote: This image became especially embedded in the collective memory when the building was stormed on 4 November 1956, in response to the Soviet invasion of Hungary and its endorsement by the Dutch communist party.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This image became especially embedded in the collective memory when the building was stormed on 4 November 1956, in response to the Soviet invasion of Hungary and its endorsement by the Dutch communist party.

facts.text: In 1969, the Shaffy Theatre opened here as a hub for the Dutch avant-garde.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1969 the Shaffy Theatre opened, which gained a reputation as a stopping place for the Dutch avant-garde, including Ramses Shaffy, Baal, Neerlands Hoop, Independent Theatre and Hauser Orkater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1969 the Shaffy Theatre opened, which gained a reputation as a stopping place for the Dutch avant-garde, including Ramses Shaffy, Baal, Neerlands Hoop, Independent Theatre and Hauser Orkater.

features.name: Simon Carmiggelt
features.opening: The Bust of Simon Carmiggelt is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: A path nearby bears the name Kronkelpad, derived from Carmiggelt's daily newspaper column.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld staat aan het Kronkelpad, een pad vernoemd naar Carmiggelts dagelijkse verhaaltjes “Kronkel”.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue is located on the Kronkelpad, a path named after Carmiggelts daily stories "Kronkel".

features.name: Marseille House
features.opening: Huis Marseille is a photography museum in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The house bears the name of Marseille, a city depicted on its façade stone.
facts.sourceQuote: On the building's classical façade, Focquier placed a stone depicting the layout of the French port city of Marseille.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the building's classical façade, Focquier placed a stone depicting the layout of the French port city of Marseille.

facts.text: French merchant Isaac Focquier built this canal house around 1665.
facts.sourceQuote: The monumental canal house is built around 1665 for the French merchant Isaac Focquier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monumental canal house is built around 1665 for the French merchant Isaac Focquier.

facts.text: Unlike traditional galleries, the space avoids white walls to use authentic light-filled rooms.
facts.sourceQuote: Huis Marseille deviates from the traditional "white cube" layout. Its authentic, light-filled spaces enhance the presentation and experience of the photographic works.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Huis Marseille deviates from the traditional "white cube" layout. Its authentic, light-filled spaces enhance the presentation and experience of the photographic works.

features.name: Van Gogh Museum
features.opening: The Van Gogh Museum (Dutch pronunciation: [vɑŋˈɣɔx mʏˌzeːjʏm]) is a Dutch art museum dedicated to the works of Vincent van Gogh and his contemporaries in the…

facts.text: Architects Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa designed the buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum opened on 2 June 1973, and its buildings were designed by Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum opened on 2 June 1973, and its buildings were designed by Gerrit Rietveld and Kisho Kurokawa.

facts.text: A technology-driven immersive exhibition launched there in 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2019, the Van Gogh Museum launched the Meet Vincent Van Gogh Experience, a technology-driven "immersive exhibition" on Van Gogh's life and works, which has toured globally.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2019, the Van Gogh Museum launched the Meet Vincent Van Gogh Experience, a technology-driven "immersive exhibition" on Van Gogh's life and works, which has toured globally.

facts.text: Johanna van Gogh-Bonger sold many paintings to spread knowledge while keeping a private collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Selling many of Vincent's paintings with the ambition of spreading knowledge of his artwork, Johanna maintained a private collection of his works.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Selling many of Vincent's paintings with the ambition of spreading knowledge of his artwork, Johanna maintained a private collection of his works.

facts.text: The collection was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.

facts.text: Vincent Willem van Gogh inherited the art collection from his mother in 1925.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection was inherited by her son Vincent Willem van Gogh in 1925, eventually loaned to the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam, where it was displayed for many years, and was transferred to the state-initiated Vincent van Gogh Foundation in 1962.

features.name: Amsterdam Museum
features.opening: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present.

facts.text: Architects Hendrick de Keyser and his son Pieter de Keyser originally extended the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was extended by Hendrick and his son Pieter de Keyser, then rebuilt by Jacob van Campen in 1634.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was extended by Hendrick and his son Pieter de Keyser, then rebuilt by Jacob van Campen in 1634.

facts.text: Jacob van Campen completely rebuilt the facility in 1634 after earlier expansions.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was extended by Hendrick and his son Pieter de Keyser, then rebuilt by Jacob van Campen in 1634.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was extended by Hendrick and his son Pieter de Keyser, then rebuilt by Jacob van Campen in 1634.

facts.text: The institution kept the name Amsterdam Historical Museum until it changed in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam Museum, known until 2010 as the Amsterdam Historical Museum, is an Amsterdam-based museum dedicated to the city's past and present.

facts.text: A major renovation forced the museum to move temporarily to the Amstelhof on the river.
facts.sourceQuote: Due to the renovation of its main location, the museum is temporarily located in the Amstelhof on the Amstel River, together with H'ART Museum and the dependence of the Museum van de Geest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the renovation of its main location, the museum is temporarily located in the Amstelhof on the Amstel River, together with H'ART Museum and the dependence of the Museum van de Geest.

features.name: Keizersgrachtkerk
features.opening: The Keizersgrachtkerk is a church of 1888, originally Reformed, on the Amsterdam Keizersgracht.

facts.text: A 1663 decree forbidding construction on inner lands forced the church to relocate its plan.
facts.sourceQuote: Er bestond namelijk een keur uit 1663 die voorschreef dat de binnenterreinen niet bebouwd mochten worden. Daarom werd het plan gewijzigd en werd het dubbele herenhuis aan de gracht afgebroken om plaats te maken voor de kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There was actually a decree of 1663 that prescribed that the inner lands could not be built on. That is why the plan was changed and the double townhouse on the canal was demolished to make way for the church.

facts.text: Two priests were shot dead by German occupiers in September 1944 after weapons were found in a church annex.
facts.sourceQuote: In de nacht van 12 op 13 september 1944 werden de koster, Sieberen van der Baan (1894), en een van de twee predikanten, Taeke Ferwerda (1876), door Duitse bezetters in de Kerkstraat doodgeschoten, vijf dagen na de vondst van wapens in een bijgebouw van de kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the night of September 12 to 13, 1944, the parish priest, Sieberen van der Baan (1894), and one of the two priests, Taeke Ferwerda (1876), were shot dead by German occupiers in Kerkstraat, five days after the discovery of weapons in an annex of the church.

features.name: Filmhuis Cavia
features.opening: Filmhuis Cavia is a film theater in the Van Hallstraat in the Amsterdam Staatsliedenbuurt that is run entirely by volunteers.

facts.text: The cinema emerged in the 1980s from the squatting movement.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop is in de jaren tachtig voortgekomen uit de kraakbeweging en heeft een eenvoudige formule: er wordt gedraaid wat elders niet te zien is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema emerged in the 1980s from the squatting movement and has a simple formula: it shows what cannot be seen elsewhere.

facts.text: Festivals like Pink Film Days and CinemAsia began their runs here.
facts.sourceQuote: Filmfestivals als Roze Filmdagen, CinemAsia en het KLIK! Amsterdam Animation Festival zijn in Cavia begonnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Film festivals such as Pink Film Days, CinemAsia and the KLIK! Amsterdam Animation Festival has started in Cavia.

facts.text: Analog films in 16 and 35 mm formats are still projected alongside digital ones.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de gangbare digitale projectie worden er ook nog steeds analoge films (16 en 35 mm) gedraaid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the conventional digital projection, analog films (16 and 35 mm) are still being shown.

features.name: Museum Van Loon
features.opening: Museum Van Loon is a museum located in a canalside house alongside the Keizersgracht in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: The Van Loon family resided here continuously for over sixty years from 1884 until 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1884 to 1945 the Van Loons lived in the house.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1884 to 1945 the Van Loons lived in the house.

facts.text: Thora van Loon-Egidius served as a lady-in-waiting to Queen Wilhelmina of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Thora van Loon-Egidius, who lived in the house, was a lady-in-waiting for Wilhelmina of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thora van Loon-Egidius, who lived in the house, was a lady-in-waiting for Wilhelmina of the Netherlands.

facts.text: Four sculptures of Ceres, Mars, Minerva and Vulcan crown the house.
facts.sourceQuote: There are four sculptures on top of the house, representing Ceres, Mars, Minerva and Vulcan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are four sculptures on top of the house, representing Ceres, Mars, Minerva and Vulcan.

facts.text: Famous architect Adriaan Dortsman designed the house in 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: The house was designed in 1672 by Adriaan Dortsman, the famous Dutch architect known for having created the Ronde Lutherse Kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was designed in 1672 by Adriaan Dortsman, the famous Dutch architect known for having created the Ronde Lutherse Kerk.

features.name: Amsterdam University College
features.opening: Amsterdam University College is a Liberal Arts and Sciences Bachelor's programme that is a joint initiative of the University of Amsterdam and Vrije…

facts.text: The college officially opened its doors to students in 2009 after being founded in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: AUC was officially founded in 2008, and took up operation with its founding class in 2009.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: AUC was officially founded in 2008, and took up operation with its founding class in 2009.

facts.text: Murray Pratt took over as dean from van der Wende in 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016, van der Wende was succeeded as AUC dean by Prof. Murray Pratt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016, van der Wende was succeeded as AUC dean by Prof. Murray Pratt.

facts.text: The programme was founded in 2008 with a particular focus on the sciences.
facts.sourceQuote: The programme was founded in 2008 with a particular focus on the sciences.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The programme was founded in 2008 with a particular focus on the sciences.

facts.text: Students live and study together on an international campus located in Amsterdam Science Park.
facts.sourceQuote: Students live and study together on an international campus located in Amsterdam Science Park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students live and study together on an international campus located in Amsterdam Science Park.

facts.text: Although AUC has its own building for classes, students can also use facilities of both parent universities.
facts.sourceQuote: Although AUC has its own building for classes, students can also use facilities of both parent universities.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although AUC has its own building for classes, students can also use facilities of both parent universities.

features.name: Posthoornkerk
features.opening: The Posthoornkerk, official name Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception, is a church building on Haarlemmerstraat in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The name Posthoornkerk was inherited from a dilapidated hiding church on Prinsengracht that it replaced.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk verving de bouwvallig geworden schuilkerk De Posthoorn aan de Prinsengracht, waarvan de naam overgenomen werd, nadat een eerdere poging van pastoor Antonius Arnoldus Steinbach om op de oude locatie een nieuwe kerk te bouwen door tegenwerking van het departement voor de R.K.Eeredienst in 1836 was mislukt, omdat direct om de hoek aan de Keizersgracht net even eerder de statie De Zaaier haar bedehuis al door nieuwbouw had vervangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church replaced the dilapidated hiding church De Posthoorn on the Prinsengracht, whose name was taken over, after an earlier attempt by pastor Antonius Arnoldus Steinbach to build a new church on the old site had failed in 1836 due to opposition from the department for the Catholic Worship Service, because just around the corner on the Keizersgracht, just a little earlier, the station De Zaaier had already replaced its chapel with a new building.

facts.text: Because the site could not accommodate a free-standing structure, the church was built extra high with internal galleries.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat de kerk niet vrijstaand kon worden gebouwd werd zij extra hoog uitgevoerd. Om de beperkte ruimte optimaal te benutten werd de kerk inwendig voorzien van galerijen boven de zijbeuken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the church could not be built free-standing, it was made extra high. In order to make the most of the limited space, the church was internally provided with galleries above the side aisles.

features.name: Collectie Six
features.opening: The Collectie Six is the common name for the patrimony of the Six family that, in addition to the family portraits, includes the family archive and art and…

facts.text: Jan Six VI's six children renounced succession rights to keep the collection intact.
facts.sourceQuote: Zijn zes kinderen deden afstand van dit deel van het bezit en successierechten over de collectie hoefden niet meer betaald te worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His six children renounced this part of the property and succession rights over the collection no longer had to be paid.

facts.text: Collectie Six is the shared patrimony of the Six family.
facts.sourceQuote: De Collectie Six is de gemeenschappelijke naam voor het patrimonium van de familie Six dat naast de familieportretten onder andere het familie-archief en kunst- en antieke voorwerpen in relatie tot de familie omvat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Collectie Six is the common name for the patrimony of the Six family, which includes, in addition to family portraits, the family archive and art and antique objects related to the family, among other things.

features.name: Monument Walraven van Hall
features.opening: The Monument Walraven van Hall is a work of art and war monument in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: Retired doctors Hans Weijers and Loek van Buchem founded the group to create this tribute.
facts.sourceQuote: Initiatiefnemer voor dit plastiek was gepensioneerd huisarts Hans Weijers en gepensioneerd medicus Loek van Buchem die een stichting in het leven riepen om een monument voor verzetsman Walraven van Hall op te richten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The initiator of this plastic was retired general practitioner Hans Weijers and retired doctor Loek van Buchem who set up a foundation to establish a monument for resistance fighter Walraven van Hall.

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on September 3, 2010, opposite De Nederlandsche Bank.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk werd op 3 september 2010 onthuld op het Frederiksplein tegenover De Nederlandsche Bank, op het moment dat in het Verzetsmuseum aan de Plantage Kerklaan een tentoonstelling over hem te zien was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The work of art was unveiled on September 3, 2010 on the Frederiksplein opposite De Nederlandsche Bank, at the time when an exhibition about him was being held at the Resistance Museum on the Plantage Kerklaan.

features.name: Luther Museum Amsterdam
features.opening: The Luther Museum Amsterdam, formerly known as the Luther Collection Amsterdam, is a museum that wants to introduce the public to Lutheranism in the…

facts.text: The institution was renamed Luther Museum Amsterdam in 2019, having previously been called the Luther Collection Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2008 draagt de stichting, die als doelstelling het behoud van luthers erfgoed heeft, de naam Luther Collectie Amsterdam, welke in 2019 de naam gekregen heeft Luther Museum Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2008, the foundation, which aims to preserve Lutheran heritage, has been called the Luther Collection Amsterdam, which was renamed Luther Museum Amsterdam in 2019.

facts.text: A Lutheran art foundation established in 1986 created this collection to save church treasures during a turbulent era of closures.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1986 heeft dit geleid tot de oprichting van een lutherse kunststichting met als doel luthers kerkelijk en diaconaal bezit bijeen te brengen, te inventariseren en waar nodig ter behoud te restaureren. Het was een roerige tijd waarin veel lutherse instellingen ophielden te bestaan en als gevolg daarvan dreigde luthers (kunst)bezit te verdwijnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1986, this led to the establishment of a Lutheran art foundation with the aim of bringing together, cataloguing and, where necessary, restoring Lutheran ecclesiastical and diaconal property for conservation. It was a turbulent time in which many Lutheran institutions ceased to exist and as a result Lutheran (art) property threatened to disappear.

facts.text: The authentic interiors of the former regent's chambers are themselves considered valuable art historical pieces within the museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Sommige stukken zijn vanaf de oprichting van het gebouw aanwezig in het bestuurscentrum terwijl de authentieke interieurs van de regentenkamers zelf ook een kunsthistorische waarde vertegenwoordigen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some pieces have been present in the management center since the building was founded, while the authentic interiors of the regent's chambers themselves also represent an art historical value.

facts.text: The collection was assembled within the former regent's chambers of a building named Wittenberg.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is bijeengebracht in de regentenkamers van gebouw Wittenberg, gelegen aan de Nieuwe Keizersgracht te Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She was brought together in the regent's chambers of building Wittenberg, located on the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam.

features.name: Gedenksteen
features.opening: The Gedenksteen for the former Detention Center, also known as Gedenksteen 4 May, is a work of art in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: The rough stone is split and offset, held together by a stainless steel anchor on a metal pole.
facts.sourceQuote: Zaanen ontwierp een zwerfkei, die in twee delen gespleten is en waarvan de twee delen ten opzichte van elkaar verschoven zijn. De twee delen worden bijeengehouden door een roestvast stalen verankering. Het geheel staat op een metalen paaltje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Zaanen designed a wandering stone, which is split into two parts and whose two parts are offset from each other. The two parts are held together by a stainless steel anchor. The whole thing is mounted on a metal pole.

features.name: New Church
features.opening: The Nieuwe Kerk (Dutch: [ˈniu.ə ˈkɛr(ə)k], lit.

facts.text: Construction started in 1380 and finished just twenty-eight years later in 1408.
facts.sourceQuote: Construction began in 1380 and finished in 1408.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 1380 and finished in 1408.

facts.text: Ownership transferred to a cultural foundation in 1979 to save money on expensive maintenance.
facts.sourceQuote: The second renovation proved expensive for the Dutch Reformed Church, forcing the church to be closed most of the time in order to save money on maintenance. To keep the church open, ownership was transferred in 1979 to a newly formed cultural foundation called the Nationale Stichting De Nieuwe Kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The second renovation proved expensive for the Dutch Reformed Church, forcing the church to be closed most of the time in order to save money on maintenance. To keep the church open, ownership was transferred in 1979 to a newly formed cultural foundation called the Nationale Stichting De Nieuwe Kerk.

facts.text: Dutch naval heroes like Admiral Michiel de Ruyter rest within its walls.
facts.sourceQuote: The Nieuwe Kerk is a burial site for Dutch naval heroes, including Admiral Michiel de Ruyter, Commodore Jan van Galen, and lieutenant commander Jan van Speyk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Nieuwe Kerk is a burial site for Dutch naval heroes, including Admiral Michiel de Ruyter, Commodore Jan van Galen, and lieutenant commander Jan van Speyk.

features.name: Weepers' Tower
features.opening: The Schreierstoren (English incorrectly translated as: Weeper's Tower or Tower of Tears), originally part of the medieval city wall of Amsterdam, the…

facts.text: A 1569 tablet inside the tower commemorates a woman who went insane after her husband left.
facts.sourceQuote: This confusion was further supported by the "memory tablet" in the tower, dating back to 1569, which "commemorates" a woman who was so "heart-grieved" at the departure of her husband, that she went insane.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This confusion was further supported by the "memory tablet" in the tower, dating back to 1569, which "commemorates" a woman who was so "heart-grieved" at the departure of her husband, that she went insane.

facts.text: Built as a defense structure in 1487, it now operates as a café and nautical bookstore.
facts.sourceQuote: It was built as a defense tower in 1487. It is currently a café and nautical bookstore.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built as a defense tower in 1487. It is currently a café and nautical bookstore.

features.name: Fusillade
features.opening: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis.

facts.text: On March 12, 1945, thirty political prisoners were executed here by the German army.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier fusilleerde het Duitse leger op 12 maart 1945 dertig politieke gevangenen als wraakactie voor een verzetsdaad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here, on March 12, 1945, the German army executed thirty political prisoners as a reprisal for a resistance act.

facts.text: The bronze statue was created in 1954 by sculptor Gerrit Bolhuis.
facts.sourceQuote: Fusillade, ook wel De gevallen hoornblazer, is een bronzen beeld aan het Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, in 1954 gemaakt door Gerrit Bolhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Fusillade, also known as The Fallen Hornblower, is a bronze statue in the Eerste Weteringplantsoen in Amsterdam, made in 1954 by Gerrit Bolhuis.

facts.text: SS Hauptscharführer Ernst Wehner was killed during the exchange of gunfire that followed the raid.
facts.sourceQuote: Er volgde een vuurgevecht, waarbij Ernst Wehner, Hauptscharführer van de SS, om het leven kwam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A firefight ensued, in which Ernst Wehner, Hauptscharführer of the SS, died.

features.name: Rembrandt House
features.opening: The Rembrandt House Museum (Dutch: Museum Het Rembrandthuis) is a museum located in a former house in the Jodenbreestraat, in the center of Amsterdam.

facts.text: A 1656 bankruptcy inventory allowed modern visitors to visualize his actual studio practice and daily life.
facts.sourceQuote: The building was redesigned in the 20th century on the basis of the inventory that was drawn up during Rembrandt's bankruptcy in 1656. This gives the visitor an idea of Rembrandt's daily life, his studio practice and what a private house and artist's studio looked like in the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was redesigned in the 20th century on the basis of the inventory that was drawn up during Rembrandt's bankruptcy in 1656. This gives the visitor an idea of Rembrandt's daily life, his studio practice and what a private house and artist's studio looked like in the 17th century.

facts.text: Around 1627, the building received an extra floor and a new facade with a triangular pediment.
facts.sourceQuote: The house was built around 1606 and was renovated around 1627, probably under the supervision of Jacob van Campen. It was then given an extra floor and a new facade with a triangular pediment.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was built around 1606 and was renovated around 1627, probably under the supervision of Jacob van Campen. It was then given an extra floor and a new facade with a triangular pediment.

features.name: Thorbecke statue
features.opening: The statue of Johan Rudolph Thorbecke, or Thorbecke monument, is a 19th-century memorial in Amsterdam to the liberal politician Thorbecke.

facts.text: A Scheveningen coachman who resembled Thorbecke served as the model for the statue.
facts.sourceQuote: De Haagse journalist Pieter Anne Haaxman schreef over het ontstaan van Leenhoff's Thorbeckebeeld in een terugblik dat een Scheveningse koetsier, die sprekend op Thorbecke leek, als model gefungeerd heeft.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hague journalist Pieter Anne Haaxman wrote about the origin of Leenhoff's Thorbecke statue in a retrospective that a Scheveningen coachman, who looked strikingly like Thorbecke, had served as a model.

facts.text: The figure leans on a Greek pillar with one hand while holding a law scroll in the other.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij leunt met zijn rechterhand op een Griekse zuil, symbool voor de democratie, en houdt in zijn linkerhand een wetsrol.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He leans on a Greek pillar, symbol of democracy, with his right hand, and holds a law scroll in his left hand.

facts.text: Inscriptions on the pedestal call him a true people's friend and loyal servant of the crown.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de sokkel zijn op de vier zijden opschriften aangebracht, waaronder OPRECHT VOLKSVRIEND, TROUWE DIENAAR der KROON, HERVORMER der STAATSREGELING
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal, inscriptions have been applied on all four sides, including TRUE PEOPLE'S FRIEND, LOYAL SERVANT of the CROWN, RESTORER of STATE GOVERNMENT

facts.text: A low wrought iron fence surrounds the entire area where the statue stands.
facts.sourceQuote: Het geheel wordt omgeven door een laag smeedijzeren hek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The entire area is surrounded by a low wrought iron fence.

features.name: Pathé de Munt
features.opening: Pathé de Munt is a large cinema in the center of Amsterdam of cinema operator Pathé.

facts.text: French architect Christian de Portzamparc collaborated on the modern building's design.
facts.sourceQuote: Het moderne gebouw werd ontworpen door Georges van Delft in samenwerking met Plan architekten en de Franse architect Christian de Portzamparc.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The modern building was designed by Georges van Delft in collaboration with Plan architects and the French architect Christian de Portzamparc.

facts.text: The venue spans three floors with 13 rooms and a total of 1829 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop heeft 13 zalen, verdeeld over drie verdiepingen, met in totaal 1829 stoelen; de grootste zaal telt 318 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has 13 rooms, spread over three floors, with a total of 1829 seats; the largest room has 318 seats.

features.name: Vrijheidscarillon
features.opening: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a clockwork toy that was manufactured in 1952 by the company A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee at the initiative of the…

facts.text: Bellringer Romke de Waard was the first to play the instrument after Queen Juliana activated it.
facts.sourceQuote: Koningin Juliana der Nederlanden zette het carillon elektronisch in werking; rechter en beiaardier Romke de Waard was de eerste die het carillon bespeelde, al dan niet begeleid door de Amsterdamse Politiekapel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Queen Juliana of the Netherlands put the carillon into electronic operation; right and bellringer Romke de Waard was the first to play the carillon, either accompanied by the Amsterdam Political Chapel or not.

facts.text: De Waard ended his inaugural performance with the Dutch national anthem, the Wilhelmus.
facts.sourceQuote: De Waard sloot zelf af met het Wilhelmus..
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Waard himself closed with the Wilhelmus..

features.name: Jewish Museum
features.opening: The Joods Museum (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌjoːts ɦɪsˈtoːris myˈzeːjʏm]; English: Jewish Museum), part of the Jewish Cultural Quarter, is a museum in Amsterdam…

facts.text: In 1989, the institution received the Council of Europe Museum Prize for its presentation and building appearance.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was recognized in 1989 when it received the Council of Europe Museum Prize, awarded for a combination of the presentation of the collection and the outward appearance of the buildings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was recognized in 1989 when it received the Council of Europe Museum Prize, awarded for a combination of the presentation of the collection and the outward appearance of the buildings.

features.name: Allard Pierson Museum
features.opening: The Allard Pierson Museum is the archaeological museum of the University of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Jan Lodewijk established the Allard Pierson Foundation in 1932 to make the antiquities available for research and teaching.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1932, Pierson's son Jan Lodewijk established the Allard Pierson Foundation in order to make the antiquities collection available for research and teaching.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1932, Pierson's son Jan Lodewijk established the Allard Pierson Foundation in order to make the antiquities collection available for research and teaching.

features.name: Ziggo Dome
features.opening: The Ziggo Dome (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈzɪɡoː doːm] or [ˈzɪɣoː doːm]) is an indoor arena in Amsterdam, Netherlands, located next to the Johan Cruijff Arena.

facts.text: Despite its name, the structure contains no actual round shapes or domes.
facts.sourceQuote: Although the name 'Dome' refers to a dome, there are no round shapes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the name 'Dome' refers to a dome, there are no round shapes.

facts.text: The venue hosted WWE house shows in May 2018 and November 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: On 18 May 2018, and 12 November 2019, American professional wrestling promotion WWE held two house shows at the Ziggo Dome, of which the first being a SmackDown Live house show.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 18 May 2018, and 12 November 2019, American professional wrestling promotion WWE held two house shows at the Ziggo Dome, of which the first being a SmackDown Live house show.

facts.text: Porcupine Tree's 2022 reunion show was released as a live album nearly a year later.
facts.sourceQuote: Porcupine Tree's reunion tour show at the Ziggo Dome on 7 November 2022 was released as a live album, Closure/Continuation.Live, on 8 December 2023.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Porcupine Tree's reunion tour show at the Ziggo Dome on 7 November 2022 was released as a live album, Closure/Continuation.Live, on 8 December 2023.

features.name: Amsterdam Pipe Museum
features.opening: The Amsterdam Pipe Museum (formerly Dutch: Pijpenkabinet, "pipe cabinet") is a museum in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, dedicated to smoking pipes, tobacco, and…

facts.text: The venue was formerly known by its Dutch name Pijpenkabinet, meaning pipe cabinet.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam Pipe Museum (formerly Dutch: Pijpenkabinet, "pipe cabinet") is a museum in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, dedicated to smoking pipes, tobacco, and related paraphernalia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam Pipe Museum (formerly Dutch: Pijpenkabinet, "pipe cabinet") is a museum in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, dedicated to smoking pipes, tobacco, and related paraphernalia.

features.name: Funerary museum
features.opening: The Nederlands Uitvaart Museum Tot Zover (Dutch Funeral Museum So Far) is a museum in Amsterdam, Netherlands that displays the various funerary practices of…

facts.text: The original caretaker residence was designed by Adriaan Willem Weissman, the architect behind Amsterdam's Stedelijk Museum.
facts.sourceQuote: The original building was designed as a caretaker’s residence by Adriaan Willem Weissman (1858–1923), who was a Dutch city architect best known for designing the Stedelijk Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original building was designed as a caretaker’s residence by Adriaan Willem Weissman (1858–1923), who was a Dutch city architect best known for designing the Stedelijk Museum.

features.name: Jewish WW2 resistance memorial
features.opening: The Monument to Jewish Resistance 1940-1945 is a monument in Amsterdam that has stood on the corner of the Amstel and the Zwanenburgwal, on the side of the…

facts.text: Stonemason Joseph Glatt, who specialized in Jewish gravestones, crafted the monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het verzetsmonument is het werk van de steenhouwer/steenhouwerij Joseph Glatt aan de Putseweg 21-23 te Putte, die gespecialiseerd was in Joodse grafstenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The resistance monument is the work of the stonemason/stonyware Joseph Glatt at Putseweg 21-23 in Putte, who specialized in Jewish gravestones.

facts.text: Since 1992, this site has hosted the annual Kristallnacht commemoration.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1992 is de locatie van het monument (bij het Amsterdamse stadhuis) de centrale plek voor de jaarlijkse Kristallnachtherdenking.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1992, the location of the monument (at the Amsterdam City Hall) has been the central place for the annual Kristallnacht commemoration.

features.name: Levensboom
features.opening: The Tree of Life, Monument of Awareness (Bon Fu Gron Prakseri) is a monument located at Surinameplein in Amsterdam-West, commemorating the history of slavery,…

facts.text: Journalist Roy Ristie helped initiate the annual June 30 ceremony that led to this site's creation.
facts.sourceQuote: One of the initiators was journalist and broadcaster Roy Ristie from the Comité 30 juni/1 juli in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the initiators was journalist and broadcaster Roy Ristie from the Comité 30 juni/1 juli in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Organizers split the commemoration into a day of reflection on June 30 and celebration on July 1.
facts.sourceQuote: The committee, in line with the Comité 4 and 5 May, chose June 30 as a day of reflection and July 1 as a day of celebration.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The committee, in line with the Comité 4 and 5 May, chose June 30 as a day of reflection and July 1 as a day of celebration.

facts.text: The trunk represents ethnic diversity while the foliage symbolizes interconnected countries.
facts.sourceQuote: The trunk of the tree represents the ethnic diversity of the community, and the foliage symbolizes the respective countries and their interconnectedness.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The trunk of the tree represents the ethnic diversity of the community, and the foliage symbolizes the respective countries and their interconnectedness.

facts.text: On Day of Awareness, two minutes of silence are observed with speeches and wreaths.
facts.sourceQuote: On the Day of Awareness, two minutes of silence are observed, speeches are given, and wreaths are laid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the Day of Awareness, two minutes of silence are observed, speeches are given, and wreaths are laid.

features.name: Het Nieuwe Verbond
features.opening: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Lourdes church, today the Church of Het Nieuwe Verbond, is a Roman Catholic church in the garden city Slotermeer in Amsterdam…

facts.text: A planned tower was cancelled because the parish could not afford an extra 100,000 guilders.
facts.sourceQuote: Granpré Molière had aanvankelijk ook een kerktoren ingetekend; echter, de financiële situatie van de parochie was onvoldoende om nog extra circa 100.000 gulden vrij te maken. De kerkgemeente hoopte op extra bijdragen als gevolg van een Lourdesjaar, maar de toren zou er nooit komen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Granpré Molière had also initially drawn up a church tower; however, the financial situation of the parish was insufficient to free up an additional approximately 100,000 guilders. The church community hoped for additional contributions as a result of a Lourdes year, but the tower would never come.

facts.text: The original church on Jacob Catskade was later used by Portuguese-speaking Catholics starting in 1989.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze driebeukige hallenkerk is gebouwd voor de parochie met dezelfde naam, ter vervanging van de eerdere kerk met die naam aan de Jacob Catskade in de Frederik Hendrikbuurt (Oud-West). De in 1957 verlaten kerk aan de Jacob Catskade wordt, na verschillende andere bestemmingen, sinds 1989 gebruikt door portugeestalige katholieken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This three-bay hall church was built for the parish with the same name, to replace the earlier church with that name on Jacob Catskade in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt (Oud-West). The church abandoned in 1957 on Jacob Catskade is, after several other destinations, used by Portuguese-speaking Catholics since 1989.

facts.text: Het Nieuwe Verbond is the Dutch name for The New Covenant, adopted after a 1993 parish merger.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze parochie is voorjaar 1993 gefuseerd met twee andere: de Sint-Catharinakerk en de Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Zeven Smarten aan de Aalbersestraat in Geuzenveld. De gefuseerde parochie kreeg de naam Het Nieuwe Verbond. Later kreeg ook de kerk de naam Het Nieuwe Verbond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This parish was merged in spring 1993 with two others: the Sint-Catharinakerk and the Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Zeven Smarten on the Aalbersestraat in Geuzenveld. The merged parish was named Het Nieuwe Verbond. Later the church also got the name Het Nieuwe Verbond.

features.name: 1936-1939 No Pasaran
features.opening: The Spanjemonument is an artistic work and war memorial in Amsterdam-Noord.

facts.text: The statue was originally rejected for a swampy square before being installed at an unnamed parking lot near the IJtunnel.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld zou oorspronkelijk in 1985 met een bijdrage van Provinciale Staten Noord-Holland geplaatst worden op het marktplein van het Buikslotermeerplein, maar dat werd te druk bevonden. Bovendien waren er problemen omtrent de fundering van het beeld in de aldaar drassige bodem. Roos en Van Weerden gingen er zelf op uit om een nieuwe plek te vinden die geschikter was en vonden die bij een naamloze parkeerplaats naast het IJtunnel-traject aan het Hagedoornplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue was originally to be placed in 1985 on the market square of the Buikslotermeerplein with a contribution from the Provincial States of North Holland, but it was found too crowded. In addition, there were problems regarding the foundation of the statue in the swampy soil there. Roos and Van Weerden set out on their own to find a new place that was more suitable and found it at an unnamed parking space next to the IJtunnel route on Hagedoornplein.

facts.text: Three columns of text flank the image, with two written in Dutch and one in Spanish.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld wordt buiten de perkjes vergezeld door een drietal zuilen met de tekst (2x in Nederlands, 1x in Spaans): 1936-1939 No PasaranAan de Nederlandse mannen en vrouwen die in de Spaanseburgeroorlog meevochten en sneuvelden in de strijd tegen het fascisme.Hun houding van waakzaamheid en verzet, waarschuwingtegen iedere vorm van fascisme voor mensen van vandaag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Outside the enclosures, the image is accompanied by three columns with the text (2x in Dutch, 1x in Spanish): 1936-1939 No Pasaran To the Dutch men and women who fought and died in the Spanish Civil War in the struggle against fascism. Their attitude of vigilance and resistance, warning against any form of fascism for people today.

features.name: Amsterdam Tulip Museum
features.opening: Amsterdam Tulip Museum (2004) ATM is a small museum in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Three Dutch bulbmen founded the museum, including a US distributor and a European supplier.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was started by three Dutch bulbsmen. One of the museum's founders is a wholesale flowerbulb distributor in the United States, Colorblends Bridgeport. One of the other founders is Fluwel, a European bulb supplier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was started by three Dutch bulbsmen. One of the museum's founders is a wholesale flowerbulb distributor in the United States, Colorblends Bridgeport. One of the other founders is Fluwel, a European bulb supplier.

facts.text: Exhibits trace tulip history from the Himalayas to the court of Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent.
facts.sourceQuote: It has 2,200 sq ft (200 m2) of floor space and the exhibits in the museum trace the history of the tulip from its origins in the Himalayas to its arrival in the court of the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent (1494-1566).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has 2,200 sq ft (200 m2) of floor space and the exhibits in the museum trace the history of the tulip from its origins in the Himalayas to its arrival in the court of the Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent (1494-1566).

facts.text: The collection explores the infamous 1630s market crash known as Tulip mania.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum features an exhibit which explores the famous Tulip mania of the 1630s. The tumultuous Tulip trade led to one of history’s most infamous market crashes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum features an exhibit which explores the famous Tulip mania of the 1630s. The tumultuous Tulip trade led to one of history’s most infamous market crashes.

features.name: Royal Palace
features.opening: The Royal Palace of Amsterdam in Amsterdam (Dutch: Koninklijk Paleis van Amsterdam or Paleis op de Dam) is one of three palaces in the Netherlands which are at…

facts.text: The yellowish sandstone has darkened significantly over time.
facts.sourceQuote: The sandstone of yellowish hue has darkened considerably in the course of time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sandstone of yellowish hue has darkened considerably in the course of time.

facts.text: Originally built as a city hall in the mid-seventeenth century, it became a royal palace in 1808.
facts.sourceQuote: The palace was originally built in the mid-seventeenth century as the new city hall for the city of Amsterdam, and only became a royal palace in 1808 when the Netherlands were part of the First French Republic and First Empire under Napoleon Bonaparte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was originally built in the mid-seventeenth century as the new city hall for the city of Amsterdam, and only became a royal palace in 1808 when the Netherlands were part of the First French Republic and First Empire under Napoleon Bonaparte.

features.name: Sloterkerk
features.opening: The Sloterkerk is a Protestant church in Sloten, North Holland.

facts.text: A second church stood here until Gueux forces destroyed it during the 1573 Siege of Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuote: De tweede Sloterkerk werd in 1573 door de Geuzen grotendeels werd verwoest tijdens het Beleg van Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The second Sloterkerk was largely destroyed by the Gueux in 1573 during the Siege of Haarlem.

facts.text: The large clock inside dates to 1516 and was cast by brothers who also made Amsterdam's Zuiderkerk tower clock.
facts.sourceQuote: De grote klok dateert uit 1516 en is gegoten door de gebroeders klokgieters Willem en Jaspar Moer (die ook verantwoordelijk waren voor de grootste klok in de Amsterdamse Zuiderkerkstoren).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The large clock dates back to 1516 and was cast by the clockmakers brothers Willem and Jaspar Moer (who were also responsible for the largest clock in the Amsterdam Zuiderkerkstoren).

facts.text: Hermanus Knipscheer II built the organ in 1851.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel is in 1851 gebouwd door Hermanus Knipscheer (II) .
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ was built in 1851 by Hermanus Knipscheer (II).

facts.text: Falling debris during a 1964 tower restoration damaged the instrument.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de restauratie van de kerktoren in 1964 is, door vallend puin, het orgel beschadigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the restoration of the church tower in 1964, the organ was damaged by falling debris.

facts.text: The manual includes a Cornet V forte stop and a Mixture III-V forte.
facts.sourceQuote: Dispositie: Manuaal: Prestant 8', Bourdon 8', Gemshoorn 8', Viool à di Gamba 8', Octaaf 4', Octaaf 2', Cornet V sterk (discant), Mixtuur III-V sterk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instrumentation: Manual: Prestant 8', Bourdon 8', Gemshoorn 8', Violin à di Gamba 8', Octave 4', Octave 2', Cornet V forte (discant), Mixture III-V forte.

facts.text: A comprehensive overhaul of the organ occurred in 2007 by Firma Flentrop.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007 integrale revisie door Firma Flentrop in Zaandam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007, comprehensive overhaul by Firma Flentrop in Zaandam.

features.name: Gemeenlandshuis
features.opening: The Gemeenlandshuis of Diemen stands at Diemerzeedijk 27 in Amsterdam-Oost.

facts.text: The name Gemeenlandshuis literally means "communal house," reflecting its original purpose.
facts.sourceQuote: Zoals de naam al doet vermoeden was het van oorsprong een gemeenlandshuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As the name suggests, it was originally a communal house.

facts.text: Carpenter master Cornelis van der Does designed this structure, which was completed in 1727.
facts.sourceQuote: Het rechthoekige vrijstaande gebouw werd aan de zeedijk opgetrokken naar ontwerp van timmermansbaas Cornelis van der Does en opgeleverd in 1727, eigenlijk als vergaderlocatie en uitvalsbasis bij dijkbewaking.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The rectangular detached building was built on the seafront according to the design of carpenter master Cornelis van der Does and completed in 1727, actually as a meeting location and base for dyke monitoring.

facts.text: A coat of arms stone from the abandoned 1609 Herberg Daer de Jaeger Uuythangt remains in the facade.
facts.sourceQuote: In de gevel is in een wapensteen een restant terug te vinden dat overgekomen is uit het toen afgedankte Herberg Daer de Jaeger Uuythangt uit 1609, dat tevens diende tot gemeenlandshuis, maar toen plaats moest maken voor dit gebouw, daar men een luxere uitstraling wilde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the facade, a remnant can be found in a coat of arms stone that has survived from the then abandoned Herberg Daer de Jaeger Uuythangt from 1609, which also served as a common house, but then had to make way for this building, as people wanted a more luxurious appearance.

features.name: Sint Olofskapel
features.opening: The Sint-Olofkapel, or Oudezijds Kapel, is a building in the Dutch city of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Sint Olofskapel honors Olaf II, a Norwegian king and patron saint of sailors.
facts.sourceQuote: De kapel is gewijd aan Sint-Olof (Olaf II), de patroonheilige der zeevaarders, die tevens koning van Noorwegen was en het christendom in dat land had verspreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel is dedicated to Sint-Olof (Olaf II), the patron saint of sailors, who was also king of Norway and had spread Christianity in that country.

facts.text: Poet Vondel praised the chapel in his 1655 poem for the new town hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Niet alleen in de geschiedenisboeken uit de Gouden Eeuw staat dit expliciet vermeld, ook Vondel maakte er gewag van in zijn gedicht voor het nieuwe stadhuis in 1655 (Daer d’Aemstelheer, van outs, de zeekapelle wydde, Ter eere van Godts Helt, Sint Olof, die zijn’ troon in ’t Noorden had gebouwt, en wien de martelkroon met recht wert toegekeurt).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This is explicitly mentioned not only in the history books of the Golden Age, but Vondel also made mention of it in his poem for the new town hall in 1655 (Daer d'Aemstelheer, van outs, de zeekapelle wydde, Ter eere van Godts Helt, Sint Olof, die zijn' troon in 't Noorden had gebouwd, en wien de martelkroon met recht waard toegekeurd).

facts.text: The current three-aisled structure dates from an enlargement completed in 1644.
facts.sourceQuote: De vergroting van de kapel in 1644 leverde het huidige gebouw op, een driebeukige kerk met een niet geheel symmetrische plattegrond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The enlargement of the chapel in 1644 resulted in the current building, a three-aisled church with an not entirely symmetrical floor plan.

facts.text: The municipality bought the ruin in 1991 for a symbolic gold coin to begin restoration.
facts.sourceQuote: Redding kwam in 1991 toen de gemeente de kapel kocht voor een symbolische gulden en het in erfpacht met restauratieverplichting aan de Stichting Restauratie Monumenten gaf, die op haar beurt een gebruiksovereenstemming na voltooiing sloot met het Barbizonhotel van de NH Hotel Group.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Rescue came in 1991 when the municipality bought the chapel for a symbolic gold and gave it on lease with a restoration obligation to the Foundation for the Restoration of Monuments, which in turn concluded a use agreement after completion with the Barbizonhotel of the NH Hotel Group.

facts.text: Architect Boudewijn de Court Onderwater died during the chapel's restoration work.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de restauratie overleed een van de architecten: Boudewijn de Court Onderwater. Ter gedachtenis is bijgaande gevelsteen geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the restoration, one of the architects died: Boudewijn de Court Onderwater. A commemorative plaque has been placed attached.

features.name: H'ART Museum
features.opening: H'ART Museum is an art museum located on the banks of the Amstel river in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Russian President Dmitry Medvedev helped open the museum alongside Queen Beatrix in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: On 20 June 2009, the museum was opened by Dutch Queen Beatrix and Russian president Dmitry Medvedev.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 20 June 2009, the museum was opened by Dutch Queen Beatrix and Russian president Dmitry Medvedev.

facts.text: The institution changed its name to H'ART Museum in September 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum changed its name to the H'ART Museum from 1 September 2023.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum changed its name to the H'ART Museum from 1 September 2023.

features.name: Shadow quay
features.opening: De Schaduwkade is a monument to two hundred Jewish residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam who were murdered in the Second World War.

facts.text: Twelve local residents initiated the monument after discovering plaques for the murdered Kok family in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: De oprichting van het monument was een initiatief van twaalf bewoners van de Nieuwe Keizersgracht. Aanleiding was de onthulling in 2009 van enkele plaquettes op nummer 24 ter herdenking van leden van de vermoorde familie Kok.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The establishment of the monument was an initiative of twelve residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. The reason was the revelation in 2009 of several plaques on number 24 in memory of members of the murdered Kok family.

facts.text: Two hundred Jewish residents of Nieuwe Keizersgracht were murdered during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: De Schaduwkade is een monument voor tweehonderd Joodse bewoners van de Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog vermoord zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Schaduwkade is a monument to two hundred Jewish residents of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht in Amsterdam who were murdered in World War II.

facts.text: The memorial features two hundred metal plaques bearing the names of those victims.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat uit tweehonderd metalen bordjes met de namen van de bewoners, gegroepeerd rond het huisnummer van het huis waar ze woonden aan de overkant van het water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of two hundred metal plaques with the names of the residents, grouped around the house number of the house where they lived across the water.

facts.text: Plaques are grouped around the house number of the residence where each person lived across the water.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat uit tweehonderd metalen bordjes met de namen van de bewoners, gegroepeerd rond het huisnummer van het huis waar ze woonden aan de overkant van het water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of two hundred metal plaques with the names of the residents, grouped around the house number of the house where they lived across the water.

features.name: Huis van de wijk Lydia
features.opening: Huize Lydia or Buurthuis Lydia is a multifunctional center located at the corner of Roelof Hartplein, Joh.

facts.text: The original construction between 1924 and 1927 included 158 sleeping quarters for women and girls.
facts.sourceQuote: Het pand werd gebouwd tussen 1924 en 1927 als tehuis voor vrouwen en meisjes in opdracht van de 'Afdeeling Amsterdam der Roomsch-Katholieke Internationale Vereeniging tot bescherming van Meisjes', en bevat 158 slaapvertrekken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was built between 1924 and 1927 as a home for women and girls commissioned by the 'Amsterdam Department of the Roman Catholic International Association for the Protection of Girls', and contains 158 sleeping quarters.

facts.text: The Amsterdam chess club Caïssa maintains its dedicated playing room within this building.
facts.sourceQuote: De Amsterdamse schaakvereniging Caïssa heeft haar speellokaal in Huize Lydia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam chess club Caïssa has its playing room in Huize Lydia.

facts.text: Jan Boterenbrood designed the U-shaped structure in the Amsterdam School style.
facts.sourceQuote: Het U-vormige gebouw is ontworpen door architect Jan Boterenbrood en gebouwd in de stijl van de Amsterdamse school.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The U-shaped building was designed by architect Jan Boterenbrood and built in the style of the Amsterdam School.

features.name: Olympiahuis
features.opening: The Olympic House (the house on Stadionplein nr. 18), also known as the Gatekeeper's House, or Northern Service House, is a former gatekeeper's house on the…

facts.text: Demolition threats in the early 2000s forced the cottage to be moved just a few meters.
facts.sourceQuote: Ondanks deze status werd het huisje in de jaren 2000 en 2001 bedreigd door sloopplannen. In verband met nieuwbouw van woningen in de omgeving werd het huisje in 2003 enige meters verplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Despite this status, the cottage was threatened by demolition plans in the 2000s and 2001. Due to the construction of new houses in the area, the cottage was moved a few meters in 2003.

facts.text: Special Olympic stamps were issued there from March to September 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: Ter gelegenheid van de Olympische Spelen werden van 27 maart tot en met 15 september 1928 de zogenaamde Olympiadezegels uitgegeven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the occasion of the Olympic Games, the so-called Olympic stamps were issued from March 27 to September 15, 1928.

facts.text: A temporary post office on the grounds applied a special stamp to these mail items.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze werden in het tijdelijke postkantoor op het Olympisch terrein afgestempeld met een speciaal stempel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These were stamped with a special stamp at the temporary post office on the Olympic grounds.

features.name: Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten
features.opening: The Royal Academy of Fine Arts (also Royal Academy of Fine Arts) in Amsterdam was the highest art training institution in the Kingdom of the Netherlands from…

facts.text: The Koninklijke Akademie was discontinued in 1870 and replaced by the Rijksakademie van beeldende kunsten.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1870 werd de Akademie opgeheven en vervangen door de Rijksakademie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1870, the Akademie was discontinued and replaced by the Rijksakademie.

facts.text: Jan Willem Pieneman served as the first director before becoming Rijksmuseum director in 1844.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste directeur van de Koninklijke Akademie was Jan Willem Pieneman, die later in 1844 directeur van het Rijksmuseum zou worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first director of the Koninklijke Akademie was Jan Willem Pieneman, who later became director of the Rijksmuseum in 1844.

features.name: Bellevue
features.opening: Theater Bellevue is a theater with three rooms on Leidsekade in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Writer Jacob van Lennep served as the first president of Sociëteit Bellevue.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste voorzitter van Sociëteit Bellevue was de schrijver Jacob van Lennep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first president of Sociëteit Bellevue was the writer Jacob van Lennep.

facts.text: The first seasons of the TV show Toppop were recorded here starting in September 1970.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier werden vanaf 22 september 1970 de eerste seizoenen van Toppop opgenomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From September 22, 1970, the first seasons of Toppop were recorded here.

facts.text: Lunch shows have been produced for the Paloni Hall for over 25 years.
facts.sourceQuote: Speciaal voor de Paloni Zaal worden al ruim 25 jaar lunchvoorstellingen geproduceerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Lunch shows have been produced specially for the Paloni Hall for more than 25 years.

facts.text: The annual Pop Arts Festival features puppet and object theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Samen met Ostade A'dam en Jeugdtheater De Krakeling organiseert Theater Bellevue het jaarlijkse Pop Arts Festival, een festival met een programmering van poppen- en objecttheater.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Together with Ostade A'dam and Youth Theater De Krakeling, Theater Bellevue organizes the annual Pop Arts Festival, a festival with a programming of puppet and object theater.

facts.text: Regular programs include the cabaret try-out stage BIES in Klein Bellevue.
facts.sourceQuote: Theater Bellevue brengt daarnaast een aantal regelmatig terugkerende programma's, zoals BIES (het cabaret try-out podium in Klein Bellevue), Fluisterende olifanten (talkshow door Theodor Holman en Gijs Groenteman in Klein Bellevue), Het Nieuwe Lied (Nederlandstalig muziekprogramma in Klein Bellevue), Nachtgasten (improvisatietheater in de Grote Zaal) en Tekstsmederij (nieuwe Nederlandse toneelteksten in de Grote Zaal).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Theater Bellevue also brings a number of regularly recurring programs, such as BIES (the cabaret try-out stage in Klein Bellevue), Whispering Elephants (talk show by Theodor Holman and Gijs Groenteman in Klein Bellevue), Het Nieuwe Lied (Dutch music program in Klein Bellevue), Nachtgasten (improvisational theater in the Great Hall) and Tekstsmederij (new Dutch stage texts in the Great Hall).

features.name: Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center
features.opening: The Sint-Lucaskerk is the former church building of the Roman Catholic Sint-Lucas parish in Amsterdam-Osdorp.

facts.text: The former church was declared a municipal monument in November 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: Naar aanleiding van een aanvraag van Heemschut werd het gebouw op 22 november 2017 gemeentelijk monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Following a request from Heemschut, the building was declared a municipal monument on November 22, 2017.

facts.text: Construction on the final building began in November 1963.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 4 november 1963 startte de bouw van het definitieve kerkgebouw van architect Th.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On November 4, 1963, construction began on the final church building by architect Th.

facts.text: Seats were arranged in three groups around the altar to encourage participation.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de inrichting van de kerk werd rekening gehouden met de nieuwe liturgie waarin de gemeenschap geen toeschouwer is van de liturgie, maar deelnemer. De zitplaatsen werden verdeeld in drie groepen die aan drie zijden van het altaar werden geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When designing the church, consideration was given to the new liturgy in which the community is not a spectator of the liturgy, but a participant. The seats were divided into three groups that were placed on three sides of the altar.

facts.text: The complex was sold to SGI Netherlands in March 2020 and renamed the Ikeda Friendship and Peace Center.
facts.sourceQuote: In maart 2020 is het complex verkocht aan de boeddhistische organisatie SGI Nederland, die het onder de benaming 'Ikeda Centrum voor Vriendschap en Vrede' gebruikt voor gebed en culturele activiteiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2020, the complex was sold to the Buddhist organization SGI Netherlands, which uses it under the name 'Ikeda Center for Friendship and Peace' for prayer and cultural activities.

facts.text: A formal online presentation occurred on May 2, 2021, following renovations completed during the pandemic.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 2 mei 2021 is het centrum na verbouwing formeel, in verband met de COVID-19-pandemie, online gepresenteerd aan de leden van de organisatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 2, 2021, the center was formally presented online to the members of the organization after renovation, in connection with the COVID-19 pandemic.

facts.text: While the parish section opened online in October 2021, the entire complex received its physical inauguration in June 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: De opening van het parrochiegedeelte is online gehouden op 10 oktober 2021, terwijl het gehele complex fysiek ingehuldigd is in juni 2022.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The opening of the parish section was held online on October 10, 2021, while the entire complex was physically inaugurated in June 2022.

features.name: Mahatma Gandhi
features.opening: Mahatma Gandhi is a work of art in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Vandals have repeatedly broken off the statue's fragile walking stick and glasses.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld kent in de wandelstaf en bril twee fragiele onderdelen, die keer op keer door vandalen afgebroken en verwijderd werden en worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image has two fragile parts in the walking stick and glasses, which have been broken and removed by vandals again and again and continue to be.

features.name: Groote Museum
features.opening: The Groote Museum is a museum on the Plantage Middenlaan in Amsterdam exploring the connections between people, animals, plants, microbes and the earth.

facts.text: The collection moved to Naturalis in Leiden after the museum closed in 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1947 werd het museum gesloten en de collectie overgebracht naar Naturalis in Leiden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1947 the museum was closed and the collection transferred to Naturalis in Leiden.

facts.text: A major restoration between 2012 and 2022 prepared the vacant building for its return.
facts.sourceQuote: Na een langdurige periode van verval en leegstand onderging het gebouw tussen 2012 en 2022 een grondige restauratie, waardoor het geschikt werd gemaakt voor een nieuwe bestemming.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After a long period of decay and vacancy, the building underwent a thorough restoration between 2012 and 2022, making it suitable for a new purpose.

facts.text: Queen Máxima officially reopened the restored museum on May 10, 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 10 mei 2022 werd het museum officieel heropend door Koningin Máxima.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 10, 2022, the museum was officially reopened by Queen Máxima.

facts.text: Visitors can enter the Groote Museum without needing a zoo ticket.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is gevestigd op de eerste verdieping van het voormalig hoofdgebouw van Artis en wordt beheerd door Artis, maar is onafhankelijk van de dierentuin te bezoeken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is located on the first floor of the former main building of Artis and is managed by Artis, but can be visited independently of the zoo.

features.name: Maarten Lutherkerk
features.opening: The Maarten Luther Kerk is a church building in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Architect F Jantzen designed this structure for the Evangelical-Lutheran church.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit kerkgebouw is voor de Evangelisch-Lutherse kerk in de bouwstijl van de Amsterdamse School ontworpen door de architect F Jantzen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This church building was designed for the Evangelical-Lutheran church in the style of the Amsterdam School by the architect F Jantzen.

features.name: Zeeburgia
features.opening: The Amsterdamse Voetbalvereniging Zeeburgia is a football club from Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: In August 1956, Zeeburgia lost a cup match 6–1 to Ajax.
facts.sourceQuote: On 26 August 1956 it lost 6–1 to Ajax in the first round of the 1956–57 National Dutch Cup.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 26 August 1956 it lost 6–1 to Ajax in the first round of the 1956–57 National Dutch Cup.

facts.text: Zeeburgia played in the Hoofdklasse from 1980 through 1984.
facts.sourceQuote: From 1980 through 1984, the male first squad played in the Hoofdklasse.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1980 through 1984, the male first squad played in the Hoofdklasse.

facts.text: Many Dutch professional footballers began their careers in Zeeburgia's youth teams.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been dubbed "royal supplier" as many Dutch professional footballers started at Zeeburgia youth teams.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been dubbed "royal supplier" as many Dutch professional footballers started at Zeeburgia youth teams.

features.name: Vincentiuskerk
features.opening: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West.

facts.text: Architect Christianus Petrus Wilhelmus Dessing designed the neo-Gothic structure for this residential area.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect Christianus Petrus Wilhelmus Dessing ontwierp voor deze toen pas ingerichte woonwijk een neogotische kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Architect Christianus Petrus Wilhelmus Dessing designed a neo-Gothic church for this then newly furnished residential area.

features.name: Torture Museum
features.opening: The Torture Museum, Amsterdam is located in Amsterdam, near the Bloemenmarkt overlooking the Singel.

facts.text: Many displayed items like iron maidens are literary inventions from the 19th century rather than real historical tools.
