features.opening: Amsterdam Centraal station (Dutch: Station Amsterdam Centraal, lit.

facts.text: A pedestrian tunnel connecting the station to the road vanished when a metro tunnel was built in the late 1970s.
facts.sourceQuote: With the construction of the metro tunnel in the late 1970s, both the pedestrian tunnel and the road in front of the station disappeared.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the construction of the metro tunnel in the late 1970s, both the pedestrian tunnel and the road in front of the station disappeared.

facts.text: In 1996, a third central roof designed by Jan Garvelink covered all platforms for the first time.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1996, a third, 'centre roof' designed by Jan Garvelink, architect at Holland Rail Consult, was built between the two existing roofs, whereby all platforms at the station were now covered.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1996, a third, 'centre roof' designed by Jan Garvelink, architect at Holland Rail Consult, was built between the two existing roofs, whereby all platforms at the station were now covered.

facts.text: Contractor Philipp Holzmann built the station while architect Pierre Cuypers focused on decoration.
facts.sourceQuote: While Cuypers was the principal architect, it is believed that he focused mostly on the decoration of the station building and left the structural design to railway engineers. The station was built by contractor Philipp Holzmann.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: While Cuypers was the principal architect, it is believed that he focused mostly on the decoration of the station building and left the structural design to railway engineers. The station was built by contractor Philipp Holzmann.

facts.text: The new central station replaced Amsterdam Willemspoort Station which closed in 1878.
facts.sourceQuote: The new central station replaced Amsterdam Willemspoort Station, which had closed in 1878, as well as the temporary Westerdok Station used from 1878 to 1889.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The new central station replaced Amsterdam Willemspoort Station, which had closed in 1878, as well as the temporary Westerdok Station used from 1878 to 1889.

facts.text: A royal waiting room for the Dutch monarchy was included in the original design.
facts.sourceQuote: A royal waiting room for the Dutch monarchy (one of three in active use in the country today) was also included in the design.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A royal waiting room for the Dutch monarchy (one of three in active use in the country today) was also included in the design.

features.name: Petruskerk
features.opening: The Petruskerk is a Protestant church in the former village of Sloterdijk, now part of Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: After Protestant services began in 1578, the church was renamed Petruskerk.
facts.sourceQuote: Na provisorisch herstel worden er vanaf de alteratie van 1578 voortaan Protestantse diensten gehouden en de kerk werd omgedoopt in Petruskerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After provisional restoration, Protestant services were held from the alteration of 1578 onwards and the church was renamed Petruskerk.

facts.text: The Geuzen destroyed the original church in 1572 following a failed attack on Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Na een mislukte aanval op van Amsterdam door geuzenaanvoerder Lumey werd de kerk in 1572 verwoest door de Geuzen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After a failed attack on Amsterdam by the leader of the Geuzen, Lumey, the church was destroyed by the Geuzen in 1572.

facts.text: Lord Cornelis de Graeff strongly supported the 1663 rebuilding initiative of priest Jan Claesz van Dijk.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1663 werd de Petruskerk op het initiatief van de kerkmeester Jan Claesz van Dijk, krachtig gesteund door de ambachtsheer van Sloterdijk, Cornelis de Graeff, herbouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1663, the Petruskerk was rebuilt at the initiative of the parish priest Jan Claesz van Dijk, strongly supported by the lord of Sloterdijk, Cornelis de Graeff.

facts.text: In 1979 the historic building was listed as a monument after being sold to a preservation foundation.
facts.sourceQuote: De in verval geraakte kerk werd in 1968 gesloten en in 1978 verkocht aan de 'Stichting tot Behoud van de Petruskerk en omgeving Oud Sloterdijk'. In 1979 werd de kerk op de monumentenlijst geplaatst, waarna tussen 1980 en 1992 restauratie kon plaatsvinden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The dilapidated church was closed in 1968 and sold in 1978 to the 'Stichting tot Behoud van de Petruskerk en omgeving Oud Sloterdijk'. In 1979 the church was placed on the list of monuments, after which restoration could take place between 1980 and 1992.

features.name: Monument Indië-Nederland
features.opening: The Monument Indië-Nederland is located near the Olympiaplein in the southern part of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Funds remaining after a mausoleum's completion paid for this monument in Amsterdam and another in Batavia.
facts.sourceQuote: After the mausoleum was completed, there was still a bit of the collected money left, with which the committee responsible for its construction decided to build two more monuments to him, one in Batavia and the other in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the mausoleum was completed, there was still a bit of the collected money left, with which the committee responsible for its construction decided to build two more monuments to him, one in Batavia and the other in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Architect Gijsbert Friedhoff and sculptor Frits van Hall won the contest to design this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: This contest was won by the architect Gijsbert Friedhoff and the sculptor Frits van Hall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This contest was won by the architect Gijsbert Friedhoff and the sculptor Frits van Hall.

facts.text: A female figure flanked by two lions symbolizes Dutch supremacy over conquered peoples of the East Indies.
facts.sourceQuote: The monument consists of a female character with a lion on each side, meant to symbolise Dutch supremacy over the conquered people of the Dutch East Indies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument consists of a female character with a lion on each side, meant to symbolise Dutch supremacy over the conquered people of the Dutch East Indies.

facts.text: Political pressure forced a name change to Monument Indië-Nederland in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: Because of political pressure the name was changed in 2004 to Monument Indië-Nederland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because of political pressure the name was changed in 2004 to Monument Indië-Nederland.

features.name: Science Park Amsterdam
features.opening: Amsterdam Science Park is a science park in the Oost borough of Amsterdam, Netherlands with focus on physics, mathematics, information technology and the life…

facts.text: Amsterdam Science Park railway station opened in 2009 under mayor Job Cohen.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2009, the Amsterdam Science Park railway station was opened by then-mayor Job Cohen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2009, the Amsterdam Science Park railway station was opened by then-mayor Job Cohen.

facts.text: Three Amsterdam Internet Exchange colocations reside here at SURFsara, NIKHEF, and Equinix-AM3.
facts.sourceQuote: Three of the colocations of the Amsterdam Internet Exchange are at the institutes SURFsara, NIKHEF, and Equinix-AM3 at the science park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three of the colocations of the Amsterdam Internet Exchange are at the institutes SURFsara, NIKHEF, and Equinix-AM3 at the science park.

features.name: Molen van Sloten
features.opening: The Molen van Sloten is a polder mill in the village of Sloten near Amsterdam.

facts.text: Built in 1991, it reuses a hull from 1847 originally located in Watergraafsmeer.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze molen is gebouwd in 1991 met gebruikmaking van een uit 1847 daterende molenromp afkomstig uit de Watergraafsmeer, die werd geplaatst op een nieuwe bakstenen onderbouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This mill was built in 1991 using a mill hull dating back to 1847 from Watergraafsmeer, which was placed on a new brick base.

facts.text: An attic display presents Rembrandt images and portraits of his characters.
facts.sourceQuote: In de molen is veel te zien over de molentechniek en de geschiedenis van Sloten en Oud Osdorp, maar er is ook een presentatie Rembrandt op zolder, met daarin wassen beelden van Rembrandt en diverse van zijn personages.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the mill there is much to see about milling technology and the history of Sloten and Oud Osdorp, but there is also a Rembrandt presentation on the attic, with washing images of Rembrandt and various of his characters.

facts.text: A glassmaking museum opened here in April 2005 but closed permanently in 2020.
facts.sourceQuote: In april 2005 werd het complex uitgebreid met een Kuiperijmuseum, waarin veel te zien was over het oude ambacht van de kuiperij. Het Kuiperijmuseum is in 2020 gesloten en ontruimd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In April 2005, the complex was expanded with a Kuiperij museum, in which there was much to see about the old craft of glassmaking. The Kuiperij Museum was closed and evacuated in 2020.

facts.text: Carpentry artifacts from this site were relocated to the Brabants Museum Oud-Oosterhout.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorwerpen die betrekking hebben op het kuipersambacht zijn verhuisd naar het Brabants Museum Oud-Oosterhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The objects related to the carpentry trade have been moved to the Brabants Museum Oud-Oosterhout.

features.name: Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt
features.opening: The Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt is a tower fort in Weesp in the province of North Holland.

facts.text: The moat was filled in 1876 to better protect the fort from newer, heavier cannons.
facts.sourceQuote: Om het fort beter te beschermen tegen nieuwe, zwaardere en trefzekerder kanonnen werd in 1876 de gracht gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1876, the moat was filled in to better protect the fort from new, heavier and more accurate cannons.

facts.text: Workers excavated the earthen embankment while restoring the original canal and bridge.
facts.sourceQuote: De aarden dekkingswal werd afgegraven en de gracht en brug werden hersteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The earthen embankment was excavated and the canal and bridge were restored.

facts.text: A music school and a historical society now operate within the renovated structure.
facts.sourceQuote: In Fort aan de Ossenmarkt, dat in 1992 feestelijk werd heropend, zijn onder andere de Kreatieve Groep Weesp, een muziekschool en de Historische Kring Weesp gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Fort aan de Ossenmarkt, which was reopened in 1992 in a festive manner, the Kreatieve Groep Weesp, a music school and the Historische Kring Weesp are among others located.

features.name: Monument Haarlemmerweg
features.opening: The Monument on the Haarlemmerweg is a monument for war victims, placed on the Haarlemmerweg, Amsterdam Nieuw-West between the pedestrian and bicycle bridges…

facts.text: Police officer Elias's father and son Verkuijl were shot dead here by German occupiers in revenge for a resistance act.
facts.sourceQuote: Politieagent Elias vader en zoon Verkuijl werden hier door de Duitse bezetter doodgeschoten als vergelding voor een verzetsdaad op het spoortraject Amsterdam-Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Police officer Elias' father and son Verkuijl were shot dead here by the German occupiers as revenge for a resistance act on the Amsterdam-Haarlem railway line.

facts.text: A white wooden cross first stood at this site from 1947 until the farm was demolished around 1964.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1947 stond hier langs de Haarlemmerweg ter hoogte van boerderij Vredelust een wit houten kruis. Vanwege een herindeling van de Haarlemmerweg en de sloop van de boerderij rond 1964 werd er een nieuw wit kruis geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1947, a white wooden cross stood here along the Haarlemmerweg near farm Vredelust. Due to a reorganization of the Haarlemmerweg and the demolition of the farm around 1964, a new white cross was placed.

features.name: Boom Chicago
features.opening: Boom Chicago is an international creative group based in Amsterdam, Netherlands, that writes and performs sketch and improvisational comedy at their theater on…

facts.text: In 2008, the group celebrated its fifteenth anniversary in April.
facts.sourceQuote: 2008: 15 year anniversary, April 24.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: 2008: 15 year anniversary, April 24.

facts.text: Oscar winner Jordan Peele created many shows at the venue before meeting Keegan-Michael Key there in 2002.
facts.sourceQuote: Oscar winner Jordan Peele created many shows at Boom Chicago in Amsterdam and at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Keegan-Michael Key met Peele in 2002 at the Boom Chicago-Second City stage swap.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Oscar winner Jordan Peele created many shows at Boom Chicago in Amsterdam and at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. Keegan-Michael Key met Peele in 2002 at the Boom Chicago-Second City stage swap.

facts.text: The series Ted Lasso was created by three alumni who also wrote, starred in and directed the show.
facts.sourceQuote: Ted Lasso was created by three Boom Chicago alumni: Jason Sudeikis, Brendan Hunt and Joe Kelly. They created, wrote, starred in, and directed the series.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Ted Lasso was created by three Boom Chicago alumni: Jason Sudeikis, Brendan Hunt and Joe Kelly. They created, wrote, starred in, and directed the series.

features.name: Auschwitz Memorial
features.opening: The Auschwitzmonument, also known as the mirror monument 'Nooit Meer Auschwitz' or Broken Mirrors, is a Dutch memorial in the Wertheimpark in Amsterdam to…

facts.text: Writer Jan Wolkers designed the monument despite having little experience with glass.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is in 1977 ontworpen door schrijver en beeldend kunstenaar Jan Wolkers, die weinig ervaring had met glas en mede-uitgevoerd door Louis La Rooy, gespecialiseerd in glaskunst, in de werkplaats van Glasindustrie van Tetterode in de Staatsliedenbuurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was designed in 1977 by writer and visual artist Jan Wolkers, who had little experience with glass and also designed by Louis La Rooy, specialized in glass art, in the workshop of Glasindustrie van Tetterode in the Staatsliedenbuurt.

facts.text: The memorial moved from Oosterbegraafplaats to Wertheimpark in 1993.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd oorspronkelijk geplaatst op de Oosterbegraafplaats. In 1993 is het monument in grotere vorm verplaatst naar het Wertheimpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was originally placed on the Oosterbegraafplaats. In 1993, the monument was moved in a larger form to Wertheimpark.

facts.text: The original artwork was largely made by hand with few safety requirements during its creation.
facts.sourceQuote: L a Rooy ging daarbij ook even terug in de tijd. Destijds werd het kunstwerk grotendeels met hand en lijf gemaakt; eisen dat de werkzaamheden veilig moesten worden uitgevoerd waren er nauwelijks.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: L a Rooy also went back in time for a while. At that time, the work of art was largely made by hand and by heart; there were hardly any requirements that the work had to be carried out safely.

features.name: Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge
features.opening: The Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge or the Obrechtsjoel (בית כנסת רב אהרן שוסטר) is the largest still functioning Ashkenazi synagogue (shoe) in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge was named after Rabbi Aron Schuster, who retired in 1973 to live in Jerusalem.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen rabbijn Aron Schuster (1907-1994) in 1973 zijn werkzaamheden als opperrabbijn neerlegde en Amsterdam verliet om in Jeruzalem te gaan wonen, werd de synagoge, die zijn standplaats was geweest vanaf zijn benoeming per 1 januari 1942 in het Rabbinaat van Amsterdam, naar hem vernoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When Rabbi Aron Schuster (1907-1994) retired from his work as chief rabbi in 1973 and left Amsterdam to live in Jerusalem, the synagogue, which had been his place of residence since his appointment on January 1, 1942 in the Rabbinate of Amsterdam, was named after him.

facts.text: After World War II, the first service resumed on Rosh Hashanah 1945 using reassembled pre-war sofas.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de Tweede Wereldoorlog werd de Obrechtsjoel het centrum van het religieus-joodse leven in Amsterdam. De eerste dienst in het gebouw kon plaatsvinden op Rosj Hasjana 1945, zij het met een provisorisch interieur. De gedemonteerde vooroorlogse banken konden nadien worden teruggeplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After World War II, the Obrechts Synagogue became the center of religious Jewish life in Amsterdam. The first service in the building could take place on Rosh Hashanah 1945, albeit with a provisional interior. The disassembled pre-war sofas could then be reassembled.

facts.text: Hans Bloemendal served as the synagogue's cantor from 1949 until 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1949 tot 2009 was Hans Bloemendal de voorzanger (chazan) van de Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1949 to 2009, Hans Bloemendal was the cantor (chazan) of the Raw Aron Schuster Synagoge.

features.name: Koningskerk
features.opening: The Koningskerk is a church in the Amsterdam district of Watergraafsmeer.

facts.text: Some observers say the brick facade resembles a crossword puzzle from the outside.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de buitenzijde geeft het volgens sommigen het uiterlijk van een kruiswoordraadsel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the outside, according to some, it gives the appearance of a crossword puzzle.

facts.text: Since 1994, the building has served the Evangelical Brotherhood Church with many Surinamese attendees.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1994 wordt de kerk gebruikt door de Evangelische Broedergemeente. Als zodanig komen er veel mensen uit de Surinaamse gemeenschap.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1994, the church has been used by the Evangelical Brotherhood Church. As such, many people come from the Surinamese community.

features.name: De Schreeuw
features.opening: De Schreeuw (The Scream) is a sculpture in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam that commemorates the assassinated Dutch film-maker Theo van Gogh.

facts.text: Artist Henneman created the work in 2007 to honor freedom of speech.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007 Henneman created the sculpture as symbol of freedom of speech.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007 Henneman created the sculpture as symbol of freedom of speech.

facts.text: The stainless steel statue stands 4.5 metres tall and features a face screaming on one side.
facts.sourceQuote: The 4.5-metre-tall (15 ft) heat-blasted stainless steel statue is in the form of a stylized profile of a face that screams on one side and has a closed mouth on the other.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 4.5-metre-tall (15 ft) heat-blasted stainless steel statue is in the form of a stylized profile of a face that screams on one side and has a closed mouth on the other.

features.name: De Boom die alles zag
features.opening: De Boom Die Alles Zag (transl.

facts.text: The tree was planted in the mid-to-late 1960s during the early development of Bijlmermeer.
facts.sourceQuote: The tree is located on the Nellesteinpad in Bijlmermeer and was planted during the early years of the neighbourhood (c. mid to late 1960s).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tree is located on the Nellesteinpad in Bijlmermeer and was planted during the early years of the neighbourhood (c. mid to late 1960s).

facts.text: Soil replacement in 2017 improved its condition, though cables still support it against falling.
facts.sourceQuote: The soil under it was replaced in 2017 to stimulate root growth, which according to pulling tests four years later improved its condition, but the tree is still supported by the cables to prevent it from falling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The soil under it was replaced in 2017 to stimulate root growth, which according to pulling tests four years later improved its condition, but the tree is still supported by the cables to prevent it from falling.

facts.text: Cleanup efforts damaged its roots, forcing workers to secure it with cables attached to neighboring trees.
facts.sourceQuote: The tree lost a part of its roots during the clean-up of the soil, which made it necessary to support it with two cables attached to neighbouring trees.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tree lost a part of its roots during the clean-up of the soil, which made it necessary to support it with two cables attached to neighbouring trees.

features.name: Museum De Dageraad
features.opening: De Dageraad is a residential complex in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Architects Michel de Klerk and Piet Kramer built the complex in 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: De socialistische woningbouwvereniging 'De Dageraad' gaf in 1920 de architecten Michel de Klerk en Piet Kramer opdracht voor de bouw van 294 woningen en zes winkels.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The socialist housing association 'De Dageraad' commissioned the architects Michel de Klerk and Piet Kramer in 1920 to build 294 houses and six shops.

facts.text: The house blocks follow the original layout of a planned hospital complex.
facts.sourceQuote: Berlage, die dit terrein aanvankelijk had gereserveerd voor een ziekenhuiscomplex. De oorspronkelijke plattegrond van het ziekenhuis is gevolgd bij de rangschikking van de huizenblokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Berlage, who initially had reserved this land for a hospital complex. The original layout of the hospital has been followed in the arrangement of the blocks of houses.

features.name: Plaquette 7 mei 1945
features.opening: The 1945 shooting on Dam square took place during the liberation of Amsterdam on 7 May 1945, in the last days of World War II in Europe.

facts.text: Plaquette 7 mei 1945 marks the date thousands gathered on Dam square to celebrate the war's end.
facts.sourceQuote: On 7 May, thousands of people gathered on the Dam, the central square of the city, to celebrate the end of the war and welcome the Allied soldiers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 7 May, thousands of people gathered on the Dam, the central square of the city, to celebrate the end of the war and welcome the Allied soldiers.

facts.text: Dutch resistance forces had already disarmed most Germans and seized key buildings by midday before British troops arrived.
facts.sourceQuote: Meanwhile the Dutch resistance (Binnenlandse Strijdkrachten) had successfully disarmed most of the Germans, without much trouble. By midday they had taken possession of three key locations: the Royal Palace, the main money office and the main post office (Operation Three Castles).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Meanwhile the Dutch resistance (Binnenlandse Strijdkrachten) had successfully disarmed most of the Germans, without much trouble. By midday they had taken possession of three key locations: the Royal Palace, the main money office and the main post office (Operation Three Castles).

facts.text: German soldiers fired machine guns into a crowd celebrating the war's end, killing over 30 people.
facts.sourceQuote: German soldiers fired machine guns into a large crowd gathered in Dam Square to celebrate the end of the war, killing over 30 people.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: German soldiers fired machine guns into a large crowd gathered in Dam Square to celebrate the end of the war, killing over 30 people.

features.name: Heineken Experience
features.opening: The Heineken Experience, located in Amsterdam, is a historic brewery and corporate visitor centre for the internationally distributed Dutch pilsner, Heineken…

facts.text: A larger modern facility replaced it on the city outskirts in 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: The industrial facility was built as the first Heineken brewery in 1867, serving as the company's primary brewing facility until 1988 when a more modern, larger facility was constructed on the outskirts of the city.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The industrial facility was built as the first Heineken brewery in 1867, serving as the company's primary brewing facility until 1988 when a more modern, larger facility was constructed on the outskirts of the city.

facts.text: Tours of the original brewery began before the visitor centre officially opened in 1991.
facts.sourceQuote: Although the Heineken Experience began in 1991, there were tours of the original brewery while it was still fully operational.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the Heineken Experience began in 1991, there were tours of the original brewery while it was still fully operational.

features.name: Museum of the Canals
features.opening: Grachtenmuseum Amsterdam (Museum of the Canals) is a museum on the Herengracht in Amsterdam dedicated to the 17th-century Amsterdam canal belt and the history…

facts.text: A dollhouse displays the house rooms using the Pepper's ghost optical illusion technique.
facts.sourceQuote: Een poppenhuis toont de kamers van het grachtenhuis met behulp van de Pepper's ghost-techniek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A dollhouse shows the rooms of the canal house using the Pepper's ghost technique.

facts.text: After a brief closure for renovation, the museum reopened at the end of March 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum werd na enkele maanden tijdelijk gesloten voor restauratie en herinrichting, en eind maart 2012 heropend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was temporarily closed for restoration and renovation after a few months, and reopened at the end of March 2012.

facts.text: Banker Jan Willink once lent the US government over 30 million guilders during their revolution.
facts.sourceQuote: De bankier heeft tijdens de Amerikaanse Onafhankelijkheidsoorlog (1775-1790) de Amerikanen vele jaren gesteund met kredieten en aandelen. Tot 1794 leenden de Verenigde Staten van Willink en andere bankiers ruim 30 miljoen gulden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the American Revolutionary War (1775-1790), the banker supported the Americans with loans and shares for many years. Until 1794, the United States borrowed more than 30 million guilders from Willink and other bankers.

facts.text: A back room preserves 1776 wallpaper by Jurriaen Andriessen depicting idealized Dutch landscapes.
facts.sourceQuote: De achterkamer heeft behangsels van Jurriaen Andriessen uit 1776 met schilderingen van geïdealiseerde Hollandse landschappen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The back room has wallpaper by Jurriaen Andriessen from 1776 with paintings of idealized Dutch landscapes.

facts.text: In 1970, this double canal house was officially designated as a national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het dubbel grachtenpand werd in 1970 aangewezen als rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The double canal house was designated as a national monument in 1970.

features.name: De Kleine Komedie
features.opening: De Kleine Komedie is today the oldest theatre in Amsterdam, dating from 1788.

facts.text: The directors fled or stepped down in 1787 due to their anti-Orange political sympathies.
facts.sourceQuote: The 'Patriotic' or 'Anti-Orange' sympathies of the directors Henry Fizeaux and Jean Alexander Botereau resulted in their stepping down in 1787 when the House of Orange was re-established.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Patriotic' or 'Anti-Orange' sympathies of the directors Henry Fizeaux and Jean Alexander Botereau resulted in their stepping down in 1787 when the House of Orange was re-established.

facts.text: Henry Hope ran the establishment until he was forced to flee before Napoleon's army arrived in 1794.
facts.sourceQuote: Orangist Henry Hope took over the running of the establishment until he fled the country before Napoleon's army in 1794.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Orangist Henry Hope took over the running of the establishment until he fled the country before Napoleon's army in 1794.

facts.text: The auditorium holds exactly 503 seats for its performances.
facts.sourceQuote: The theatre has 503 seats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theatre has 503 seats.

features.name: Westertoren
features.opening: The Westertoren in Amsterdam is the tower of the Westerkerk, at Prinsengracht 279 by the Westermarkt in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: The tower underwent a major restoration from February 2023 until early 2025.
facts.sourceQuote: Van februari 2023 tot begin 2025 werd de toren gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower was restored from February 2023 to the beginning of 2025.

features.name: Filmhallen
features.opening: The Filmhallen, also known as FilmHallen, is a movie theater in the De Hallen complex in the former tram depot Tollensstraat in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: The cinema opened on September 4, 2014, debuting with the Dutch film Nena.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop draait sinds 4 september 2014, met op 8 september de première van de Nederlandse speelfilm Nena van Saskia Diesing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has been open since September 4, 2014, with the premiere of the Dutch feature film Nena by Saskia Diesing on September 8.

facts.text: Kadir Selçuk and Alex Rutten of The Movies operate this movie theater.
facts.sourceQuote: De exploitanten zijn Kadir Selçuk en Alex Rutten van The Movies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The operators are Kadir Selçuk and Alex Rutten of The Movies.

facts.text: Filmhallen participates in the Cineville partnership connecting various cinemas.
facts.sourceQuote: De Filmhallen doet mee aan het samenwerkingsverband Cineville van filmhuizen en bioscopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Filmhallen participates in the Cineville partnership of film theaters and cinemas.

facts.text: The cinema opened its doors on October 22, 2014 after the interior was stored since 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen het Filmmuseum in 2012 verhuisde naar het nieuwe EYE-gebouw in Amsterdam-Noord, werd het Parisien interieur ontmanteld en opgeslagen. In het najaar van 2014 kreeg het oude interieur van Cinema Parisien een derde leven als filmzaal in de Filmhallen. De zaal werd in gebruik genomen op 22 oktober 2014.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Filmmuseum moved to the new EYE building in Amsterdam-North in 2012, the Parisian interior was dismantled and stored. In the fall of 2014, the old interior of Cinema Parisien received a third life as a cinema in the Filmhallen. The hall was put into use on October 22, 2014.

facts.text: Room 7 features a 1924 art deco interior with Amsterdam School accents originally from Cinema Parisien.
facts.sourceQuote: In zaal 7 is het art-deco-interieur met Amsterdamse School-accenten uit 1924 ingebouwd van de vroegere Cinema Parisien, die tot 1987 op de Nieuwendijk gevestigd was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In room 7, the art deco interior with Amsterdam School accents from 1924 is built into the former Cinema Parisien, which was located on Nieuwendijk until 1987.

features.name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
features.opening: De Brakke Grond, full name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural center at Nes 45 in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The name de Brakke Grond refers to the marshy area where Amstel sweet water mixed with IJ seawater.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam "de Brakke Grond" verwijst naar het drassige gebied dat zich oorspronkelijk op deze plek bevond. De mengeling van het zoet water van de Amstel en het zeewater van het IJ maakte het grondwater hier brak.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name "de Brakke Grond" refers to the marshy area that originally existed in this place. The mixture of the sweet water of the Amstel and the seawater of the IJ made the groundwater here brackish.

facts.text: Well-known doctor Nicolaes Tulp gave anatomy lessons in a dissection room here until 1691.
facts.sourceQuote: Tevens werd ze gebruikt als schermschool en, tot 1691, als ontleedkamer waar bekende artsen als Nicolaes Tulp anatomieles gaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was also used as a teaching hospital and, until 1691, as a dissection room where well-known doctors such as Nicolaes Tulp gave anatomy lessons.

facts.text: Remains of the original monastery church were discovered during renovation work on Nespleintje in 1991.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1991 werden tijdens renovatiewerken op het Nespleintje resten van de kloosterkerk gevonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1991, during renovation work on Nespleintje, remains of the monastery church were found.

facts.text: Architect Arthur Staal designed the current building housing this cultural center.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huidige gebouw is een ontwerp van architect Arthur Staal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current building is a design by architect Arthur Staal.

facts.text: The Flemish government opened the venue in 1981 to promote cultural exchange.
facts.sourceQuote: De Brakke Grond werd geopend door de Vlaamse overheid in 1981 met het doel de Vlaamse culturele identiteit te profileren in Nederland, Vlaams-Nederlandse culturele uitwisseling te bevorderen en Vlaamse artiesten een podium in Nederland te bieden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Brakke Grond was opened by the Flemish government in 1981 with the aim of profiling the Flemish cultural identity in the Netherlands, promoting Vlaams-Dutch cultural exchange and providing Flemish artists with a stage in the Netherlands.

features.name: Houseboat Museum
features.opening: The Woonbootmuseum (also known as the Houseboat Museum) is a museum in Amsterdam entirely dedicated to the history and culture of living on the water.

facts.text: Resident Vincent van Loon founded the museum after noticing tourists peering curiously inside.
facts.sourceQuote: The idea for the museum arose in the 1990s with then-houseboat resident Vincent van Loon. Because he noticed that passersby and tourists on the canals frequently peered curiously inside, he decided to establish a museum to provide insight into life on the water.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The idea for the museum arose in the 1990s with then-houseboat resident Vincent van Loon. Because he noticed that passersby and tourists on the canals frequently peered curiously inside, he decided to establish a museum to provide insight into life on the water.

facts.text: Restorations returned the historic skipper's cabin at the ship's rear to its original condition.
facts.sourceQuote: During the renovations, the historic skipper's cabin (the authentic quarters of the skipper at the rear) was restored to its original condition.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the renovations, the historic skipper's cabin (the authentic quarters of the skipper at the rear) was restored to its original condition.

facts.text: New owners redecorated the living quarters in 1970s style to reflect the houseboat culture heyday.
facts.sourceQuote: The new owners redecorated the residential section of the ship in a 1970s style to reflect the heyday of Amsterdam's houseboat culture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The new owners redecorated the residential section of the ship in a 1970s style to reflect the heyday of Amsterdam's houseboat culture.

facts.text: The vessel housing the museum was built in 1914 as an inland ship.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is located on the Prinsengracht, on the edge of the Jordaan, and is housed aboard the Hendrika Maria, a historic inland vessel from 1914.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is located on the Prinsengracht, on the edge of the Jordaan, and is housed aboard the Hendrika Maria, a historic inland vessel from 1914.

features.name: Fo Guang Shan He Hua Tempel
features.opening: Fo Guang Shan He Hua Temple (Chinese: 佛光山荷華寺; pinyin: Fó Guāng Shān Hé Huá Sì; lit.

facts.text: Dutch architect Fred Greven traveled to Taiwan to learn about Buddhist temples for this project.
facts.sourceQuote: Despite Greven's lack of experience in designing Buddhist temples, he was appointed and travelled to Taiwan to learn about Buddhist temples.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Despite Greven's lack of experience in designing Buddhist temples, he was appointed and travelled to Taiwan to learn about Buddhist temples.

facts.text: Fo Guang Shan He Hua Tempel is commissioned by the Buddha's Light International Association based in Taiwan.
facts.sourceQuote: The temple was commissioned by the Buddha's Light International Association based in Taiwan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The temple was commissioned by the Buddha's Light International Association based in Taiwan.

facts.text: The second design succeeded only after the architect adopted the Buddhist sacred unit of 32 centimeters for all measurements.
facts.sourceQuote: For the second design he applied the Buddhist sacred measurement unit of 32 centimeters and everything fell in place.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For the second design he applied the Buddhist sacred measurement unit of 32 centimeters and everything fell in place.

facts.text: Original Taiwanese roof tiles were replaced by custom yellow glazed Romanesque tiles because they could not withstand Dutch weather.
facts.sourceQuote: However, these were incompatible with Dutch weather. They were replaced by custom yellow glazed Romanesque tiles with replica fittings and prayer statues.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, these were incompatible with Dutch weather. They were replaced by custom yellow glazed Romanesque tiles with replica fittings and prayer statues.

features.name: Opstandingskerk
features.opening: The Opstandingskerk is a church in Amsterdam West, at Bos en Lommerplein 325 on the western part of the square.

facts.text: Construction earned it the nickname Kolenkit due to its 48-meter-high bell tower resembling a coal kit.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze kreeg al tijdens de bouw de bijnaam Kolenkit vanwege de gelijkenis van de 48 meter hoge klokkentoren met een kolenkit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She already got the nickname Kolenkit during construction because of the similarity of the 48-meter-high bell tower to a coal kit.

facts.text: Dutch architect Marius Duintjer designed the church between 1955 and 1956.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd ontworpen door de Nederlandse architect Marius Duintjer en gebouwd in de periode 1955-1956.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was designed by the Dutch architect Marius Duintjer and built in the period 1955-1956.

facts.text: The slanted bell tower points to the sky like a little finger in a hand.
facts.sourceQuote: De schuine afplatting van de klokkentoren vormt daar nog een diagonaal element aan toe en lijkt naar de hemel te wijzen als een wijsvinger in een hand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The slanted flattening of the bell tower adds another diagonal element to it and seems to point to the sky like a little finger in a hand.

features.name: Rasphuispoort
features.opening: The Rasphuis was a "tuchthuis" or prison in Amsterdam that was established in 1596 in the former Convent of the Poor Clares on the Heiligeweg.

facts.text: A persistent myth claims prisoners pumped water in a flooded cellar, though historians find no evidence for this room.
facts.sourceQuote: There is a persistent myth that the Rasphuis contained a "water dungeon," the so-called Waterhuis. If prisoners refused to work they were placed in a cellar that quickly filled with water after a sluice was opened; they were handed a pump that enabled them to keep from drowning, provided they pumped energetically and continuously. Geert Mak and other historians, however, point out that there is no evidence whatsoever for the existence of this room and this punishment.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a persistent myth that the Rasphuis contained a "water dungeon," the so-called Waterhuis. If prisoners refused to work they were placed in a cellar that quickly filled with water after a sluice was opened; they were handed a pump that enabled them to keep from drowning, provided they pumped energetically and continuously. Geert Mak and other historians, however, point out that there is no evidence whatsoever for the existence of this room and this punishment.

facts.text: Detainees shaved brazilwood with eight-to-twelve bladed rasps, creating the powder that gave Rasphuispoort its name.
facts.sourceQuote: The detainees in the Rasphuis were made to shave wood from the brazilwood tree (Caesalpinia echinata or pernambuco), rasping it into powder using an eight to twelve bladed rasp, hence the name.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The detainees in the Rasphuis were made to shave wood from the brazilwood tree (Caesalpinia echinata or pernambuco), rasping it into powder using an eight to twelve bladed rasp, hence the name.

facts.text: The prison closed in 1815 before the building was demolished in 1892 to construct a swimming pool.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1815 it was closed, and in 1892 the building was demolished to make way for a swimming pool.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1815 it was closed, and in 1892 the building was demolished to make way for a swimming pool.

features.name: The National Maritime Museum
features.opening: The Maritime Museum (Dutch: Het Scheepvaartmuseum, pronounced [ət ˈsxeːpfaːrtmyˌzeːjʏm]) is a maritime museum in Amsterdam in the Netherlands.

facts.text: The former naval storehouse was designed by Dutch architect Daniël Stalpaert.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum is housed in a former naval storehouse, 's Lands Zeemagazijn or Admiraliteits Magazijn, designed by the Dutch architect Daniël Stalpaert and constructed in 1656.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is housed in a former naval storehouse, 's Lands Zeemagazijn or Admiraliteits Magazijn, designed by the Dutch architect Daniël Stalpaert and constructed in 1656.

facts.text: After a major renovation, the museum reopened on October 2, 2011.
facts.sourceQuote: After an extensive renovation in 2007–2011, Het Scheepvaartmuseum reopened on 2 October 2011.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After an extensive renovation in 2007–2011, Het Scheepvaartmuseum reopened on 2 October 2011.

features.name: Academie voor Theater en Dans
features.opening: The Academy of Theatre and Dance is a faculty of the Amsterdam University of the Arts which was known as de Theaterschool until September 2016.

facts.text: The institution merged with the Kleinkunstacademie in 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2001 it merged with the Kleinkunstacademie, founded in 1960 by Boris Blom
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2001 it merged with the Kleinkunstacademie, founded in 1960 by Boris Blom

facts.text: Anna Sablariolles was registered as the very first pupil.
facts.sourceQuote: There Anna Sablariolles was registered as first pupil, and Maria Gartman as one of its first instructors.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There Anna Sablariolles was registered as first pupil, and Maria Gartman as one of its first instructors.

facts.text: Maria Gartman served as one of the school's earliest instructors.
facts.sourceQuote: There Anna Sablariolles was registered as first pupil, and Maria Gartman as one of its first instructors.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There Anna Sablariolles was registered as first pupil, and Maria Gartman as one of its first instructors.

facts.text: The institution kept the name de Theaterschool until September 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: The Academy of Theatre and Dance is a faculty of the Amsterdam University of the Arts which was known as de Theaterschool until September 2016.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Academy of Theatre and Dance is a faculty of the Amsterdam University of the Arts which was known as de Theaterschool until September 2016.

facts.text: About sixty instructors work there, nearly all active in theatre or dance.
facts.sourceQuote: The staff of instructors and guest instructors amounts to about sixty persons, nearly all also in active in the theatrical and dance field.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The staff of instructors and guest instructors amounts to about sixty persons, nearly all also in active in the theatrical and dance field.

features.name: Kerk van Zunderdorp
features.opening: The Kerk van Zunderdorp is the Reformed Dutch Kerk van Zunderdorp in Amsterdam-North.

facts.text: The current hall church was constructed in 1711 against an older tower.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een gepleisterde zaalkerk met steunberen, in 1711 gebouwd tegen de laatgotische toren zonder steunberen van de vorige kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a plastered hall church with buttresses, built in 1711 against the late Gothic tower without buttresses of the previous church.

facts.text: A fire forced a major restoration of the interior in 1824.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkinterieur wordt overdekt door een houten tongewelf met trekbalken op geprofileerde sleutelstukken en korbelen (volgens de V.L. herbouwd 1711 en 1824; het eerste jaartal is waarschijnlijk, het tweede betreft een herstelling na een brand).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church interior is covered by a wooden barrel vault with trusses on profiled keystones and corbels (rebuilt according to the V.L. in 1711 and 1824; the first year is probably, the second refers to a restoration after a fire).

facts.text: The organ was crafted in 1907 by Mart Vermeulen's workshop in Woerden.
facts.sourceQuote: Goldschmeding (Amsterdam) in 1907, maar afkomstig uit de werkplaats van de orgelmaker Mart. Vermeulen (Woerden).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Goldsmith (Amsterdam) in 1907, but from the workshop of the organ maker Mart. Vermeulen (Woerden).

facts.text: Flentrop Orgelbouw restored the instrument in Zaandam during 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 is het instrument gerestaureerd door Flentrop Orgelbouw te Zaandam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, the instrument was restored by Flentrop Orgelbouw in Zaandam.

features.name: Museum Het Schip
features.opening: Het Schip (English: The Ship) is a building complex in the Spaarndammerbuurt neighbourhood of Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: Architect Michel de Klerk designed the complex in 1919.
facts.sourceQuote: The complex in the architectural style of the Amsterdam School was designed by Michel de Klerk in 1919.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex in the architectural style of the Amsterdam School was designed by Michel de Klerk in 1919.

facts.text: A former school and post office became a museum in 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2001, the former school and post office are used as a museum about the Amsterdam School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2001, the former school and post office are used as a museum about the Amsterdam School.

facts.text: The socialist group Eigen Haard commissioned architect Michel de Klerk to design this housing block.
facts.sourceQuote: One such group was Eigen Haard, or "our own hearth," a socialist group that commissioned Michel de Klerk to design and build three blocks of proletarian housing, including Het Schip.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One such group was Eigen Haard, or "our own hearth," a socialist group that commissioned Michel de Klerk to design and build three blocks of proletarian housing, including Het Schip.

features.name: DeLaMar
features.opening: DeLaMar is a theatre near Leidseplein in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with two auditoriums containing 601 and 939 seats.

facts.text: A Dutch resistance bombing on January 7, 1944, caused part of the structure to burn down.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dutch resistance bombed the building on 7 January 1944, causing part of the building to burn down.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dutch resistance bombed the building on 7 January 1944, causing part of the building to burn down.

facts.text: Wim Sonneveld purchased the venue in 1952 and reopened it as the Nieuwe de la Mar Theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Wim Sonneveld bought the theatre in 1952 and reopened it as the Nieuwe de la Mar Theater (English: New de la Mar Theatre).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Wim Sonneveld bought the theatre in 1952 and reopened it as the Nieuwe de la Mar Theater (English: New de la Mar Theatre).

features.name: Middenstip Stadion De Meer
features.opening: Middenstip is a work of art by Harald Vlugt, placed in Amsterdam-Oost, the Watergraafsmeer.

facts.text: The neighborhood was built on the site of Stadion De Meer, which served as Ajax's home until 1996.
facts.sourceQuote: De wijk is gebouwd op de plaats waar tot 1996 Stadion De Meer stond, jarenlang thuishonk van AFC Ajax.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The neighborhood was built on the site where Stadion De Meer stood until 1996, home to AFC Ajax for many years.

features.name: Bellamyplein
features.opening: The Bellamyplein is a triangular square in the Bellamy neighborhood in Amsterdam-West, between the Bilderdijkkade and the Ten Katestraat.

facts.text: Two massive winged nut trees, planted in 1933, tower over the square at heights of up to eighteen meters.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zuidpunt van het plantsoen staan twee reusachtige bomen (boomnummers 504239 en 504235, niet monumentaal), beide van het type gewone vleugelnoot (Pterocarya fraxinifolia). Ze stammen uit 1933/1934 en worden 15 tot 18 meter hoog gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the southern end of the park are two enormous trees (tree numbers 504239 and 504235, not monumental), both of the type common winged nut (Pterocarya fraxinifolia). They date back to 1933/1934 and are kept 15 to 18 meters high.

features.name: Amsterdamse Bos
features.opening: The Amsterdamse Bos (Dutch for "Amsterdam Forest") is a large urban forest and landscape park south-west of Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: The city council officially approved the park's creation in 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam city council decided in 1928 to create a major public park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam city council decided in 1928 to create a major public park.

facts.text: German anti-aircraft positions and searchlights were installed near Schiphol, clearing strips of young woodland.
facts.sourceQuote: Because of the proximity of Schiphol, German anti-aircraft positions and searchlights were installed, and strips of young woodland were cleared.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because of the proximity of Schiphol, German anti-aircraft positions and searchlights were installed, and strips of young woodland were cleared.

facts.text: During the Dutch famine of 1944–1945, further trees were cut down to provide fuel for survival.
facts.sourceQuote: Further trees were cut for fuel during the Dutch famine of 1944–1945.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Further trees were cut for fuel during the Dutch famine of 1944–1945.

facts.text: Four specific camps held Jewish men who were subjected to forced labour before many faced deportation.
facts.sourceQuote: Four camps in the Amsterdamse Bos were specifically used for Jewish men, who were subjected to forced labour. These camps formed part of the persecution of Dutch Jews and, for many of those imprisoned there, preceded deportation to concentration and extermination camps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Four camps in the Amsterdamse Bos were specifically used for Jewish men, who were subjected to forced labour. These camps formed part of the persecution of Dutch Jews and, for many of those imprisoned there, preceded deportation to concentration and extermination camps.

features.name: Gaasperpark
features.opening: The Gaasperpark is a park in Gaasperdam, Amsterdam-Zuidoost district, on the northern bank of the Gaasperplas, an artificial recreation lake, created by sand…

facts.text: Construction began in 1977 specifically for the 1982 Floriade exhibition.
facts.sourceQuote: De aanleg van het park startte in 1977 voor de Floriade van 1982.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The construction of the park began in 1977 for the 1982 Floriade.

facts.text: Six steel boxes from the original event still stand near the former entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: Een kunstwerk bestaande uit zes stalen dozen bij de voormalige ingang staat er nog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A work of art consisting of six steel boxes still stands near the former entrance.

features.name: Gaasperzoom
features.opening: The Gaasperzoom is a park and nature reserve in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: A north-south bicycle path crosses the reserve while another runs along the Ruwelswal.
facts.sourceQuote: Een fietspad doorkruist het gebied van noord naar zuid. Haaks hierop loopt een fietspad langs de Ruwelswal naar het riviertje het Gein langs de woonwijken Gein en Reigersbos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A bicycle path crosses the area from north to south. At an angle to this, a bicycle path runs along the Ruwelswal to the stream the Gein along the residential areas Gein and Reigersbos.

features.name: Hortusplantsoen
features.opening: The Hortusplantsoen is a park and street in the center of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Famous football coach Rinus Michels taught gymnastics here from 1956 to 1965.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier werkte de latere voetbaltrainer Rinus Michels van 1956 tot 1965 als gymnastiekleraar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here, the later football coach Rinus Michels worked as a gymnastics teacher from 1956 to 1965.

facts.text: A plaque unveiled in 2007 honors Jewish students sent to camps from this school.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 19 april 2007 onthulde de Amsterdamse burgemeester Job Cohen een plaquette bij de Academie ter herinnering aan de Joodse leerlingen van de J.C. Ammanschool die tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog werden opgepakt en naar de concentratiekampen gestuurd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 19, 2007, the mayor of Amsterdam, Job Cohen, unveiled a plaque at the Academy in memory of the Jewish students of the J.C. Nursing school that was seized during World War II and sent to the concentration camps.

facts.text: Two bridges span the pond: a 1877 natural stone vault and a 1903 iron arch, both national monuments.
facts.sourceQuote: De twee bruggen in de vijver zijn beide aangewezen als rijksmonument: een natuurstenen welfbrug met zware gietijzeren leuningen uit 1877 (brug nr. 233) en een ijzeren boogbrug uit 1903.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both of the bridges in the pond have been designated as a national monument: a natural stone vault bridge with heavy cast iron railings from 1877 (bridge no. 233) and an iron arch bridge from 1903.

features.name: Wachterliedplantsoen
features.opening: The Wachterliedplantsoen is a park in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West.

facts.text: The name Wachterliedplantsoen honors late medieval guard songs sung by watchmen bidding farewell to lovers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen is vernoemd bij een gemeenteraadsbesluit van 26 juli 1939 naar de wachterliederen, een laatmiddeleeuws soort minnelied waarbij afscheid genomen werd door de waarschuwende wachter op een muur van een minnend paar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is named after a municipal council decision of July 26, 1939 after the guard songs, a late medieval kind of love song in which farewell was said by the warning guard on a wall of a loving couple.

facts.text: A complete renovation and replanting of the garden took place in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 is het plantsoen volledig gerenoveerd en opnieuw beplant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, the garden was completely renovated and replanted.

features.name: Hoeckelingsdam
features.opening: The Hoeckelingsdam is a low, 1.6 kilometer long dam in the IJmeer, intended to create calm water between the dam and the Uitdammerdijk and thereby increase the…

facts.text: Construction took place between 2003 and 2005 to compensate for the IJburg district development.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hoeckelingsdam is tussen 2003 en 2005 aangelegd als natuurcompensatie voor de aanleg van de Amsterdamse wijk IJburg, die aan de overzijde van het IJmeer ligt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hoeckelingsdam was built between 2003 and 2005 as a nature compensation for the construction of the Amsterdam district of IJburg, which is located across the IJmeer.

facts.text: Engineers designed the dam to partially submerge underwater and occasionally flood naturally.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hoeckelingsdam werd ontworpen om deels onder water te verdwijnen en af en toe te overstromen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hoeckelingsdam was designed to partially disappear underwater and occasionally flood.

facts.text: Since at least 2005, Staatsbosbeheer has served as the nature manager for this specific zone.
facts.sourceQuote: Gegevens uit 2005 noemen de directie IJsselmeergebied van Rijkswaterstaat als eigenaar en technisch beheerder, en Staatsbosbeheer als natuurbeheerder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Data from 2005 name the IJsselmeer Area Directorate of Rijkswaterstaat as the owner and technical manager, and Staatsbosbeheer as the nature manager.

features.name: Sarphatipark
features.opening: The Sarphatipark (Dutch pronunciation: [sɑrˈfaːtiˌpɑr(ə)k]) is a public urban park located in the stadsdeel Amsterdam Oud-Zuid in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Painter Mommie Schwarz lived nearby until his deportation and execution at Auschwitz in 1942.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dutch painter Mommie Schwarz and his wife Else Berg lived adjacent to the park from 1927 until their deportation to, and execution at, the Auschwitz concentration camp in 1942.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dutch painter Mommie Schwarz and his wife Else Berg lived adjacent to the park from 1927 until their deportation to, and execution at, the Auschwitz concentration camp in 1942.

features.name: Park Somerlust
features.opening: Park Somerlust is a park in Amsterdam-Oost

facts.text: A major redesign between 2011 and 2015 replaced demolished buildings with the current park layout.
facts.sourceQuote: Veel bebouwing werd daarbij afgebroken en er vond in de periode 2011 tot 2015 een herinrichting plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A lot of buildings were demolished and a redesign took place between 2011 and 2015.

facts.text: Park Somerlust shares its name origin with a former country estate along the river.
facts.sourceQuote: Zowel Park Somerlust als het Bella Vistapark ontlenen hun naam aan voormalige buitenplaatsen langs de Amstel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both Park Somerlust and the Bella Vistapark derive their names from former country estates along the Amstel.

facts.text: A 1966 landmark for rowing club RIC features a sloping river section and a screened terrace.
facts.sourceQuote: Een daarvan is een gezichtsbepalend gebouw aan de Amstel uit 1966 ontworpen door architecten Ab Gmelig Meyling en Piet Zanstra voor roeivereniging RIC. Opvallend is het schuin oplopend gedeelte aan de rivier en de afscherming van een terras.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of these is a landmark building on the Amstel from 1966 designed by architects Ab Gmelig Meyling and Piet Zanstra for rowing club RIC. Notable is the sloping section on the river and the screening of a terrace.

facts.text: The former Zuidergasfabriek engineering house was renovated into the restaurant tHUIS on the AMSTEL.
facts.sourceQuote: De voormalige ingenieurswoning van de Zuidergasfabriek is gerenoveerd tot restaurant tHUIS aan de AMSTEL.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former engineering house of the Zuidergasfabriek has been renovated into a restaurant tHUIS on the AMSTEL.

features.name: Darwinplantsoen
features.opening: Darwinplantsoen is a street and a park in the Dutch capital Amsterdam, more specifically in Amsterdam-Oost, Watergraafsmeer.

facts.text: Large plots held spacious villas with garages, featuring plenty of open space between the homes.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen aan de oostkant van de straat op voor plaatselijke begrippen ruime kavels grote huizen te staan in de bouwstijl van twee-onder-een-kap en een-onder-een-kap met garage, met veel ruimte tussen de villa's.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the east side of the street, according to local terminology, large houses in the style of two-storey and one-storey houses with garage were built on large plots of land, with plenty of space between the villas.

facts.text: Original residents looked out over meadows from the last farm, which are now sports fields today.
facts.sourceQuote: De woningen zagen uit op de weiden van de laatste boerderij in Oost, wat nu sportvelden zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The houses looked out over the meadows of the last farm in the east, which are now sports fields.

facts.text: Landscape architect Hans Warnau created the park's original design in 1952.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp uit 1952 is van tuin- en landschapsarchitect Hans Warnau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 1952 design was by garden and landscape architect Hans Warnau.

facts.text: Construction did not begin until 1963, eleven years after the initial design was completed.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel park en tuin in 1952 ontworpen zijn, kwam het pas tot uitvoering in 1963, men zag toen ook een verbinding naar het Prins Bernhardpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the park and garden were designed in 1952, it was not implemented until 1963, at that time a connection to Prins Bernhardpark was also seen.

facts.text: The layout features four distinct compartments tailored to specific age groups and activities.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de invulling van de ruimtes hield Warnau rekening met de behoeftes van verschillende leeftijdsgroepen in de wijk, dat leidde tot vier compartimenten met een eigen functie en opzet. Een rozentuin voor ouderen Een speelweide voor algemeen gebruik Een vasteplantentuin met taxushagen voor plantenliefhebbers Een verhard bomenplein met zandbak en speelvijver voor kinderen en schaduwzoekers De rozentuin en de vasteplantentuin werden op hetzelfde niveau aangelegd als de bebouwing om de relatie tussen beiden te versterken en om het onderscheid te benadrukken tussen verfijnde en eenvoudige ruimtes voor sport en spel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When filling the spaces, Warnau took into account the needs of different age groups in the neighborhood, which led to four compartments with their own function and layout. A rose garden for the elderly A play meadow for general use A perennial plant garden with boxwood hedges for plant lovers A paved tree square with sandpit and play pond for children and shade seekers The rose garden and the perennial plant garden were laid out at the same level as the buildings to strengthen the relationship between the two and to emphasize the distinction between sophisticated and simple spaces for sports and play.

facts.text: A 2017 renovation added wadis to improve soil drainage while creating playful hills.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2017 is het park flink op de schop genomen en zijn er wadi's aangelegd. Dit vooral om de drainage van de bodem te verbeteren. Er zijn heuvels gekomen met een diverse beplanting die het geheel een speels aanzien geeft.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017 the park was given a good overhaul and wadis were created. This is mainly to improve soil drainage. Hills have come with a diverse planting that gives the whole thing a playful appearance.

features.name: Beatrixpark
features.opening: The Beatrixpark is a park in the Amsterdam-Zuid borough and is located in the "Prinses Irenebuurt" residential area.

facts.text: During World War II, the park temporarily bore the name Diepenbrockpark from 1942 to 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: In June 1938, it was already given the name Beatrixpark and during World War II, from 1942 to 1945, it was temporarily called "Diepenbrockpark".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June 1938, it was already given the name Beatrixpark and during World War II, from 1942 to 1945, it was temporarily called "Diepenbrockpark".

facts.text: Unemployed workers built the park as a public works project to provide employment.
facts.sourceQuote: The decision was made to have the park created by unemployed people ("werkverschaffingsproject").
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The decision was made to have the park created by unemployed people ("werkverschaffingsproject").

facts.text: Dutch architect Jakoba Mulder designed the oldest section of this city park.
facts.sourceQuote: The design for the oldest part of the park was by the Dutch architect Jakoba Mulder.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design for the oldest part of the park was by the Dutch architect Jakoba Mulder.

facts.text: In 1972, this site hosted a major garden and agricultural exhibition known as Floriade.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1972, part of the park, together with the Amstelpark, was the site of the Floriade garden and agricultural exhibition.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1972, part of the park, together with the Amstelpark, was the site of the Floriade garden and agricultural exhibition.

features.name: Museum Square
features.opening: The Museumplein (Dutch pronunciation: [myˌzeːjʏmˈplɛin]; English: Museum Square) is a public space in the Museumkwartier neighbourhood of the Amsterdam-Zuid…

facts.text: A 1999 reconstruction by Sven-Ingvar Andersson added underground parking and a supermarket.
facts.sourceQuote: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.

facts.text: The famous I AMsterdam sign stood here until city officials removed it in December 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.

facts.text: Visitors can explore the House of Bols and the Diamond Museum on this site.
facts.sourceQuote: Consulate General of Turkey Consulate General of the United States Concertgebouw Stedelijk Museum Van Gogh Museum House of Bols Diamond Museum Coster Diamonds Rijksmuseum Moco Museum (opened at the end of May 2016)
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Consulate General of Turkey Consulate General of the United States Concertgebouw Stedelijk Museum Van Gogh Museum House of Bols Diamond Museum Coster Diamonds Rijksmuseum Moco Museum (opened at the end of May 2016)

features.name: Professor Joop van Stigtpark
features.opening: Professor Joop van Stigtpark is the unofficial name of a park-like environment in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: A street sign was unveiled in 2013 by a council member alongside the architect's son André.
facts.sourceQuote: Het “straatnaambord” werd op 13 december 2013 onthuld door een van de stadsdeelraadsleden in aanwezigheid van zoon André van Stigt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The "street sign" was unveiled on December 13, 2013 by one of the borough council members in the presence of son André van Stigt.

features.name: Park de Schinkeleilanden
features.opening: The Park Schinkeleilanden is located in Amsterdam-Zuid west of the Olympic Stadium along the Schinkel.

facts.text: The Frans Otten Stadium has occupied the site since 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2004 staat hier het Frans Otten Stadion.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2004, the Frans Otten Stadium has been located here.

facts.text: Landscape architects Sant and Co designed this four-island park.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Park Schinkeleilanden is ontworpen door het Amsterdamse landschapsarchitectenbureau Sant en Co. Het park bestaat nu uit vier eilanden met ieder een eigen karakter en is bedoeld voor algemene recreatie en sportbeoefening.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Park Schinkeleilanden was designed by the Amsterdam landscape architecture firm Sant and Co. The park now consists of four islands each with its own character and is intended for general recreation and sports.

facts.text: A continuous cycle path named Piet Kranenbergpad opened here in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: Er langs loopt het in 2007 aangelegde Piet Kranenbergpad, een doorgaand fiets- en voetpad, vanaf de Havenstraat bij het Haarlemmermeerstation naar het Amsterdamse Bos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Along it runs the Piet Kranenbergpad, a continuous cycle and footpath, built in 2007, from Havenstraat near the Haarlemmermeer station to the Amsterdamse Bos.

features.name: Bijlmerweide
features.opening: The Bijlmerweide is a park in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: Artist Peter Vial replaced neglected signs with mosaic copies that lack legal validity.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze kunstenaar trof bij een bezoek aan het park verwaarloosde verkeersborden aan en drong aan op vernieuwing. Dit zou echter tijden gaan duren, dus verving hij ze door eigen exemplaren, niet geschilderd, maar voorzien van mozaïek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During a visit to the park, this artist found neglected traffic signs and called for renewal. However, this would take a long time, so he replaced them with his own copies, not painted, but equipped with mosaic.

facts.text: Municipal authorities labeled the mosaic signs as art expressions to protect them from demolition.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze bleken echter niet rechtsgeldig te zijn en moesten dus aangevuld worden door middel van “echte” verkeersborden. Om deze kleine kunstwerkjes voor sloop te behoeden kregen ze een gemeentelijke plaatje “kunstuiting” onder het bord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, these were not deemed legally valid and therefore had to be supplemented by "real" traffic signs. In order to protect these small works of art from demolition, they received a municipal picture of "art expression" under the sign.

facts.text: A dedicated bicycle and pedestrian bridge named Veeneik connects the park across the Gaasp river.
facts.sourceQuote: De Veeneikbrug, een fiets- en voetgangersbrug, verbindt de Bijlmerweide over de Gaasp met het Diemerbos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Veeneik Bridge, a bicycle and pedestrian bridge, connects the Bijlmerweide over the Gaasp to the Diemerbos.

facts.text: The Veeneik Bridge spans the Gaasp to link Bijlmerweide directly with the Diemerbos forest.
facts.sourceQuote: De Veeneikbrug, een fiets- en voetgangersbrug, verbindt de Bijlmerweide over de Gaasp met het Diemerbos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Veeneik Bridge, a bicycle and pedestrian bridge, connects the Bijlmerweide over the Gaasp to the Diemerbos.

features.name: Botanical Garden Zuidas
features.opening: The Botanic Garden Zuidas (Dutch: Botanische tuin Zuidas) is a botanical garden belonging to Vrije Universiteit in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: The garden survived a 2010 public protest that saved it from hospital expansion plans.
facts.sourceQuote: The garden's existence was threatened in 2009, when plans for an expansion of the university hospital called for it to be removed. In 2010, after widespread popular protest, the VU announced the garden could remain.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden's existence was threatened in 2009, when plans for an expansion of the university hospital called for it to be removed. In 2010, after widespread popular protest, the VU announced the garden could remain.

facts.text: Botanical Garden Zuidas adopted its current name in 2016 to reflect the surrounding district.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 the garden changed its name from Hortus Botanicus Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (which was often abbreviated to VU-Hortus) to its current name, after the better known Zuidas development area it is in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016 the garden changed its name from Hortus Botanicus Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (which was often abbreviated to VU-Hortus) to its current name, after the better known Zuidas development area it is in.

facts.text: About one thousand square metres of the site are occupied by glass-houses within the hectare.
facts.sourceQuote: It is situated behind the University Medical Centre, and includes a garden area of about 1 hectare (2.5 acres) of which about 1,000 square metres (11,000 sq ft) is occupied by glass-houses.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is situated behind the University Medical Centre, and includes a garden area of about 1 hectare (2.5 acres) of which about 1,000 square metres (11,000 sq ft) is occupied by glass-houses.

features.name: Carel Willinkplantsoen
features.opening: The Carel Willinkplantsoen is a relatively small park in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Carel Willinkplantsoen received its official name only in 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen, dat pas in 1999 zijn naam kreeg, is genoemd naar de kunstschilder Carel Willink.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden, which was only given its name in 1999, is named after the artist Carel Willink.

facts.text: Stadhouderskade makes a strange turn here to cross the Boerenwetering canal.
facts.sourceQuote: De Stadhouderskade maakt ter plaatse een vreemde bocht om de Boerenwetering te kruisen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Stadhouderskade makes a strange turn on site to cross the Boerenwetering.

facts.text: Mayor Schelto Patijn unveiled the statue on March 3, 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld werd op 3 maart 2000 onthuld door burgemeester Schelto Patijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue was unveiled on March 3, 2000 by Mayor Schelto Patijn.

features.name: Julianapark
features.opening: The Julianapark, named in 1939 after Princess Juliana, was a park but is now a residential area in Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer.

facts.text: A section of the original park once featured grazing cows on its grasslands.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van het park bleef weidelandschap met grazende koeien.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Part of the park remained grassland with grazing cows.

features.name: Park De Kuil
features.opening: Park de Kuil is a park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Locals called the low-lying plain 'the Kuil' long before it became a park.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebied stond bij de plaatselijke bevolking vanwege de lage ligging destijds bekend als de Kuil en werd naast voor het uitlaten van honden ook veelvuldig gebruikt voor sport en spel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area was known to the local population at the time as the Kuil due to its low elevation and was also frequently used for sports and play in addition to walking dogs.

facts.text: Landscape architect Pieter Boekschooten led the area's transformation into an ecological park.
facts.sourceQuote: Begin 21e eeuw is het gebied onder leiding van landschapsarchitect Pieter Boekschooten veranderd in het eerste ecologische park van Geuzenveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of the 21st century, under the leadership of landscape architect Pieter Boekschooten, the area was transformed into the first ecological park of Geuzenveld.

facts.text: Excavated wet spots were turned into ponds while freed land created playgrounds.
facts.sourceQuote: De grond moest gedraineerd worden en de natte plekken werden uitgegraven, daarmee ontstonden er vijvers. Met de vrijgekomen grond werden speelterreinen gemaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ground had to be drained and the wet spots were excavated, creating ponds. Playgrounds were made with the land that was freed up.

facts.text: The Tower Gate Bridge, designed by Gert Vos in 1995, is also known as bridge 1828.
facts.sourceQuote: Een kunstwerk wat in beide categorieën geplaatst is, is brug 1828, de zogenaamde Torenpoortbrug uit 1995 geplaatst naar een ontwerp van Gert Vos.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A work of art that is placed in both categories is bridge 1828, the so-called Tower Gate Bridge from 1995 placed according to a design by Gert Vos.

facts.text: Hans Mantje created the two-part artwork titled Plastic in landscape for the park's center.
facts.sourceQuote: Midden in het park staat/ligt het tweedelige kunstwerk Plastiek in landschap van Hans Mantje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the middle of the park stands/lies the two-part artwork Plastic in landscape by Hans Mantje.

features.name: Rietlandpark
features.opening: The Rietlandpark in Amsterdam-Oost was named in 2005 and is named after the Stads Rietlanden.

facts.text: Until roughly 1880, the site was an uninhabited, swampy area covered in reeds outside the dikes.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit was tot omstreeks 1880 een buitendijks onbebouwd, deels moerassig en met riet begroeid gebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until around 1880, this was an uninhabited, partly swampy and reed-covered area outside the dikes.

facts.text: The railway yard and trade areas were constructed here at the end of the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Eind 19e eeuw werden hier handelsterreinen en een rangeerterrein van de spoorwegen aangelegd als middelpunt van het Oostelijk Havengebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the end of the 19th century, trade areas and a railway yard were built here as the center of the Eastern Harbor Area.

features.name: Snodenhoekpark
features.opening: The Snodenhoekpark is a small park and a street in the Gaasperdam district in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: Construction occurred in the mid-1980s alongside the Reigersbos district.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park is midden jaren 80 aangelegd, gelijktijdig met de wijk Reigersbos, onderdeel van Gaasperdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was built in the mid-1980s, at the same time as the Reigersbos district, part of Gaasperdam.

features.name: Staalmanpark
features.opening: The Staalmanpark is a city park in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West.

facts.text: The neighborhood underwent major demolition and new construction between 2008 and 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 2008 tot 2022 was/is sanering van de wijk (Staalmanpleinbuurt) noodzakelijk waarbij er gesloopt werd alsook nieuwbouw werd gepleegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 2008 to 2022, redevelopment of the district (Staalmanplein neighborhood) was/is necessary, during which demolition was carried out as well as new construction.

facts.text: Houses nearby by Cornelis Keesman and Arthur Staal hold just under full monument status.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen park en plein ligt een wijkje met woningen van Cornelis Keesman en Arthur Staal, dat net geen monumentstatus heeft (orde 2 in plaats van orde 1) en in de genoemde periode grondig gerenoveerd wordt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between the park and the square is a small neighborhood with houses by Cornelis Keesman and Arthur Staal, which is just under monument status (order 2 instead of order 1) and is being thoroughly renovated during the period mentioned.

facts.text: An ancient electricity house remains in the northwest corner of the park.
facts.sourceQuote: Een overblijfsel uit oude tijden is het elektriciteitshuisje in de noordwesthoek van het park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A remnant of ancient times is the electricity house in the northwest corner of the park.

features.name: Lutkemeerpark
features.opening: The Lutkemeerpark is the unofficial name of a park in the west of the Lutkemeerpolder.

facts.text: A bridge on Ethnostreet cuts through the park at its narrowest point, accessible only to pedestrians and cyclists.
facts.sourceQuote: De Etnastraat met daarin brug 2128 doorsnijdt het park op haar smalste punt, maar is daar alleen toegankelijk voor voetgangers en fietsers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Ethnostreet, with bridge 2128 crossing it, cuts through the park at its narrowest point, but is only accessible to pedestrians and cyclists there.

facts.text: Unpaved paths, grit-covered trails, and elevated grassland cross the watery area.
facts.sourceQuote: Het waterig gebied wordt doorsneden door meest onverharde wandelpaden, soms bestrooid met grit, soms onbestrooid en soms ook gewoon bestaand uit verhoogd grasland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The watery area is crossed by mostly unpaved walking paths, sometimes covered with grit, sometimes unpaved and sometimes simply consisting of elevated grassland.

facts.text: The entire area is hidden behind various reed collars.
facts.sourceQuote: Het geheel gaat schuil achter allerlei rietkragen.
