facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The whole thing is hidden behind all kinds of reed collars.

features.name: Amstelpark
features.opening: The Amstelpark is a 45-hectare (110-acre) urban park in Buitenveldert-Oost, in the borough of Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands.

facts.text: The name Amstelpark was transferred to this site after the original green space north of the river became Martin Luther Kingpark.
facts.sourceQuote: The name Amstelpark predates the present park. An earlier green space farther north along the Amstel was known by that name until 1968, when it was renamed the Martin Luther Kingpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Amstelpark predates the present park. An earlier green space farther north along the Amstel was known by that name until 1968, when it was renamed the Martin Luther Kingpark.

facts.text: An earlier location bearing this name was renamed in 1968 and is now known as Martin Luther Kingpark.
facts.sourceQuote: An earlier green space farther north along the Amstel was known by that name until 1968, when it was renamed the Martin Luther Kingpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An earlier green space farther north along the Amstel was known by that name until 1968, when it was renamed the Martin Luther Kingpark.

facts.text: Historical archives label old photos of the former northern site as 'Amstelpark, later: Martin Luther Kingpark'.
facts.sourceQuote: The Amsterdam City Archives consequently describes historical images of that site as "Amstelpark, later: Martin Luther Kingpark".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Amsterdam City Archives consequently describes historical images of that site as "Amstelpark, later: Martin Luther Kingpark".

features.name: Hollandse Tuin
features.opening: The Hollandse Tuin is a 19th-century monumental garden within the Amsterdam zoo Artis.

facts.text: Four marble sculptures representing the seasons were permanently installed at the garden's corners in the 1930s.
facts.sourceQuote: In de tuin zijn ook vier marmeren sculpturen geplaatst, die de vier seizoenen verbeelden. De vier werden vermoedelijk rond 1882 door Artis werden aangekocht en kregen in de jaren dertig van de twintigste eeuw een vaste plek op de hoeken van de tuin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Four marble sculptures depicting the four seasons are also placed in the garden. The four were probably bought by Artis around 1882 and were given a permanent place on the corners of the garden in the 1930s of the twentieth century.

facts.text: A female figure and lion at the monument base reference the allegory of the Hollandse virgin and Leo Belgicus.
facts.sourceQuote: De vrouwenfiguur en leeuw onderaan lijken te verwijzen naar de bekende allegorie van de Hollandse maagd en de 'Leo Belgicus'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The female figure and lion at the bottom seem to refer to the well-known allegory of the Hollandse virgin and the 'Leo Belgicus'.

facts.text: The garden features two symmetrical borders flanking a central axis with rectangular plots ending in concave curves.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij heeft twee symmetrische perken die aan weerszijden van een middenas zijn aangelegd. De rechthoekige perken hebben een concave afronding aan de kant van het gedenkteken voor Westerman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has two symmetrical borders that are laid out on either side of a central axis. The rectangular plots have a concave finish on the side of the Westerman memorial.

facts.text: Four marble statues representing the seasons stand in the corners on natural stone bases.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de hoeken, aan weerszijden van de middenas, staan 19e-eeuwse marmeren beelden, allegorische voorstellingen van de vier seizoenen, op natuurstenen sokkels met profielen en spaarvelden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the corners, on either side of the central axis, stand 19th-century marble statues, allegorical representations of the four seasons, on natural stone bases with profiles and recessed fields.

facts.text: Originally spanning four axles, the garden was later reduced to approximately half its initial size.
facts.sourceQuote: De Hollandse Tuin was aanvankelijk een stuk groter, met vier assen die leidden naar een centraal rond perk. De huidige tuin is ongeveer half zo groot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hollandse Tuin was initially much larger, with four axles leading to a central circular enclosure. The current garden is about half the size.

features.name: Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark
features.opening: The Gijsbrecht van Aemstelpark is a linear urban park in Buitenveldert, in the borough of Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands.

facts.text: Elevated rope bridges let red squirrels cross roads between the Amsterdamse Bos and Amstelpark.
facts.sourceQuote: These include elevated rope bridges that allow red squirrels to move between trees on opposite sides of the roads and between the larger habitats of the Amsterdamse Bos and Amstelpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These include elevated rope bridges that allow red squirrels to move between trees on opposite sides of the roads and between the larger habitats of the Amsterdamse Bos and Amstelpark.

features.name: Vondelpark
features.opening: The Vondelpark (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈvɔndəlˌpɑr(ə)k]) is a public urban park of 47 hectares (120 acres) in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: English dream pop band Vondelpark took their name directly from the Amsterdam park.
facts.sourceQuote: The English dream pop band Vondelpark took their name from the park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The English dream pop band Vondelpark took their name from the park.

facts.text: Originally called Nieuwe Park, it was later renamed Vondelpark after the 17th-century poet Joost van den Vondel.
facts.sourceQuote: The park was opened in 1865 and originally named Nieuwe Park (English: New Park), but later renamed Vondelpark, after the 17th-century playwright and poet Joost van den Vondel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was opened in 1865 and originally named Nieuwe Park (English: New Park), but later renamed Vondelpark, after the 17th-century playwright and poet Joost van den Vondel.

facts.text: Inside the grounds you will find an open-air theatre, a playground, and several food service facilities.
facts.sourceQuote: Within the park is an open-air theatre, a playground and several food service facilities.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Within the park is an open-air theatre, a playground and several food service facilities.

features.name: Deutzenhofje
features.opening: The Deutzen Hofje or Deutzenhofje is a 17th-century hofje on the Prinsengracht 857 in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The gablestone inscription honors Agneta's love and faith for the poor.
facts.sourceQuote: On the gablestone in front is inscribed: Agneta Deutz laat hier haar liefde en godsdienst blijken Den Armen tot een troost, tot voorbeeld aan de rijken Anno 1695 On the top floor the regent's room has a view over the canal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the gablestone in front is inscribed: Agneta Deutz laat hier haar liefde en godsdienst blijken Den Armen tot een troost, tot voorbeeld aan de rijken Anno 1695 On the top floor the regent's room has a view over the canal.

facts.text: An old pump remains in the garden planted with summer flowers.
facts.sourceQuote: The garden has an old pump and is planted with flowers in the summer months.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden has an old pump and is planted with flowers in the summer months.

facts.text: Two outer double houses serve as rental homes to generate income for the hofje.
facts.sourceQuote: The two outer double houses are rental homes that add to the hofje's income.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The two outer double houses are rental homes that add to the hofje's income.

features.name: Sloterpark
features.opening: Sloterpark is an urban park in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: In 1990 the lake area split into three boroughs before joining Nieuw-West in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: When the city established its boroughs in 1990, the lake was divided into three: Geuzenveld-Slotermeer, Slotervaart and Osdorp. Since 2010, it has been an integral part of the Nieuw-West borough.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the city established its boroughs in 1990, the lake was divided into three: Geuzenveld-Slotermeer, Slotervaart and Osdorp. Since 2010, it has been an integral part of the Nieuw-West borough.

facts.text: Visitors can rent canoes, surfboards, and sailing boats along with taking lessons.
facts.sourceQuote: Canoes, surfboards and sailing boats are available for rent including lessons.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Canoes, surfboards and sailing boats are available for rent including lessons.

facts.text: The lake features a beach adjacent to a swimming pool complex with multiple pools.
facts.sourceQuote: The lake has a beach with a nearby swimming pool which includes an outdoor pool, a paddling pool, a sunbathing area and a playground.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The lake has a beach with a nearby swimming pool which includes an outdoor pool, a paddling pool, a sunbathing area and a playground.

features.name: Rembrandtpark
features.opening: Rembrandtpark (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈrɛmbrɑntˌpɑr(ə)k]) is an urban park in Nieuw-West, Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Construction finished in 1973, creating a 45-hectare green space.
facts.sourceQuote: The park was completed in 1973 and has a surface area of 45 hectares (110 acres) which includes a petting zoo and playgrounds.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was completed in 1973 and has a surface area of 45 hectares (110 acres) which includes a petting zoo and playgrounds.

facts.text: Visitors can spot 37 bird species and six types of bats here.
facts.sourceQuote: In the park, 37 bird species including the common buzzard (Buteo buteo), 35 bee species including the orange-horned nomad bee (Nomada fulvicornis), and 6 bat species including the pond bat (Myotis dasycneme) have been observed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park, 37 bird species including the common buzzard (Buteo buteo), 35 bee species including the orange-horned nomad bee (Nomada fulvicornis), and 6 bat species including the pond bat (Myotis dasycneme) have been observed.

facts.text: Three streets cross the elongated park, dividing it into four distinct sections.
facts.sourceQuote: The elongated park is crossed from east to west by the streets Jan van Galenstraat, Postjesweg, and Cornelis Lelylaan, which divides the park into four sections.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The elongated park is crossed from east to west by the streets Jan van Galenstraat, Postjesweg, and Cornelis Lelylaan, which divides the park into four sections.

features.name: Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen
features.opening: The Domela Nieuwenhuisplantsoen is a small garden in the shape of a triangle in the Spaarndammerbuurt neighborhood in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: The garden was laid out in 1972 on the site of a demolished church whose foundations remain visible.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen is in 1972 aangelegd op het terrein van de in 1968 gesloopte Maria Magdelenakerk, waarvan de funderingsresten nog in het park terug te vinden zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden was laid out in 1972 on the site of the Maria Magdalenakerk, which was demolished in 1968, whose foundation remains can still be found in the park.

facts.text: Residents requested the name in 1972 because Domela Nieuwenhuis once lived nearby on the Haarlemmerdijk.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plantsoen kreeg op 20 december 1972 op verzoek van de bewoners deze naam omdat Domela Nieuwenhuis in de nabijheid op de Haarlemmerdijk had gewoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was given this name on December 20, 1972 at the request of the residents because Domela Nieuwenhuis had lived nearby on the Haarlemmerdijk.

facts.text: A major renovation in 2018 and 2019 added reproduced old arcades to mark the garden's boundary.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de renovatie 2018/2019 werden diverse ingrepen gedaan in het plantsoen. Er kwamen nagebootste oude boogmuren die de oorspronkelijke aanvulden als terreinafscheiding.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the renovation 2018/2019, various interventions were carried out in the garden. Reproduced old arcades were added to complement the original ones as a boundary marker.

facts.text: The garden features an open dome for climbing plants alongside artwork titled Looplijnen by Elspeth Pikaar.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwam voorts een open koepel waartegen klimplanten konden opklimmen en het kunstwerk Looplijnen van Elspeth Pikaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There was also an open dome against which climbing plants could climb and the artwork Looplijnen by Elspeth Pikaar.

facts.text: A historic blue municipal postbox designed by Anton Kurvers stands here in the Amsterdam School style.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is tevens een historische blauwe gemeentegirobus te vinden, ontworpen door Anton Kurvers in de stijl van de Amsterdamse School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is also a historic blue municipal postbox to be found, designed by Anton Kurvers in the style of the Amsterdam School.

features.name: Diemerpark
features.opening: Diemerpark is the largest urban park in Amsterdam with an area of around 90 hectares, making it about twice as large as the famous Vondelpark in…

facts.text: Visitors cannot dig holes or plant deep-rooted trees taller than five meters because of the sealed landfill beneath.
facts.sourceQuote: As a result, visitors are not allowed to dig holes, and it is not possible to leave deep-rooted trees of more than 5 meters high there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result, visitors are not allowed to dig holes, and it is not possible to leave deep-rooted trees of more than 5 meters high there.

features.name: Naardermeer
features.opening: The Naardermeer is a protected nature reserve on the northwestern border of the Gooi, located between Muiderberg, Naarden, Hilversumse Meent and Weesp, in the…

facts.text: Dikes named Keverdijk and Broekdijk were built along the north and south sides respectively.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook langs het Naardermeer werd een aantal dijken aangelegd. Aan de noordzijde de Keverdijk en aan de zuidzijde de Broekdijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A number of dikes were also built along the Naardermeer. On the north side the Keverdijk and on the south side the Broekdijk.

facts.text: A 1383 dam eliminated tidal ebb and flow by cutting off the Zuiderzee influence.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1383 werd de verbinding tussen de Vecht en het Naardermeer nabij het gehucht Uitermeer afgedamd door de bouw van de Uitermeerse dam. Hierdoor werd de invloed van de Zuiderzee uitgebannen en was er niet langer sprake van eb en vloed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1383, the connection between the Vecht and the Naardermeer near the hamlet of Uitermeer was dammed by the construction of the Uitermeerse dam. This eliminated the influence of the Zuiderzee and there was no longer any ebb and flow.

features.name: Natuurpark Vrije Geer
features.opening: The Natuurpark Vrije Geer is a small green area near the village of Sloten with an area of more than 4 hectares.

facts.text: The village of Sloten faced total demolition when new housing replaced the horticultural area in the 1990s.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen in de jaren negentig ook het Tuinbouwgebied Sloten moest wijken voor de nieuwbouwwijk Nieuw Sloten dreigde het dorp Sloten geheel ingebouwd te raken door nieuwbouwwijken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Horticultural Area Sloten also had to make way for the new residential area Nieuw Sloten in the 1990s, the village of Sloten was threatened with being completely built over by new residential areas.

features.name: Heemtuin Sloterpark
features.opening: The Heemtuin Sloterpark is located in the Sloterpark west of the Sloterplas in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: The terrain was elevated in the 1950s before the area remained untouched for a long time.
facts.sourceQuote: Na ophoging van het terrein in de jaren vijftig bleef dit gebied lange tijd onaangeroerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the elevation of the terrain in the 1950s, this area remained untouched for a long time.

facts.text: Construction of the community garden began in 1975 with the planting of its first trees.
facts.sourceQuote: Met de aanleg van de heemtuin werd in 1975 begonnen, toen de eerste bomen werden geplant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the community garden began in 1975, when the first trees were planted.

facts.text: Soil from elsewhere including peat, sand, clay and chalk was brought in to create varied conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarna werden er hoogteverschillen in het terrein gemaakt en ook grond van elders werd aangevoerd, zoals veen, zand, klei en mergelkalk, zodat in zeer gevarieerde milieuomstandigheden een keur aan plantensoorten kon worden ingezaaid en geplant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, height differences were made in the terrain and soil from elsewhere was also brought in, such as peat, sand, clay and chalk, so that a variety of plant species could be sown and planted in very varied environmental conditions.

facts.text: A Nature and Environment Education Center named 'Floating Ice' was built in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: Naast de heemtuin is in 2006 een Natuur en Milieu Educatiecentrum (NME) verrezen, de 'Drijfsijs'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to the community garden, a Nature and Environment Education Center (NME) was built in 2006, the 'Floating Ice'.

features.name: Frederik Hendrikplantsoen
features.opening: Frederik Hendrikplantsoen is a park in Amsterdam West, on the edge of the Jordaan in one of the greenest historic neighbourhoods of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Recent extensive investment and redevelopment occurred after consultation with the local community.
facts.sourceQuote: The park is located in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt Neighbourhood and has recently undergone extensive investment and redevelopment in consultation with the local community.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park is located in the Frederik Hendrikbuurt Neighbourhood and has recently undergone extensive investment and redevelopment in consultation with the local community.

features.name: Martin Luther Kingpark
features.opening: The Martin Luther Kingpark is a city park in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Martin Luther Kingpark received its name in 1968 following the murder of its namesake that same year.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park werd in 1968 vernoemd naar de dat jaar vermoorde Amerikaanse predikant Martin Luther King.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was named in 1968 after the American preacher Martin Luther King, who was murdered that year.

facts.text: The annual Parade festival has been hosted within Martin Luther Kingpark every year since 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park wordt sinds 1990 jaarlijks de Parade gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1990, the Parade has been held annually in the park.

features.name: Park Frankendael
features.opening: Frankendael is one of two remaining buitenplaats (country estates) in Amsterdam (the other is Amstelrust).

facts.text: The estate was named Frankendael after a Protestant refuge in Germany where the founder's grandfather found hospitality.
facts.sourceQuote: Balde named the estate Frankendael, a name derived from Frankenthal, a place of refuge for Protestants near Worms, where his grandfather had found hospitality.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Balde named the estate Frankendael, a name derived from Frankenthal, a place of refuge for Protestants near Worms, where his grandfather had found hospitality.

facts.text: A marble fountain originally from the Driemond estate near Weesp stands at the front of the house along the canal.
facts.sourceQuote: At the front of the house at the canal is a marble fountain that was purchased in 1770 and originally came from the Driemond country estate near Weesp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the front of the house at the canal is a marble fountain that was purchased in 1770 and originally came from the Driemond country estate near Weesp.

facts.text: Between 1927 and 1956, the villa gardens hosted open-air theatre performances during the summer months.
facts.sourceQuote: Between 1927 and 1956, the gardens of the villa hosted open-air theatre performances in the summer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1927 and 1956, the gardens of the villa hosted open-air theatre performances in the summer.

facts.text: The estate is one of only two remaining buitenplaats country estates in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: Frankendael is one of two remaining buitenplaats (country estates) in Amsterdam (the other is Amstelrust).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Frankendael is one of two remaining buitenplaats (country estates) in Amsterdam (the other is Amstelrust).

features.name: Westerpark
features.opening: The Westerpark (English: Western Park) is a public urban park in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Architect Isaac Gosschalk designed the buildings in Dutch neo-renaissance style under director J. Pazzani.
facts.sourceQuote: The buildings are designed by architect Isaac Gosschalk in the then-popular Dutch neo-renaissance style under the supervision of J. Pazzani, director of the new gas plant, who would decide on the location of the various buildings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The buildings are designed by architect Isaac Gosschalk in the then-popular Dutch neo-renaissance style under the supervision of J. Pazzani, director of the new gas plant, who would decide on the location of the various buildings.

facts.text: The city ended the private concession in 1898 and added a coke gas plant to the facility.
facts.sourceQuote: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.

facts.text: Two large coal gas containers from the original industrial era remain visible today.
facts.sourceQuote: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.

facts.text: The former borough and current neighborhood both take their name from this park.
facts.sourceQuote: The former borough (stadsdeel) of Westerpark is named after the park, as is the current neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former borough (stadsdeel) of Westerpark is named after the park, as is the current neighborhood.

facts.text: The verdant space formerly housed the Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg.
facts.sourceQuote: The verdant space of the former Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg has become a place for cultural avant-garde businesses and events.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The verdant space of the former Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg has become a place for cultural avant-garde businesses and events.

features.name: De Krommert
features.opening: De Krommert (also known as De Krommerdt) is a neighborhood in the Amsterdam district of West, named after the De Krommert waterway.

facts.text: A tram bridge over the ditch, numbered 249, was constructed in 1904.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen de tramlijn Amsterdam - Haarlem - Zandvoort in 1904 door de ESM werd aangelegd kwam er een brug over De Krommert; deze kreeg brugnummer 249.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Amsterdam - Haarlem - Zandvoort tram line was laid by the ESM in 1904, a bridge was built over De Krommert; this was given bridge number 249.

facts.text: Two road segments meet at nearly a right angle to guide trams toward Sloterdijk.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarbij staan twee delen van de Admiraal de Ruijterweg in een bijna rechte hoek op elkaar. De weg maakt een flauwe bocht om de tram de boog te kunnen laten nemen in de richting Sloterdijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Two parts of the Admiraal de Ruijterweg are standing next to each other at almost a right angle. The road makes a slight turn so that the tram can take the bend in the direction of Sloterdijk.

facts.text: The nearby Krommertstraat honors a ditch that was dammed in 1931.
facts.sourceQuote: In de buurt ligt sinds 1925 de Krommertstraat, vernoemd naar de daar in 1931 gedempte sloot.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1925, the Krommertstraat has been located nearby, named after the ditch that was dammed there in 1931.

features.name: Siegerpark
features.opening: The Siegerpark is a small city park on the Sloterweg in the Riekerpolder in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Anna Laura Doris de Greeff, wife of Wilhelm Sieger, opened the grounds with a garden and playground on Ascension Day 1937.
facts.sourceQuote: Opening vond plaats op Hemelvaartsdag 1937. Siegers vrouw, Anna Laura Doris de Greeff opende het terrein met een siertuin, bijentuin, proeftuin en speeltuin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Opening took place on Ascension Day 1937. Siegers' wife, Anna Laura Doris de Greeff, opened the grounds with a garden, bee garden, tasting garden and playground.

facts.text: A large southern section vanished in the 1960s to make way for a national road.
facts.sourceQuote: Door aanleg van een te vernieuwen rijksweg 4 (Haagse weg) ging in de jaren zestig aan de zuidzijde een flink stuk van het park verloren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the construction of a to be renewed national road 4 (Haagse weg), a large part of the park was lost on the south side in the 1960s.

facts.text: The youth series SpangaS filmed multiple scenes here between 2011 and 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Siegerpark was van 2011 tot en met 2014 een aantal keren het decor voor de jeugdserie SpangaS.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Siegerpark was the setting for the youth series SpangaS several times from 2011 to 2014.

features.name: Noorderpark
features.opening: The Noorderpark is a park in Amsterdam-North.

facts.text: West 8 designed maple leaf motifs that appear on railings, paths, and concrete decorations throughout the grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: West 8 ontwierp ook een thema voor het park bestaande uit een hederabladerenmotief dat in het park op verschillende plekken terugkomt, waaronder in metalen brugleuningen en hekwerken, versiering op de paden en als 3D-motief in beton.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: West 8 also designed a theme for the park consisting of a maple leaf motif that recurs in the park in various places, including in metal bridge railings and fencing, decoration on the paths and as a 3D motif in concrete.

facts.text: The Noorderparkbad replaced the outdated Floraparkbad in a new public swimming pool.
facts.sourceQuote: In het parkdeel ten westen van het Noordhollandsch Kanaal (voormalig Florapark) is ter vervanging van het gedateerde Floraparkbad een nieuw openbaar zwembad gebouwd; het Noorderparkbad, met een grand café.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park area west of the Noordhollandsch Kanaal (former Florapark), a new public swimming pool has been built in place of the outdated Floraparkbad; the Noorderparkbad, with a grand café.

facts.text: Refurbished petrol stations named Roze Tanker and De Gele Pomp host cultural events nearby.
facts.sourceQuote: In de laatstgenoemde worden, net zoals in de herbestemde benzinepompstations Roze Tanker en De Gele Pomp (gelegen langs beide zijden van de Nieuwe Leeuwardenweg) kleinschalige culturele en sociale activiteiten georganiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the latter, as in the refurbished petrol pump stations Roze Tanker and De Gele Pomp (located along both sides of the Nieuwe Leeuwardenweg), small-scale cultural and social activities are organized.

features.name: Mien Ruysplantsoen
features.opening: The Mien Ruysplantsoen or KNSM park is a park or small city park on the KNSM island in the Eastern Harbor Area of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Mien Ruys came from a Rotterdam family of shipping and cargo drivers.
facts.sourceQuote: Vermoedelijk omstreeks 1952 ontwierp tuinarchitect Mien Ruys, telg uit een Rotterdamse reders- en cargadoorsfamilie, voor het personeel van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Stoomboot-Maatschappij (KNSM) een bedrijfsparkje op het KNSM-eiland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Probably around 1952, garden architect Mien Ruys, a member of a Rotterdam shipping and cargo driver family, designed a small business park for the staff of the Royal Dutch Steam Boat Company (KNSM) on the KNSM island.

facts.text: Five tall poplars across the street are all that remain of a group once called The Seven Sisters.
facts.sourceQuote: Dwars op de KNSM-laan, gedeeltelijk in de middenberm, staan vijf hoge populieren, een restant van wat ooit "De Zeven Zusters" waren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Across the KNSM-laan, partially in the middle berm, stand five tall poplars, a remnant of what were once "The Seven Sisters".

features.name: Henriette Schwarzpark
features.opening: The Henriette Schwarzpark is a small park in Osdorp, Amsterdam-Nieuw West.

facts.text: Henriette Schwarz was the wife of philosopher Leo Polak, who died in 1941.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij was echtgenote van filosoof, rechtsgeleerde en vrijdenker Leo Polak (1880-1941), naar wie het aan de overzijde van de Baden Powellweg gelegen Leo Polakhuis is vernoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She was the wife of philosopher, jurist and freethinker Leo Polak (1880-1941), to whom the Leo Polakhuis located on the other side of the Baden Powellweg is named.

facts.text: Descendants of the couple unveiled the park's sign and information panel in April 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 12 april 2023 werden het straatnaambord en informatiepaneel onthuld door enkele nazaten van het echtpaar Polak-Schwarz.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 12, 2023, the street sign and information panel were unveiled by some descendants of the Polak-Schwarz couple.

features.name: Oosterpark
features.opening: The Oosterpark (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌoːstərˈpɑr(ə)k], "Eastern Park") is the first large park laid out by the municipality of Amsterdam.

facts.text: A centuries-old cemetery behind the Tropical Museum was relocated to create the park.
facts.sourceQuote: In order to create the Oosterpark, a centuries-old cemetery behind the Tropical Museum had to be relocated.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In order to create the Oosterpark, a centuries-old cemetery behind the Tropical Museum had to be relocated.

facts.text: American landscape architect Max Oostram renovated the park.
facts.sourceQuote: The park, an English garden, was renovated by American landscape architect Max Oostram from Landenberg, Pennsylvania and completed in 2012.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park, an English garden, was renovated by American landscape architect Max Oostram from Landenberg, Pennsylvania and completed in 2012.

features.name: Constantiahofje
features.opening: Constantia is a residential complex around a green courtyard on Willemsstraat 149-165 in Amsterdam, which was built in neoclassical style in 1863.

facts.text: A dedicated foundation for these homes was established in 1863 as a subdivision.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorzitter van deze vereniging richtte in 1863 de Stichting voor den Ambachtsstand - Constantiawoningen op, als een onderafdeling van de Vereeniging, speciaal voor de bouw van deze woningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The president of this association founded the Foundation for the Craftsmen's Trade - Constantia Homes in 1863, as a subdivision of the Association, specifically for the construction of these homes.

facts.text: Original one-room apartments were combined into larger units during renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: De oorspronkelijke eenkamerwoningen zijn toen samengevoegd tot grotere eenheden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original one-room apartments were then combined into larger units.

facts.text: The housing corporation managing these homes merged in 2014 to form Stichting Ymere.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen 2004 en 2014 fuseerde deze stichting met woningcorporaties in Amsterdam, Almere, Haarlem, Haarlemmermeer, Noord-Kennemerland en Weesp tot de huidige Stichting Ymere, waardoor een van de grootste woningcorporaties van Nederland ontstond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 2004 and 2014, this foundation merged with housing corporations in Amsterdam, Almere, Haarlem, Haarlemmermeer, North Kennemerland and Weesp to form the current Stichting Ymere, thus creating one of the largest housing corporations in the Netherlands.

features.name: Lange Bretten
features.opening: De Bretten, and sometimes also called the Lange Bretten, is a nature reserve in the Amsterdam municipality of Nieuw-West with an area of 130 ha.

facts.text: The name derives from the House at Bretten, a country house demolished for the first Dutch railway.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebied is genoemd naar het Huis te Bretten, een van de landhuizen die langs deze vaart heeft gestaan. Dit huis stond ten westen van Sloterdijk langs de Spaarndammerdijk en werd afgebroken voor de aanleg van de eerste spoorlijn van Nederland, van Amsterdam naar Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area is named after the House at Bretten, one of the country houses that stood along this canal. This house stood west of Sloterdijk along the Spaarndammerdijk and was demolished for the construction of the first railway line in the Netherlands, from Amsterdam to Haarlem.

facts.text: In 2006, paths and play facilities were built to make the area more attractive for recreation.
facts.sourceQuote: Door aanleg van paden en speelvoorzieningen in 2006 is het gebied aantrekkelijker gemaakt voor recreatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area has been made more attractive for recreation by the construction of paths and play facilities in 2006.

features.name: Flevopark
features.opening: Flevopark is a park located in the Indische Buurt, in the eastern portion of the city of Amsterdam, in the province of North Holland, Netherlands.

facts.text: Construction finally began in 1928 after funding became available in 1921.
facts.sourceQuote: The expropriation procedure began in 1914, and from 1921 there was money available to obtain the land suitable for building the park. In 1928, the construction of the park began.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The expropriation procedure began in 1914, and from 1921 there was money available to obtain the land suitable for building the park. In 1928, the construction of the park began.

facts.text: In 1956, part of the adjacent Jewish Cemetery was sold to the city and merged into the park.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1956 a large part of the adjacent Jewish Cemetery Zeeburg was relocated to the Jewish Cemetery of Diemen because of the construction of a road. The other part was sold to the Amsterdam municipality and added to the park.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1956 a large part of the adjacent Jewish Cemetery Zeeburg was relocated to the Jewish Cemetery of Diemen because of the construction of a road. The other part was sold to the Amsterdam municipality and added to the park.

facts.text: A distillery and tasting room sit directly on the banks of the Nieuwe Diep.
facts.sourceQuote: On the banks of the Nieuwe Diep is a distillery and tasting room.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the banks of the Nieuwe Diep is a distillery and tasting room.

facts.text: Visitors can enjoy large lawns, barbecue areas, and a terrace for outdoor gatherings.
facts.sourceQuote: The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park contains a playground, tennis courts, the youth centre "Jeugdland", an outdoor swimming pool, large lawns, barbecue areas, a terrace and several trails for running.

features.name: W.H. Vliegenbos
features.opening: The W.H. Vliegenbos is located in Amsterdam-North, between Meeuwenlaan, Nieuwendammerdijk, Nieuwendammerkade and Zamenhofstraat.

facts.text: During World War II, residents cut down over 80% of the trees for firewood, but the forest recovered well after 1945.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Tweede Wereldoorlog is door de bewoners van omliggende woonwijken meer dan 80% van alle bomen gekapt voor brandhout. Na 1945 heeft het bos zich vlot hersteld door het weer uitlopen van de achtergebleven stobben.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, more than 80% of all trees were cut down by the residents of surrounding residential areas for firewood. After 1945, the forest recovered well as the remaining stumps died out.

facts.text: Most trees were planted after World War II following severe fuel shortages that caused massive deforestation.
facts.sourceQuote: Bijna alle bomen dateren van na de Tweede Wereldoorlog, want vanwege brandstofschaarste heeft toen grootschalige houtkap plaatsgevonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Almost all the trees date from after World War II, because due to fuel shortages, large-scale deforestation took place at that time.

facts.text: A shift in water management around 1990 caused the local frog and toad populations to crash dramatically.
facts.sourceQuote: Voorheen was het gebied rijk aan kikkers, padden en salamanders maar door een wijziging in het waterbeheer rond 1990 is de amfibieënpopulatie sterk teruggelopen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Previously, the area was rich in frogs, toads and salamanders, but due to a change in water management around 1990, the amphibian population has declined sharply.

facts.text: The forest preserves dead wood intentionally to create habitats for mushrooms, mosses, and insects.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo blijft dood hout zoveel mogelijk liggen en biedt een plek aan onder meer paddenstoelen, mossen en insecten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This way, dead wood remains as much as possible and provides a place for mushrooms, mosses and insects, among others.

features.name: Hortus Botanicus
features.opening: Hortus Botanicus is a botanical garden in the Plantage district of Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

facts.text: A single coffee plant in its collection served as the parent for all coffee culture in Central and South America.
facts.sourceQuote: A single coffee plant in Hortus' collection served as the parent for the entire coffee culture in Central and South America.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A single coffee plant in Hortus' collection served as the parent for the entire coffee culture in Central and South America.

facts.text: The Palm House and Hugo de Vries Laboratory were built in 1912 and 1915 using Amsterdam School expressionist architecture.
facts.sourceQuote: The Orangery dates from 1875, and the Palm House and Hugo de Vries Laboratory - both created in Amsterdam School expressionist architecture - date from 1912 and 1915.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Orangery dates from 1875, and the Palm House and Hugo de Vries Laboratory - both created in Amsterdam School expressionist architecture - date from 1912 and 1915.

facts.text: The garden houses a Persian ironwood tree among its famous collection of endangered plants.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection is famous for its trees and plants, some of which are endangered. Well-known plants and trees can be found there, like the Persian ironwood tree.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection is famous for its trees and plants, some of which are endangered. Well-known plants and trees can be found there, like the Persian ironwood tree.

features.name: Bella Vistapark
features.opening: The Bella Vistapark is a city park in Amstelkwartier-Noord, Amsterdam-Oost.

facts.text: Until the 21st century, buildings of the GEB and a sewage treatment plant stood here.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot in de 21e eeuw stonden hier gebouwen van het GEB als ook een rioolwaterzuiveringsinstallatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the 21st century, buildings of the GEB as well as a sewage treatment plant stood here.

features.name: Dutch Equestrian School Museum Hollandsche Manege
features.opening: The Hollandsche Manege in Amsterdam is the oldest riding school in the Netherlands, dating back to 1744.

facts.text: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart performed here with his sister Marianne in 1766.
facts.sourceQuote: On the upper floor of the horse trainer's house, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and his sister Marianne gave a performance in 1766.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the upper floor of the horse trainer's house, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and his sister Marianne gave a performance in 1766.

facts.text: Animal rights group Dier & Recht has criticized the facility for horse conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: Both the location and the riding school's management have been criticised by animal protection organisation Dier & Recht for the conditions horses are kept in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Both the location and the riding school's management have been criticised by animal protection organisation Dier & Recht for the conditions horses are kept in.

features.name: Eendrachtspark
features.opening: The Eendrachtspark is a city park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Garden architect Evert Mos created the specific design for the park's interior layout.
facts.sourceQuote: Tuinarchitect Evert Mos maakte het ontwerp voor de inrichting.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Garden architect Evert Mos made the design for the interior.

facts.text: The southern edge once featured a peninsula called Scholeneiland where several schools stood.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de zuidzijde van het park was een schiereiland waar een aantal scholen waren gevestigd dat bekendstond als het Scholeneiland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the south side of the park was a peninsula where a number of schools were located that was known as the Scholeneiland.

facts.text: Aldo van Eyck designed a round pier bath with stepping stones forming an unconventional circular fragment.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij ontwierp ook voor hier een rond pierenbadje met daarin stapstenen, die een tegendraads cirkelfragment vormen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He also designed a round pier bath for here with stepping stones in it, which form an unconventional circular fragment.

facts.text: After renovation, two igloos by Van Eyck were added to the playground alongside modern equipment.
facts.sourceQuote: Er staan na vernieuwing van de speelplaats ook nog twee iglo’s van Van Eyck. De speelplaats werd aangevuld met modernere speeltoestellen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the renovation of the playground, there are also two igloos by Van Eyck. The playground was supplemented with more modern playground equipment.

features.name: Bilderdijkpark
features.opening: Bilderdijkpark is both a small park and a street in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: The land was purchased in 1912 from the former De Liefde cemetery.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 17 april 1912 kocht de gemeente Amsterdam de gronden behorende tot de begraafplaats De Liefde op.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 17, 1912, the municipality of Amsterdam purchased the land belonging to De Liefde cemetery.

facts.text: Felicia Cuypers, daughter of architect Pierre Cuypers, was among the last buried there.
facts.sourceQuote: Een van de laatsten die er begraven werd was Felicia Catharina Rosalia Cuypers (vrouw van Eduard Maria Alberdingk Thijm en dochter van Pierre Cuypers, architect van de tweede versie van de kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the last to be buried there was Felicia Catharina Rosalia Cuypers (wife of Eduard Maria Alberdingk Thijm and daughter of Pierre Cuypers, architect of the second version of the church.

features.name: Piet Wiedijkpark
features.opening: The Piet Wiedijkpark is a park in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp, Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Piet Wiedijkpark honors a pharmacist who wrote Multatuli's first biography under the pseudonym J. Sachs.
facts.sourceQuote: Straat en park zijn genoemd naar de apotheker en publicist Piet Wiedijk († 1938), die onder het pseudoniem J. Saks de eerste biografie van Multatuli schreef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street and park are named after the pharmacist and publicist Piet Wiedijk († 1938), who under the pseudonym J. Sachs wrote the first biography of Multatuli.

facts.text: A pier bath modeled after Aldo van Eyck's designs was added to the park in 1972 or 1973.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo werd er in de periode 1972/1973 een pierenbad aangelegd. Het heeft het model van de pierenbadjes van Aldo van Eyck, die met zijn speelplaatsen werkte voor de Dienst der Publieke Werken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, a pier bath was built in the period 1972/1973. It has the model of the pier bathhouses by Aldo van Eyck, who worked for the Department of Public Works with his playgrounds.

facts.text: Curved stepping stones once crossed the pond but were later covered over to prevent falls.
facts.sourceQuote: De vijver kent de voor hem karakteristieke springstenen (in een boogsegment; later afgedekt tegen valwonden), die springstenen zijn ook buiten het badje terug te vinden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pond has the characteristic stepping stones for him (in a curved segment; later covered against falls), which stepping stones can also be found outside the pool.

facts.text: Volunteers established the nature garden Natuurtuin de Wiedijk in the late 1990s.
facts.sourceQuote: Het noordelijkste deel van het park (ten noorden van de Pieter Calandlaan) is eindjaren negentig door vrijwilligers ingericht als Natuurtuin de Wiedijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The northernmost part of the park (north of Pieter Calandlaan) was set up as Natuurtuin de Wiedijk by volunteers in the late 1990s.

facts.text: Three architecturally valued bridges by Dick Slebos cross the Christoffelplantijngracht within the park.
facts.sourceQuote: Over de Christoffelplantijngracht liggen drie bruggen ontworpen door Dick Slebos, die weliswaar architectonisch hogelijk gewaardeerd worden (orde 1 en 2), maar nog niet zoals de Piet Römerbrug tot gemeentelijk monument zijn verklaard: Brug 716 Brug 721 Piet Bakkerbrug (Brug 715) in de Pieter Calandlaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three bridges designed by Dick Slebos lie over the Christoffelplantijngracht, which are indeed architecturally highly valued (order 1 and 2), but have not yet been declared a municipal monument like the Piet Römerbrug: Bridge 716 Bridge 721 Piet Bakkerbrug (Bridge 715) in Pieter Calandlaan.

facts.text: Bridge 719 in Cornelis Lelylaan was designed by architect Dirk Sterenberg as part of a building series.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Cornelis Lelylaan ligt dan nog brug 719 van architect Dirk Sterenberg in zijn reeks bouwwerken in de Cornelis Lelylaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Cornelis Lelylaan is then still bridge 719 by architect Dirk Sterenberg in his series of buildings in the Cornelis Lelylaan.

features.name: Leidsebosje
features.opening: The Leidsebosje is a park between Leidseplein and Vondelpark in Amsterdam, in a north-south running strip between Stadhouderskade and Singelgracht in…

facts.text: The unofficial name Leidsebosje became official in 2017, allowing a street sign to be placed.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 16 maart 2017 werd de officieuze naam Leidsche Bosje/Leidse Bosje/Leidsebosje door een raadsbesluit op voorstel van het College van burgemeester en wethouders officieel gemaakt, en kon een straatnaambordje geplaatst worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On March 16, 2017, the unofficial name Leidsche Bosje/Leidse Bosje/Leidsebosje was officially adopted by a council decision at the proposal of the College of Mayors and Councillors, and a street sign could be placed.

facts.text: Odd house numbers 1, 3 and 5 sit in the south while even number 2 is located in the north.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Leidsebosje kent oneven huisnummers 1, 3 en 5 in het zuidelijk deel en even huisnummer 2 in het noordelijke.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Leidsebosje has odd house numbers 1, 3 and 5 in the southern part and even house number 2 in the northern part.

facts.text: A roundabout built on the site was converted back into a T-intersection in 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo werd de Singelgracht ter plaatste van het Leidseplein rechtgetrokken, en kwam een rotonde die in 1971 weer omgebouwd werd tot de T-kruising Stadhouderskade en Leidseplein, met als verbinding de Leidsebrug ontworpen door Piet Kramer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, the Singelgracht was straightened on the site of Leidseplein, and a roundabout was built that was converted back into the T-intersection Stadhouderskade and Leidseplein in 1971, with the Leidsebrug designed by Piet Kramer as the connection.

features.name: Nelson Mandelapark
features.opening: The Nelson Mandelapark, formerly known as Bijlmerpark until 2014, is a city park in the south of the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: Since 1975, the Kwakoe Summer Festival has been organized here annually.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1975 wordt hier jaarlijks het Kwakoe Zomerfestival georganiseerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1975, the Kwakoe Summer Festival has been organized here annually.

features.name: 't Kleine Loopveld
features.opening: 't Kleine Loopveld is a linear park along the southern edge of Buitenveldert in Amsterdam-Zuid, Netherlands.

facts.text: The green strip spans roughly 16.5 hectares, covering about 41 acres of land.
facts.sourceQuote: It covers approximately 16.5 ha (41 acres).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It covers approximately 16.5 ha (41 acres).

features.name: Monument Rozenoord
features.opening: Monument Rozenoord is a monument in Amsterdam-Zuid from 2015 to commemorate the executed during World War II at the Rozenoord firing range.

facts.text: The memorial features scattered chairs on a concrete slab, each representing a known victim.
facts.sourceQuote: Het in het Amstelpark geplaatste monument bestaat uit een grasveld met lege stoelen. Deze stoelen zijn stuk voor stuk geplaatst op een betonnen plaat waarop naam, geboortedatum en fusilladedatum te lezen zijn van de personen waarvan de naam bekend is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument placed in Amstelpark consists of a grassy field with empty chairs. These chairs are all placed on a concrete slab on which the name, date of birth and date of execution can be read of the persons whose name is known.

facts.text: Six additional chairs were added in summer 2018 after research recovered five new names.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer van 2018 werden er op het veld nog zes stoelen bijgeplaatst, doordat familie uit de Verenigde Staten op zoek was naar de geschiedenis van Hartog Frinkel, die mede dankzij het NIOD leidde tot het terugvinden van vijf namen van slachtoffers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer of 2018, six more chairs were added to the field, because family from the United States was looking for the history of Hartog Frinkel, which led to the recovery of five names of victims thanks in part to the NIOD.

features.name: Erasmuspark
features.opening: The Erasmuspark is a city park in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: World War II halted further development, leaving only a quarter of the planned area finished by 1950.
facts.sourceQuote: Verdere aanleg werd onmogelijk gemaakt door de Tweede Wereldoorlog. Er gebeurde op houtroof na weinig in park; in 1950 is alleen nog het oorspronkelijke kwart van het park ingericht als park, daaromheen was agrarisch gebied met tuinderijen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Further development was made impossible by World War II. After little in the park due to wood theft; in 1950 only the original quarter of the park was still set up as a park, around it was agricultural land with gardens.

facts.text: A ring ditch was completed around the entire area to drain the six-hectare park.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor de afwatering van het park werd de ringsloot, die al in het westen en zuiden lag compleet gemaakt, door een omringing van het gehele parkoppervlak, waarvan ongeveer 6 hectare overblijft (300 bij 200 meter).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For the drainage of the park, the ring ditch, which was already located in the west and south, was completely completed, by surrounding the entire park area, of which about 6 hectares remain (300 by 200 meters).

features.name: Geuzenbos
features.opening: The Geuzenbos is a nature reserve in the Groote IJpolder between the Spaarnwoude Recreation Area, the De Heining business park and the Spaarndammerdijk…

facts.text: Mowing fields here have height differences of about five meters due to past sludge dumping.
facts.sourceQuote: Het deel ter hoogte van het gemaal is lang gebruikt als stortplaats voor slib dat vrijkwam bij de verwerking van suikerbieten door de nabij gevestigde fabriek van de Centrale Suiker Maatschappij (CSM). Het maaiveld in de polder kent hierdoor hoogteverschillen van circa vijf meter en een sterk wisselende bodemopbouw en samenstelling, van klei tot kalkrijk zand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area near the pumping station has long been used as a landfill for sludge that was released during the processing of sugar beets by the nearby factory of the Centrale Suiker Maatschappij (CSM). As a result, the mowing field in the polder has height differences of about five meters and a strongly changing soil structure and composition, from clay to calcareous sand.

facts.text: A road called Councillor of Essenweg splits the 60-hectare reserve into two separate sections.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebied met een oppervlakte van 60 hectare wordt in tweeën gedeeld door de Wethouder van Essenweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The area with an area of 60 hectares is divided into two by the Councillor of Essenweg.

features.name: Wertheimpark
features.opening: The Wertheimpark is a city park in the Plantagebuurt in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Despite being a central Amsterdam park, Wertheimpark has no official street addresses.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park kent geen adressen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park has no addresses.

facts.text: Wertheimpark stands as the sole park located entirely within Amsterdam's Centrum district.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is het enige park binnen de grenzen van stadsdeel Centrum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is the only park within the boundaries of the Centrum district.

features.name: Theo van Goghpark
features.opening: The Theo van Goghpark is a city park in the Amsterdam district of IJburg.

facts.text: Thirteen plane trees were transplanted here after being removed from Europaplein for subway construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Dertien volwassen platanen die in het park zijn geplant, zijn afkomstig van het Europaplein bij de RAI, waar ze moesten wijken voor werkzaamheden voor de Noord-Zuidlijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Thirteen adult plane trees planted in the park come from Europaplein near the RAI, where they had to make way for work for the North-South Line.

facts.text: Streets surrounding the park are named after film figures like Emmy Andriesse and Eva Besnyö.
facts.sourceQuote: De straten rondom het park zijn vernoemd naar personen uit de filmwereld. Zo ligt het park ingeklemd tussen straten vernoemd naar Emmy Andriesse, Eva Besnyö en Fritz Kahlenberg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The streets around the park are named after people from the film world. For example, the park is sandwiched between streets named after Emmy Andriesse, Eva Besnyö and Fritz Kahlenberg.

features.name: Jan van Zutphenplantsoen
features.opening: The Jan van Zutphenplantsoen is a park and green strip in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp.

facts.text: Bus line 19 used this location as its final stop from June 1983 until September 1991.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park was van juni 1983 tot september 1991 de eindhalte van bus 19.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was the final stop of bus 19 from June 1983 to September 1991.

features.name: Stadspark Osdorp
features.opening: The Stadspark Osdorp is a park in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp.

facts.text: Colorful glazed earthenware fantasy sculptures by Adriaan Rees and local children appeared in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park staan, bij de beide bruggen over de Hoekenesgracht, sinds 2007 kleurige geglazuurde aardewerken fantasie-beelden die de kunstenaar Adriaan Rees samen met kinderen uit de buurt heeft gemaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the park, near the two bridges over the Hoekenesgracht, colorful glazed earthenware fantasy sculptures have been standing since 2007 that the artist Adriaan Rees made together with children from the neighborhood.

facts.text: In June 2017, the world's largest calisthenics park opened within these grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: In juni 2017 werd in het park het grootste calisthenics park van de wereld geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June 2017, the largest calisthenics park in the world was opened in the park.

features.name: Gerbrandypark
features.opening: The Gerbrandypark is a city park in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Gerbrandypark was named in 1963 after Dutch statesman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy.
facts.sourceQuote: Het park werd aangelegd tussen 1957 en 1965 en in 1963 vernoemd naar de Nederlandse politicus en staatsman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy (1885-1961).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The park was laid out between 1957 and 1965 and was named in 1963 after the Dutch politician and statesman Pieter Sjoerds Gerbrandy (1885-1961).

facts.text: A separate park with the same name exists in Nieuwegein's Galecop district.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is ook een Gerbrandypark in Nieuwegein, in de wijk Galecop.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is also a Gerbrandypark in Nieuwegein, in the Galecop district.

facts.text: Aldo van Eyck designed the playground featuring a unique pier pool.
facts.sourceQuote: In het Gerbrandypark zijn een speelplaats met een pierenbadje van Aldo van Eyck, twee tennisbanen en een voetbalveld (kunstgras).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Gerbrandypark there is a playground with a pier pool by Aldo van Eyck, two tennis courts and a football field (artificial turf).

facts.text: Artist Hoshyar Rasheed created several sculptures during the park's renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is een nieuwe bloementuin en kunstenaar Hoshyar Rasheed heeft verschillende beelden ontworpen bij de afronding van de renovatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is a new flower garden and artist Hoshyar Rasheed designed several sculptures during the completion of the renovation.

features.name: Houthavenpark
features.opening: The Houthavenpark is a park in Amsterdam-West, located between the Spaarndammerbuurt and the Houthavens district.

facts.text: Residents voted to name the park Houthavenpark in April 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van het park werd in april 2021 vastgesteld na een verkiezing door buurtbewoners.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the park was determined in April 2021 after an election by neighborhood residents.

features.name: Spui
features.opening: The Spui (Dutch pronunciation: [spœy] .

facts.text: The Maagdenhuis, built in 1780, now serves as the University of Amsterdam headquarters.
facts.sourceQuote: The Maagdenhuis (1780), the headquarters of the University of Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Maagdenhuis (1780), the headquarters of the University of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Gerrit van Arkel won third prize for a design at the 1900 World's Fair in Paris.
facts.sourceQuote: The design by Gerrit van Arkel won third prize in the architects' competition at the 1900 World's Fair in Paris.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design by Gerrit van Arkel won third prize in the architects' competition at the 1900 World's Fair in Paris.

facts.text: The Oude Lutherse Kerk dates back to 1632 and stands across the Singel canal.
facts.sourceQuote: The Oude Lutherse Kerk (1632–1633), the Old Lutheran Church, across the Singel canal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Oude Lutherse Kerk (1632–1633), the Old Lutheran Church, across the Singel canal.

facts.text: The name Spui derives from a lockable water discharge, related to the Dutch verb for spewing.
facts.sourceQuote: A spui is a lockable water discharge. The word is related to the Dutch verbs spuiten and spuwen, cognates of the English word spewing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A spui is a lockable water discharge. The word is related to the Dutch verbs spuiten and spuwen, cognates of the English word spewing.

facts.text: Visitors can find weekly book markets on Fridays and art markets on Sundays at this location.
facts.sourceQuote: The Spui is hosts a weekly book market on Fridays and a variety of bookstores on or near the square, including two shops dedicated to English-language literature (the American Book Center relocated to the Spui in October 2006). There is also a weekly Sunday art market.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Spui is hosts a weekly book market on Fridays and a variety of bookstores on or near the square, including two shops dedicated to English-language literature (the American Book Center relocated to the Spui in October 2006). There is also a weekly Sunday art market.

features.name: Flower Market
features.opening: The Bloemenmarkt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈbluməˌmɑr(ə)kt]) is the world's only floating flower market.

facts.text: The market was established in 1862 on the Singel canal.
facts.sourceQuote: Founded in 1862, it is sited in Amsterdam, Netherlands, on the Singel canal between Muntplein and Koningsplein in the city's southern canal belt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Founded in 1862, it is sited in Amsterdam, Netherlands, on the Singel canal between Muntplein and Koningsplein in the city's southern canal belt.

facts.text: Bulbs purchased here rarely bloom according to a 2019 survey.
facts.sourceQuote: A 2019 survey found bulbs bought at the Bloemenmarkt rarely to never flower.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A 2019 survey found bulbs bought at the Bloemenmarkt rarely to never flower.

features.name: New Market
features.opening: Nieuwmarkt (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈniuˌmɑr(ə)kt]; English: New Market) is a square in the centre of Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: A medieval city gate now stands here, having been converted into a weighing house after the walls were demolished.
facts.sourceQuote: The Nieuwmarkt is dominated by a building known as the Waag, originally a gate in the medieval city walls but converted into a weighing house after the walls were demolished in the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Nieuwmarkt is dominated by a building known as the Waag, originally a gate in the medieval city walls but converted into a weighing house after the walls were demolished in the 17th century.

facts.text: In World War II, Nazis used this location as a collection point for Jews rounded up for concentration camps.
facts.sourceQuote: In World War II the square was used by the Nazis as a collection point for Jews who had been rounded up to be sent to the concentration camps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In World War II the square was used by the Nazis as a collection point for Jews who had been rounded up to be sent to the concentration camps.

facts.text: Heavy riots erupted in 1975 when residents fought against plans to tear down buildings for a highway through the area.
facts.sourceQuote: In the 1970s many buildings on and around the square were torn down to make way for a planned metro and four-lane highway, which was to run right through the Nieuwmarkt neighbourhood. This led to heavy rioting, known as the Nieuwmarkt Riots (Nieuwmarktrellen), in 1975 and, ultimately, abandonment of the highway plans.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1970s many buildings on and around the square were torn down to make way for a planned metro and four-lane highway, which was to run right through the Nieuwmarkt neighbourhood. This led to heavy rioting, known as the Nieuwmarkt Riots (Nieuwmarktrellen), in 1975 and, ultimately, abandonment of the highway plans.

features.name: Solebayplein
features.opening: Solebayplein is an unofficial name for a square in the Landlust district in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: Trees and shrubs once blocked light, making residents feel unsafe on the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij een algehele opknapbeurt van de omgeving klaagden de bewoners dat zij zich nogal onveilig voelden op het pleintje. Dit kwam doordat de bomen en struiken licht weghielden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During a general renovation of the surroundings, the residents complained that they still felt quite unsafe on the square. This was because the trees and shrubs were blocking out light.

facts.text: Artist Lobke Alkemade previously redesigned squares in Amsterdam-Oost before this project.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeente Amsterdam of stadsdeel West vroeg vervolgens aan architecte/kunstenares Lobke Alkemade het plein opnieuw in te richten. Zij had eerder voor de gemeente gewerkt met pleinen in Amsterdam-Oost, zoals het Iepenplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality of Amsterdam or the West district then asked architect/artist Lobke Alkemade to redesign the square again. She had previously worked for the municipality with squares in Amsterdam-Oost, such as the Iepenplein.

facts.text: Alkemade created an open layout featuring benches and a new work of art.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij richtte een open plein in met zitbankjes en een kunstwerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: She created an open square with benches and a work of art.

facts.text: The residential block forming the square's south side was constructed in 1934 and 1935.
facts.sourceQuote: Het woonblok Haarlemmerweg 507-531, dat de zuidkant van het pleintje vormt stamt uit de jaren 1934/1935.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The residential block Haarlemmerweg 507-531, which forms the south side of the square, dates back to the 1934/1935 years.

facts.text: Architect Gerrit Jan Rutgers designed this distinctive Amsterdam School building complex.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is gebouwd in de stijl van de Amsterdamse School en is ontworpen door Gerrit Jan Rutgers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in the style of the Amsterdam School and was designed by Gerrit Jan Rutgers.

facts.text: Courtyard houses feature natural stone entrances that transition into brick near the doors.
facts.sourceQuote: Het zijn portiekwoningen, waarvan de portieken een natuurstenen ingang en trap hebben die richting toegangsdeur overgaat in in baksteen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They are courtyard houses, whose porches have a natural stone entrance and staircase that transitions into brick towards the entrance door.

features.name: Prinses Amaliaplein
features.opening: The Prinses Amaliaplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Princess Amalia was chosen because nearby streets honor other royal family members.
facts.sourceQuote: Men koos voor prinses Amalia omdat meerdere straten hier vernoemd zijn naar leden van het koningshuis (Prinses Irene, Prinses Marijke en Prinses Margriet en het Beatrixpark).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Princess Amalia was chosen because several streets here are named after members of the royal family (Prinses Irene, Prinses Marijke and Prinses Margriet and the Beatrixpark).

facts.text: A planned park named Prinses Amaliapark was cancelled before the square received its name.
facts.sourceQuote: In eerste instantie had de gemeente een park naar haar willen vernoemen; het Prinses Amaliapark, dat zou komen te liggen in de hoek van de Vivaldistraat, Hector Berliozlaan. Het park verdween van de tekentafel, de naam Amaliapark werd per gelijke datum ingetrokken waardoor de naam Prinses Amalia “vrijkwam”.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, the municipality wanted to name a park after her; the Prinses Amaliapark, which would be located in the corner of Vivaldistraat, Hector Berliozlaan. The park disappeared from the drawing table, the name Amaliapark was withdrawn on the same date, resulting in the name Prinses Amalia "emerging".

facts.text: A major redesign took place in 2018 and 2019 after neighborhood consultation.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plein werd in 2018/2019 verder heringericht in overleg met de buurt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square was further redesigned in 2018/2019 in consultation with the neighborhood.

features.name: Beursplein
features.opening: The Beursplein is a square in the center of Amsterdam, between the Damrak and the Beursstraat.

facts.text: Berlage also designed six lanterns and two fountains that were originally horse troughs.
facts.sourceQuote: Berlage ontwierp ook zes lantaarns en twee fonteinen (voormalig paardendrinkbakken) voor het Beursplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Berlage also designed six lanterns and two fountains (former horse troughs) for the Beursplein.

facts.text: A bicycle shed was installed beneath the square in 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2018 is er onder het plein een fietsenstalling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2018, there has been a bicycle shed under the square.

facts.text: The Bijenkorf parking garage entrance often triggers traffic jams extending to the Damrak.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan het plein ligt ook de ingang van de parkeergarage van de Bijenkorf, die regelmatig voor files tot op het Damrak zorgt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square also houses the entrance to the Bijenkorf parking garage, which regularly causes traffic jams up to the Damrak.

features.name: Rhijnspoorplein
features.opening: The Rhijnspoorplein is a square in Amsterdam-East and -Center.

facts.text: Construction of the Amsterdam subway began here in August 1970.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw van de Amsterdamse metro startte in augustus 1970 op het Rhijnspoorplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction of the Amsterdam subway began in August 1970 at the Rhijnspoorplein.

facts.text: Foundations of a former train station turntable were demolished during this work.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen werden ook de nog aanwezige fundamenten van de draaischijf van het voormalige treinstation gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Then the still present foundations of the turntable of the former train station were also demolished.

facts.text: The tunnel for the East Line opened to traffic in October 1977.
facts.sourceQuote: De tunnel van de Oostlijn werd in oktober 1977 in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tunnel of the East Line was put into use in October 1977.

features.name: Dappermarkt
features.opening: The Dappermarkt is a market on Dapperstraat in Amsterdam-East and is one of the busiest markets of Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

facts.text: The municipality officially designated the street as a market in 1910.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1910, the Dapperstraat was officially designated by the municipality of Amsterdam as a market street.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1910, the Dapperstraat was officially designated by the municipality of Amsterdam as a market street.

features.name: Rembrandt Square
features.opening: Rembrandtplein (English: Rembrandt Square) is a major square in central Amsterdam, Netherlands, named after Rembrandt van Rijn who owned a house nearby from…

facts.text: By 1655, farmers sold dairy and poultry here, earning the name Botermarkt or butter market.
facts.sourceQuote: By 1655, the city had expanded beyond this area and it began to attract visiting farmers who brought their butter, dairy and poultry products to sell in the city and it became known as Botermarkt or butter market.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By 1655, the city had expanded beyond this area and it began to attract visiting farmers who brought their butter, dairy and poultry products to sell in the city and it became known as Botermarkt or butter market.

facts.text: In 1876, a statue of Rembrandt moved to the center, renaming the site Rembrandt Square.
facts.sourceQuote: The market continued under this name until 1876 when a statue of Rembrandt by sculptor Louis Royer was moved from the perimeter to the centre of the square and it was renamed Rembrandtplein (Rembrandt Square).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The market continued under this name until 1876 when a statue of Rembrandt by sculptor Louis Royer was moved from the perimeter to the centre of the square and it was renamed Rembrandtplein (Rembrandt Square).

facts.text: Autumn fairs once replaced farmer stalls with dance orchestras and circus tents.
facts.sourceQuote: Each autumn, the square hosted a fair and the farmers' stalls were replaced by dance orchestras and circus tents.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Each autumn, the square hosted a fair and the farmers' stalls were replaced by dance orchestras and circus tents.

facts.text: A massive 114-square-meter LCD screen once held the title of Europe's largest display.
facts.sourceQuote: At the time of installation, the screen was the largest in Europe at 114 m2 (1,230 sq ft).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the time of installation, the screen was the largest in Europe at 114 m2 (1,230 sq ft).

facts.text: The cast iron statue was created in 1852 by sculptor Louis Royer.
facts.sourceQuote: The statue of Rembrandt was made in 1852 by sculptor Louis Royer and is of cast iron.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The statue of Rembrandt was made in 1852 by sculptor Louis Royer and is of cast iron.

facts.text: Visitors could upload videos to the giant screen using Bluetooth-enabled mobile phones.
facts.sourceQuote: The display measures 7.6 m × 15 m (25 ft × 49 ft) and, in addition to programmed advertisements, allows passers-by to upload videos with a Bluetooth enabled mobile phone.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The display measures 7.6 m × 15 m (25 ft × 49 ft) and, in addition to programmed advertisements, allows passers-by to upload videos with a Bluetooth enabled mobile phone.

features.name: Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen
features.opening: The Kleine-Gartmanplantsoen is a square and park in the center of Amsterdam.

facts.text: An overpass beginning at bridge 198 resulted in a half-bridge with railings on only one side.
facts.sourceQuote: De overkluizing begon bij brug 198, die daardoor het uiterlijk kreeg van een halve brug (aan één kant leuningen en borstweringen).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The overpass began at bridge 198, which as a result took on the appearance of a half-bridge (with railings and guardrails on one side).

facts.text: Anne Frank and fellow undergrounders were imprisoned here after being betrayed during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog werden Anne Frank en haar mede-onderduikers opgesloten in dit Huis van Bewaring nadat ze waren verraden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, Anne Frank and her fellow undergrounders were imprisoned in this Detention House after being betrayed.

facts.text: Resistance members led by Gerrit van der Veen attempted to free prisoners in a robbery on May 1, 1944.
facts.sourceQuote: Een groep onder leiding van Gerrit van der Veen pleegde op 1 mei 1944 een overval op het Huis van Bewaring in een poging gevangengenomen verzetsleden te bevrijden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A group led by Gerrit van der Veen carried out a robbery of the Detention Center on May 1, 1944 in an attempt to free captured resistance members.

facts.text: Johannes Post carried out a second robbery at the center on the night of July 14-15, 1944.
facts.sourceQuote: Een tweede overval werd uitgevoerd door Johannes Post in de nacht van 14-15 juli 1944.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A second robbery was carried out by Johannes Post on the night of July 14-15, 1944.

features.name: Zuidplein
features.opening: The Zuidplein in Amsterdam-Zuid is the forecourt of Amsterdam Zuid station.

facts.text: Tram 5 used this square as an end loop until the line extended to Amstelveen in 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990 werd de tramlus in verband met de verlegging en verlenging van lijn 5 naar Amstelveen verlaten maar het busstation bleef bestaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, the tram loop was abandoned in connection with the relocation and extension of line 5 to Amstelveen, but the bus station remained.

facts.text: A large, free underground bicycle parking garage sits directly beneath the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder het plein ligt bij Station Zuid een ondergrondse fietsenstalling (groot en gratis).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Underneath the square is an underground bicycle parking garage (large and free) near Station Zuid.

facts.text: Tram lines 5 and 25 stop on the north side along Strawinskylaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de noordzijde ligt de Strawinskylaan met haltes voor tramlijnen 5 en 25, buslijnen 15 en 62 van het GVB en buslijnen 178, 198, 221, 321 en 346 van Connexxion/Transdev.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the north side is the Strawinskylaan with stops for tram lines 5 and 25, GVB bus lines 15 and 62 and Connexxion/Transdev bus lines 178, 198, 221, 321 and 346.

features.name: Meidoornplein
features.opening: The Meidoornplein is a rectangular square in Amsterdam-North.

facts.text: Meidoornplein received its official name on January 21, 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plein kreeg haar naam op 21 januari 1920 en snoepte daarmee een deel af van de Meidoornlaan, die al in 1919 haar naam had gekregen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square was named on January 21, 1920, thus taking away part of Meidoornlaan, which had already been named in 1919.

facts.text: Houses feature brown-red brick with mustard yellow woodwork and green doors in strict symmetry.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook de kleurstelling van de woningen wijkt niet af: bruinrood baksteen, mosterdgele accenten in houtwerk en groene deuren. Uiteraard behoort de totale symmetrie ook hier tot het uitgangspunt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The color scheme of the houses also does not deviate: brown-red brick, mustard yellow accents in woodwork and green doors. Of course, total symmetry also belongs to the starting point here.

facts.text: A central building originally served as a reading room but holds lower architectural value than the homes.
facts.sourceQuote: Midden in het plantsoen staat echter een gebouw, wel in dezelfde stijl maar dan van een architect van de Dienst der Publieke Werken. De woningen worden qua architectuur hoog ingeschat (orde 2, bijna monument), het pand midden op het plein, origineel een leeszaal, minder (orde 3, moeite van het bewaren waard).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, in the middle of the park there is a building, in the same style but by an architect of the Department of Public Works. The houses are highly valued in terms of architecture (order 2, almost a monument), the building in the middle of the square, originally a reading room, less (order 3, worth preserving).

features.name: Museum Square
features.opening: The Museumplein (Dutch pronunciation: [myˌzeːjʏmˈplɛin]; English: Museum Square) is a public space in the Museumkwartier neighbourhood of the Amsterdam-Zuid…

facts.text: A 1999 reconstruction by Sven-Ingvar Andersson added underground parking and a supermarket.
facts.sourceQuote: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Museumplein was reconstructed after a design by the Swedish/Danish landscape architect Sven-Ingvar Andersson in 1999. It now includes underground parking spaces and an underground supermarket.

facts.text: The famous I AMsterdam sign stood here until city officials removed it in December 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: The main "I AMsterdam" sign was also located here in front of the Rijksmuseum, until 4 December 2018, when it was removed at the behest of the city council.
