facts.sourceQuote: The Enneüs Heerma Bridge (Dutch: Enneüs Heermabrug) is a bridge in Amsterdam, Netherlands located in the new neighbourhood of IJburg, built on seven artificial islands in the IJmeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Enneüs Heerma Bridge (Dutch: Enneüs Heermabrug) is a bridge in Amsterdam, Netherlands located in the new neighbourhood of IJburg, built on seven artificial islands in the IJmeer.

features.name: Daalwijkdreef
features.opening: The Daalwijkdreef is a promenade in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: The first elevated section for fast traffic opened in 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eerste gedeelte van de verhoogde dreef, uitsluitend voor snelverkeer, werd geopend in 1971.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first section of the elevated causeway, exclusively for fast traffic, was opened in 1971.

facts.text: Unlike nearby roads, it remains entirely elevated as originally planned.
facts.sourceQuote: In tegenstelling tot bijvoorbeeld de Bijlmerdreef is de dreef nog steeds geheel hooggelegen conform de uitgangspunten van het stedenbouwkundig plan van de Bijlmermeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike, for example, the Bijlmerdreef, the dreef is still entirely elevated in accordance with the starting points of the Bijlmermeer urban planning plan.

facts.text: An unused bridge head exists because the crossing road was never built to its intended width.
facts.sourceQuote: Daar waar de Gooiseweg met een viaduct de Daalwijkdreef kruist bevindt zich aan de oostzijde een ongebruikt brughoofd dat ongebruikt bleef omdat de Gooiseweg nooit in de beoogde breedte is aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Where the Gooiseweg crosses the Daalwijkdreef with a viaduct, there is an unused bridge head on the east side that remained unused because the Gooiseweg was never built to the intended width.

facts.text: Bus stops once fell in Diemen due to a municipal boundary running through the middle of the drive.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk lag de gemeentegrens tussen Amsterdam en Diemen midden over de dreef tussen de Gooiseweg en de Elsrijkdreef. Hierdoor lagen de haltes stadinwaarts op het verlengde gedeelte van de dreef van de op 30 september 1973 ingestelde toenmalige GVB bus 58 in de gemeente Diemen en was haltering niet toegestaan vanwege een bepaling van de Commissie Vergunningen Personenvervoer waarbij het GVB buiten de gemeente zonder vergunning niet mocht halteren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the municipal boundary between Amsterdam and Diemen was in the middle of the dreef between the Gooiseweg and the Elsrijkdreef. As a result, the stops in the city center were located on the extended section of the driveway of the then-GVB bus 58, which was established on September 30, 1973, in the municipality of Diemen, and stopping was not allowed due to a provision of the Commission for the Granting of Passenger Transport Licenses stating that the GVB was not allowed to stop outside the municipality without a license.

features.name: Kamperfoelieweg
features.opening: The Kamperfoelieweg is a street in Amsterdam-North.

facts.text: Allied bombings in July 1943 destroyed much of the area, leading to reconstruction between 1945 and the 1950s.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de geallieerde bombardementen op Amsterdam-Noord in juli 1943 is een groot deel van de Kamperfoelieweg geraakt, waardoor een deel van de straat dateert uit de heropbouw in de jaren 1945 tot 1950.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Allied bombings of Amsterdam-Noord in July 1943, a large part of the Kamperfoelieweg was damaged, resulting in part of the street dating back to the reconstruction in the 1945 to 1950s.

facts.text: Kamperfoelieweg was laid out during the 1920s.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat werd aangelegd in de jaren twintig.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street was laid out in the 1920s.

features.name: De Ruijterkade
features.opening: The De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam is located along the IJ on the north side of Central Station.

facts.text: Steam boats departed from this quay for northern and western destinations starting in 1880.
facts.sourceQuote: De De Ruijterkade werd vanaf 1880 het beurtvaartcentrum van Amsterdam, waar stoomboten vertrokken naar de belangrijkste bestemmingen van Noord- en West-Nederland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1880, the De Ruijterkade became the ferry center of Amsterdam, where steam boats departed for the main destinations of northern and western the Netherlands.

facts.text: A large construction pit for the IJzijde bus station occupied much of the area from 2004 onwards.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 2004 was een groot deel van de De Ruijterkade jarenlang een grote bouwput voor het project "IJsei": de bouw van een hooggelegen busstation, IJzijde geheten, met daaronder de Michiel de Ruijtertunnel voor auto's.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 2004 onwards, a large part of De Ruijterkade was for many years a large construction pit for the "IJsei" project: the construction of a high-rise bus station, called IJzijde, with the Michiel de Ruijtertunnel for cars underneath.

facts.text: Although named after the admiral with a y, the local spelling uses an i instead.
facts.sourceQuote: De spelling van de De Ruijterkade (en ook de Admiraal de Ruijterweg) is in Amsterdam met een ij, terwijl de naam van de naamgever meestal met een y wordt geschreven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The spelling of the De Ruijterkade (and also the Admiraal de Ruijterweg) is in Amsterdam with an i, while the name of the namesake is usually written with a y.

features.name: Kromwijkdreef
features.opening: The Kromwijkdreef, part of urban route S113, connects Karspeldreef in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost with Langbroekdreef and Loosdrechtdreef in…

facts.text: Kromwijkdreef was named after the old patrician house Cromwijck in Maarsseveen by a council decision in January 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: De dreef is bij een raadsbesluit van 20 januari 1971 vernoemd naar een van de oude patriciërshuizen, Cromwijck, in Maarsseveen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The drive was named after one of the old patrician houses, Cromwijck, in Maarsseveen, by a council decision of January 20, 1971.

facts.text: The road opened to traffic in 1977 as a temporary access route for Nellestein residents before becoming a permanent link.
facts.sourceQuote: De dreef was oorspronkelijk half hoog gelegen en uitsluitend bestemd voor snelverkeer en werd voor het verkeer opengesteld in 1977. Van 1977 tot 1982 was het de tijdelijke ontsluitingsweg voor de bewoners van de wijk Nellestein en sloot bij het metrostation Gaasperplas aan op Langbroekdreef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The drive was originally located half-high and was exclusively intended for fast traffic and was opened to traffic in 1977. From 1977 to 1982 it was the temporary access road for the residents of the Nellestein district and connected to Langbroekdreef at the Gaasperplas metro station.

facts.text: In the late 1990s, the dike was lowered to meadow level to create bicycle and pedestrian paths with level crossings.
facts.sourceQuote: In de tweede helft van de jaren negentig werd de dreef in het kader van de vernieuwing van de Bijlmermeer verlaagd naar maaiveldniveau en er verschenen fiets- en voetpaden en gelijkvloerse kruisingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the second half of the 1990s, the dike was lowered to meadow level as part of the renewal of the Bijlmermeer and bicycle and pedestrian paths and level crossings appeared.

features.name: Blauwbrug
features.opening: The Blauwbrug (English: Blue bridge) is a historic bridge in Amsterdam, Netherlands over the river Amstel.

facts.text: The Blauwbrug (Blue bridge) keeps a name from a vanished wooden structure painted the Dutch flag's blue around 1600.
facts.sourceQuote: The bridge owes its name to a wooden "blue bridge" that was there from around 1600 but no longer exists and which was painted the characteristic blue of the Dutch flag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge owes its name to a wooden "blue bridge" that was there from around 1600 but no longer exists and which was painted the characteristic blue of the Dutch flag.

facts.text: Stone bases mimic ship bows and support columns topped with the Imperial Crown of Austria.
facts.sourceQuote: The stone bridge has three openings for ships and is richly decorated. The bases are formed like ships' bows and on top columns with leaf-motifs, masks and finally the Imperial Crown of Austria, as also present in the city's coat of arms.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stone bridge has three openings for ships and is richly decorated. The bases are formed like ships' bows and on top columns with leaf-motifs, masks and finally the Imperial Crown of Austria, as also present in the city's coat of arms.

features.name: Houtmankade
features.opening: The Houtmankade is the designation of two Amsterdam canals.

facts.text: A council officially named this quay on May 15, 1878.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat kreeg haar naam in een raadsbesluit van 15 mei 1878.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street was named in a council decision of May 15, 1878.

facts.text: The eastern side of the quay is split into two parts because a canal interrupts it.
facts.sourceQuote: De Houtmankade (oostzijde), oneven nummering, bestaat uit 2 gedeelten, omdat deze zijde van de Houtmankade onderbroken wordt door de Zoutkeetsgracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Houtmankade (east side), odd numbering, consists of 2 parts, because this side of the Houtmankade is interrupted by the Zoutkeetsgracht.

features.name: Robert Scottstraat
features.opening: The Robert Scottstraat is a street in Amsterdam-West in the Robert Scott neighborhood named after him.

facts.text: Construction did not begin until a decade later during post-war reconstruction.
facts.sourceQuote: Het zou nog tien jaar duren voordat er gebouwd kon worden in de periode van wederopbouw na Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It would take another ten years before construction could begin in the period of reconstruction after World War II.

facts.text: A narrow bend prevents public transport or art installations within the street itself.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat met knik is vrij nauw, dus plaats voor kunst in de openbare ruimte is er niet, noch is de straat geschikt voor openbaar vervoer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street with the bend is quite narrow, so there is no place for art in the public space, nor is the street suitable for public transport.

facts.text: Odd house numbers run from 1 to 19 while even ones go up to 52 due to a missing block.
facts.sourceQuote: Oneven huisnummers lopen op van 1 tot en met 19; even huisnummers van 2 tot 52. Het verschil wordt veroorzaakt door een open ruimte aan westkant van de straat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Odd house numbers run from 1 to 19; even house numbers from 2 to 52. The difference is caused by an open space on the west side of the street.

facts.text: The open space in the street received its own name Robert Scottplein only in 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: Die open ruimte ligt er al sinds de aanleg van de straat, maar kreeg in 2015 pas een eigen naam Robert Scottplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That open space has been there since the construction of the street, but only received its own name Robert Scottplein in 2015.

facts.text: Architects Karel Petrus Tholens and Louis Jean George Marie van Steenhardt Carré designed the municipal monuments at numbers 28-34.
facts.sourceQuote: Van geheel andere orde zijn twee gemeentelijk monumenten: enerzijds Robert Scottstraat 28-34 van architecten Karel Petrus Tholens en Louis Jean George Marie van Steenhardt Carré en anderzijds Robert Scottstraat 7 eveneens ontworpen door Tholens, maar dan met Gerard Holt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Two municipal monuments are of a completely different order: on the one hand Robert Scottstraat 28-34 by architects Karel Petrus Tholens and Louis Jean George Marie van Steenhardt Carré and on the other hand Robert Scottstraat 7 also designed by Tholens, but then with Gerard Holt.

features.name: Meer en Vaart
features.opening: Meer en Vaart is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Until 1921, that estate served as the official residence for the mayor of Sloten.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit was tot 1921 de ambtswoning van de burgemeester van de gemeente Sloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This was until 1921 the official residence of the mayor of the municipality of Sloten.

facts.text: The original building was demolished in the 1940s before the Bos en Lommer district rose.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebouw is afgebroken in de jaren veertig voor de bouw van de wijk Bos en Lommer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was demolished in the 1940s before the construction of the Bos en Lommer district.

facts.text: A 1970 collision on this street created a specific legal term known as the Meer en Vaart judgment.
facts.sourceQuote: Een botsing op Meer en Vaart in 1970 leidde tot de rechtskundige term Meer en Vaart-arrest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A collision on Meer en Vaart in 1970 led to the legal term Meer en Vaart judgment.

facts.text: The busy intersection with Cornelis Lelylaan remains grade-separated because the road was never extended further west.
facts.sourceQuote: Verkeerstechnisch is nog van belang de drukke verkeerskruising met de Cornelis Lelylaan, ooit bedoeld als ongelijkvloers, maar doordat de Cornelis Lelylaan nooit verder westwaarts werd afgebouwd bleef ze gelijkvloers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From a traffic engineering point of view, the busy traffic intersection with the Cornelis Lelylaan is still important, which was once intended as a grade-separated intersection, but because the Cornelis Lelylaan was never further developed westwards, it remained grade-separated.

features.name: Burgemeester Röellstraat
features.opening: The Burgemeester Röellstraat is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: An elevated section was excavated in 2000 after being closed to regular traffic twelve years earlier.
facts.sourceQuote: Nauwelijks 12 jaar later werd het voor het doorgaande verkeer alweer buiten gebruik gesteld en het verhoogd liggende deel tussen de Van Leeuwenlaan en het Lambertus Zijlplein is in 2000 afgegraven waarbij de viaducten zijn gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Barely 12 years later, it was again put out of use for regular traffic and the elevated section between Van Leeuwenlaan and Lambertus Zijlplein was excavated in 2000, destroying the viaducts.

features.name: Purmerplein
features.opening: The Purmerplein in Amsterdam-North is a square in the village of Nieuwendam, which has belonged to the municipality of Amsterdam since 1921.

facts.text: Municipal Housing Service Amsterdam directed the district's construction.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Purmerplein vormt het centrum van Tuindorp Nieuwendam, een uitbreidingswijk met voornamelijk arbeiderswoningen die tussen 1924 en 1934 werd gebouwd onder regie van de Gemeentelijke Woningdienst Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Purmerplein forms the center of Tuindorp Nieuwendam, an expansion district with mainly worker's homes that was built between 1924 and 1934 under the direction of the Municipal Housing Service Amsterdam.

facts.text: The Purmerweg and Purmerplein were ready when Tuindorp Nieuwendam construction began.
facts.sourceQuote: De Purmerweg en het Purmerplein (dat een onderbreking is van de Purmerweg) kwamen gereed aan het begin van de aanleg van Tuindorp Nieuwendam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Purmerweg and the Purmerplein (which is a break in the Purmerweg) were ready at the beginning of the construction of Tuindorp Nieuwendam.

facts.text: Purmerplein acts as a break within the continuous Purmerweg route.
facts.sourceQuote: De Purmerweg en het Purmerplein (dat een onderbreking is van de Purmerweg) kwamen gereed aan het begin van de aanleg van Tuindorp Nieuwendam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Purmerweg and the Purmerplein (which is a break in the Purmerweg) were ready at the beginning of the construction of Tuindorp Nieuwendam.

features.name: Zuiderzeeweg
features.opening: The Zuiderzeeweg is the name of a number of Dutch roads, including in Amsterdam and Middenmeer.

facts.text: A former East Sewage Treatment Plant once stood on Zeeburgereiland before relocating.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het eiland bevond zich de Rioolwaterzuiveringsinrichting Oost maar deze is verplaatst naar het Westelijk Havengebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the island was the East Sewage Treatment Plant but this has been relocated to the Western Harbor Area.

facts.text: Pedestrian staircases lead down from the Amsterdam Bridge to Camping Zeeburg.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarna loopt de weg over de Amsterdamsebrug, waarbij aan de zuidzijde een trap voor voetgangers en fietsers naar beneden is aangebracht die leidt naar Camping Zeeburg en de Diemerzeedijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, the road runs over the Amsterdam Bridge, where on the south side a staircase for pedestrians and cyclists has been installed leading down to Camping Zeeburg and the Diemerzeedijk.

features.name: Prinses Irenestraat
features.opening: The Prinses Irenestraat is a street in the Amsterdam district of Zuid, on the edge of the Zuidas.

facts.text: A former school building on the site was demolished in 2013 to make way for offices.
facts.sourceQuote: Het oude schoolgebouw is in 2013 gesloopt om plaats te maken voor kantoren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The old school building was demolished in 2013 to make way for offices.

facts.text: A pentagonal playground near the street is locally nicknamed the Pentagon.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen de straat en het Zuidplein, bij het eind van de Minervalaan, ligt een vijfhoekig speelterrein (soms "Pentagon" genoemd).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between the street and the Zuidplein, at the end of the Minervalaan, there is a pentagonal playground (sometimes called "Pentagon").

features.name: Cornelis Lelylaan
features.opening: The Cornelis Lelylaan is a city motorway in Amsterdam (part of the city route s106) that connects the districts West and Nieuw-West.

facts.text: The road honors Cornelis Lely, the engineer who designed the Zuiderzeewerken waterworks.
facts.sourceQuote: De weg is vernoemd naar Cornelis Lely (1854-1929), waterbouwkundige, minister en gouverneur en de ontwerper van de Zuiderzeewerken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The road is named after Cornelis Lely (1854-1929), civil engineer, minister and governor and the designer of the Zuiderzeewerken.

facts.text: The road is spanned by viaducts of the western ring railway at Lelylaan Station.
facts.sourceQuote: Ter hoogte van het Station Lelylaan wordt de weg zelf overspannen door viaducten van de westelijke ringspoorbaan: de Lelylaanmetrobrug en de Lelylaanspoorbrug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the Lelylaan Station, the road itself is spanned by viaducts of the western ring railway: the Lelylaan metro bridge and the Lelylaan railway bridge.

facts.text: Multiple bridges cross waterways like the Postjeswetering and streets such as Derkinderenstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: Een aantal bruggen en viaducten voeren de Cornelis Lelylaan over waterwegen en straten: Brug 386 over de Postjeswetering/Westlandgracht, Viaduct(en) over de Ringweg-West, Brug 689 over Derkinderenstraat/Delflandlaan met afslag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A number of bridges and viaducts cross the Cornelis Lelylaan over waterways and streets: Bridge 386 over the Postjeswetering/Westlandgracht, Viaduct(s) over the Ringweg-West, Bridge 689 over Derkinderenstraat/Delflandlaan with exit.

features.name: Haarlemmermeerstraat
features.opening: The Haarlemmermeerstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Amsterdam laid out this street in 1927 using territory annexed from Sloten six years earlier.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat werd aangelegd in 1927 op het grondgebied van de in 1921 geannexeerde gemeente Sloten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street was laid out in 1927 on the territory of the municipality of Sloten, which was annexed in 1921.

features.name: Aalsmeerweg
features.opening: The Aalsmeerweg is a street in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: Until 1975, this road served as the main access route from The Hague and Schiphol.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 1975, toen de Ringweg Zuid werd geopend, was de Aalsmeerweg de invalsweg vanuit de richting Den Haag en Schiphol, omdat deze in het verlengde lag van de Oude Haagseweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1975, when the Ringweg Zuid was opened, the Aalsmeerweg was the access road from the direction of The Hague and Schiphol, because it was part of the extension of the Oude Haagseweg.

features.name: Weesperstraat
features.opening: The Weesperstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: Department store Vroom & Dreesman opened its first shop at number 70 in 1887.
facts.sourceQuote: De straat telde veel winkels; zo vestigden Vroom & Dreesman in 1887 op nummer 70 hun eerste zaak, De Zon geheten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The street had many shops; for example, Vroom & Dreesman established their first store in 1887 at number 70, called De Zon.

facts.text: During the harsh winter of 1944-1945, wood and materials were stripped from empty Jewish homes.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de deportatie van Joden werd tijdens de koude hongerwinter van 1944-1945 uit hun leegstaande huizen het hout en ander bruikbaar materiaal gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the deportation of Jews, during the harsh winter of 1944-1945, the wood and other usable materials were demolished from their empty houses.

facts.text: Original buildings were demolished in the 1960s to widen the street into a highway.
facts.sourceQuote: De oorspronkelijke bebouwing is afgebroken in de jaren zestig, waarna de straat is verbreed tot een stadsautoweg, die het J.D.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original buildings were demolished in the 1960s, after which the street was widened into a city highway, which connects the J.D.

facts.text: Bridge 240 honors L.H., the last pre-war chief rabbi who died in Poland in 1942.
facts.sourceQuote: Brug 240 over de Nieuwe Keizersgracht, hoek Weesperstraat, is vernoemd naar de in 1942 in Polen omgekomen laatste vooroorlogse opperrabbijn L.H.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Bridge 240 over the Nieuwe Keizersgracht, corner Weesperstraat, is named after the last pre-war chief rabbi L.H. who died in Poland in 1942.

features.name: Amsterdamseweg
features.opening: The Amsterdamseweg is an important street in Amstelveen, Netherlands.

facts.text: Houses line the old dike, creating a unique souterrain level beneath each home.
facts.sourceQuote: Nowadays, the houses are built up against the dike, that's why the houses of the Amsterdamseweg have a souterrain.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nowadays, the houses are built up against the dike, that's why the houses of the Amsterdamseweg have a souterrain.

features.name: Prins Hendrikkade
features.opening: The Kattenburgerplein is a square in Kattenburg in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: Most original buildings vanished during the Kattenburg redevelopment between 1963 and 1976.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de sanering van Kattenburg in de jaren 1963-1976 werd het merendeel van de bebouwing gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the redevelopment of Kattenburg in the years 1963-1976, most of the buildings were demolished.

facts.text: The northern facade looks old but was actually constructed in 1970 as a historical reconstruction.
facts.sourceQuote: De noordelijke gevelwand van het plein ziet er oud uit, maar betreft bouw uit 1970. De gereconstrueerde geveltjes aan het Kattenburgerplein herinneren aan de historische bebouwing.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The northern facade wall of the square looks old, but concerns construction from 1970. The reconstructed facades on the Kattenburgerplein remind of the historical buildings.

facts.text: House numbers skip wildly, restarting at 27 and again at 38 after major omissions.
facts.sourceQuote: De huisnummers lopen op van 1 tot en met 91, maar er zitten grote omissies in de nummering. Na huisnummer 1 loopt de teller pas weer vanaf huisnummer 27 voor drie woonboten, daarna begint de reeks opnieuw bij 38 (gegevens 2019).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house numbers run from 1 to 91, but there are major omissions in the numbering. After house number 1, the counter only starts again from house number 27 for three residential boats, after which the series starts again at 38 (data 2019).

facts.text: The 17th-century Zeemagazijn building has housed the National Maritime Museum since 1973.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan het plein staat het 17e-eeuwse gebouw 's Lands Zeemagazijn, sinds 1973 in gebruik als Het Scheepvaartmuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the square stands the 17th-century building 's Lands Zeemagazijn, which has been in use as Het Scheepvaartmuseum since 1973.

facts.text: A distinctive tower crowns an 1898 municipal monument designed by Willem Kromhout.
facts.sourceQuote: Op huisnummer 38, in de knik in het plein naar de gracht, staat een gemeentelijk monument uit 1898, ontworpen door Willem Kromhout. Het gebouw is opgesierd met een markant torentje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At house number 38, in the bend in the square leading to the canal, there is a municipal monument from 1898, designed by Willem Kromhout. The building is adorned with a distinctive tower.

features.name: Parnassusweg
features.opening: The Parnassusweg is a street in the Amsterdam district of Zuid.

facts.text: In the 1950s, the road was extended toward Buitenveldert to reach the A10 ring road.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren vijftig werd de weg verlengd richting Buitenveldert en liep tot de ringweg van Amsterdam, de A10.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1950s, the road was extended towards Buitenveldert and ran to the ring road of Amsterdam, the A10.

facts.text: Since 1972, the road has been raised to create a highway-like appearance with lower paths for cyclists and pedestrians.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf de Prinses Irenestraat tot aan de Ringweg-Zuid heeft de weg een snelwegachtig aanzien doordat de weg sinds de aansluiting op de Strawinskylaan in 1972 verhoogd is terwijl fiets- en voetpaden zich lager bevinden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From Prinses Irenestraat to the Ringweg-Zuid, the road has a highway-like appearance because the road has been raised since the connection to Strawinskylaan in 1972 while bicycle and pedestrian paths are lower.

facts.text: Tram line 5 began operating on the southern section of the street in 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Ten zuiden van de Strawinskylaan rijdt sinds 2008 tramlijn 5 over de weg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2008, tram line 5 has been running over the road south of Strawinskylaan.

features.name: Nieuwe Doelenstraat
features.opening: The Nieuwe Doelenstraat is a street in the city center of Amsterdam.

facts.text: The name Nieuwe Doelenstraat distinguishes it from the older Old Doelenstraat built in the fifteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: De aanduiding "Nieuwe" is overigens ter onderscheid met de Oude Doelenstraat, die werd aangelegd in de vijftiende eeuw op de plek van de oudste doelen van de stad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By the way, the designation "Nieuwe" is used to distinguish it from the Old Doelenstraat, which was built in the fifteenth century on the site of the oldest goals of the city.

facts.text: Rembrandt van Rijn once lived on this street alongside other notable residents like Frederik Muller.
facts.sourceQuote: Enkele bekende inwoners van de straat die vroeger hier woonden zijn Rembrandt van Rijn, Frederik Muller, Pieter de Carpentier, Bartholomeus van der Helst, Jan J.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some well-known residents of the street who used to live here are Rembrandt van Rijn, Frederik Muller, Pieter de Carpentier, Bartholomeus van der Helst, Jan J.

facts.text: The University Theater and Institute for Theatre Studies are part of the University of Amsterdam located here.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de straat bevindt zich ook een deel van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA), waaronder het Universiteitstheater en het Instituut voor Theaterwetenschap.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the street is also part of the University of Amsterdam (UvA), including the University Theater and the Institute for Theatre Studies.

features.name: Ecuplein
features.opening: The Ecuplein is a square in the De Aker district in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Streets surrounding the square are named after various currencies like the Pound Sterling.
facts.sourceQuote: Het plein en de straten ten zuiden en ten oosten zijn genoemd naar valuta, met de Valutaboulevard, Pond Sterlinglaan etc.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The square and the streets to the south and east are named after currencies, with the Valutaboulevard, Pond Sterlinglaan etc.

facts.text: The Zorroflat on the west side is an eighteen-floor tower standing fifty-four meters high.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de westzijde staat de Zorroflat, 18 verdiepingen, 54 meter hoog, van 1999.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the west side is the Zorroflat, 18 floors, 54 meters high, from 1999.

features.name: Laan van Spartaan
features.opening: Laan van Spartaan is a residential neighborhood in the Amsterdam district of West, formerly district of Bos en Lommer.

facts.text: Construction started in 2007 and finished in April 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw startte in 2007 en werd voltooid in april 2021.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 2007 and was completed in April 2021.

facts.text: Housing corporation Ymere and developer Bouwfonds built the neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuote: De wijk is ontwikkeld door woningcorporatie Ymere en projectontwikkelaar Bouwfonds.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The district was developed by housing corporation Ymere and project developer Bouwfonds.

facts.text: A baseball club called the Detach Pirates once trained here before moving to Osdorp in 2000.
facts.sourceQuote: Het sportpark omvatte oorspronkelijk vier voetbalvelden, een clubhuis voor de voetbalclub VVA/Spartaan en een honkbalveld met trainingsveld en clubhuis voor Detach Pirates. Deze honkbalvereniging verhuisde in 2000 als Amsterdam Pirates naar Sportpark Ookmeer in Osdorp.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The sports park originally included four football fields, a clubhouse for the football club VVA/Spartaan and a baseball field with training field and clubhouse for Detach Pirates. This baseball club moved in 2000 as Amsterdam Pirates to Sportpark Ookmeer in Osdorp.

features.name: Westerpark
features.opening: The Westerpark (English: Western Park) is a public urban park in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

facts.text: Architect Isaac Gosschalk designed the buildings in Dutch neo-renaissance style under director J. Pazzani.
facts.sourceQuote: The buildings are designed by architect Isaac Gosschalk in the then-popular Dutch neo-renaissance style under the supervision of J. Pazzani, director of the new gas plant, who would decide on the location of the various buildings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The buildings are designed by architect Isaac Gosschalk in the then-popular Dutch neo-renaissance style under the supervision of J. Pazzani, director of the new gas plant, who would decide on the location of the various buildings.

facts.text: The city ended the private concession in 1898 and added a coke gas plant to the facility.
facts.sourceQuote: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.

facts.text: Two large coal gas containers from the original industrial era remain visible today.
facts.sourceQuote: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gas produced from coal is stored in large gas containers, two of which are still visible today The city puts an end to the concession in 1898, taking over the plant and added an additional coke gas plant.

facts.text: The former borough and current neighborhood both take their name from this park.
facts.sourceQuote: The former borough (stadsdeel) of Westerpark is named after the park, as is the current neighborhood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former borough (stadsdeel) of Westerpark is named after the park, as is the current neighborhood.

facts.text: The verdant space formerly housed the Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg.
facts.sourceQuote: The verdant space of the former Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg has become a place for cultural avant-garde businesses and events.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The verdant space of the former Westergasfabriek gasworks along Haarlemmerweg has become a place for cultural avant-garde businesses and events.

features.name: Westerdoksdijk
features.opening: The Westerdokseiland is an island in Amsterdam between the Westerdok and the IJ.

facts.text: The island formed in 1832 when a dam cut off tidal influence from the North Sea.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontstond in 1832 toen door aanleg van de Westerdoksdam dit deel van het IJ werd afgescheiden en daardoor ook geen eb en vloed meer kende in het tot 1870 nog in open verbinding met de Zuiderzee staande IJ.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It arose in 1832 when the construction of the Westerdoksdam separated this part of the IJ and therefore no longer experienced tides in the IJ, which was still in open connection with the North Sea until 1870.

facts.text: Over 150 wild plant species grew there, including black pepper and sorghum.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het amper vier hectare grote eiland groeiden meer dan 150 wilde plantensoorten. Dat had alles te maken met het havenverleden van het eiland, en de aanwezigheid van het Koloniaal etablissement aan de Westerdoksdijk. Geen werelddeel ontbrak: aardpeer, alsemambrosia, bezemkruid, sorgo, kafferkoren en zegekruid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the barely four hectares large island, more than 150 wild plant species grew. That had everything to do with the island's port past, and the presence of the Colonial establishment on the Westerdoksdijk. No continent was missing: potato, chamomile, broomweed, sorghum, black pepper and marjoram.

features.name: 's-Gravendijkdreef
features.opening: The 's-Gravendijkdreef connects the Bijlmerdreef at Groenhoven and Gouden Leeuw, originally also Grunder and since then Nieuw-Grunder, in the east of the…

facts.text: s-Gravendijkdreef was named after a farm in Noordwijkerhout by council decision in January 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: De dreef is bij een raadsbesluit van 20 januari 1971 vernoemd naar een boerderij in Noordwijkerhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The drive was named after a farm in Noordwijkerhout by a council decision of January 20, 1971.

facts.text: The drive was lowered into a city street during the Bijlmermeer renewal in the late 1990s.
facts.sourceQuote: In de tweede helft van de jaren negentig werd de dreef in het kader van de vernieuwing van de Bijlmermeer verlaagd, verdwenen als gevolg daarvan de viaducten (brug 1019 tot en met brug 1026) en werd ze veranderd in een stadsstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the second half of the 1990s, the dreef was lowered as part of the renewal of the Bijlmermeer, the viaducts (bridge 1019 to and with bridge 1026) disappeared as a result and it was changed into a city street.

features.name: Speelmanstraat
features.opening: Speelmanstraat is a street in the Amsterdam garden city of Slotermeer.

facts.text: Speelmanstraat joins Theodorus Dobbestraat and Freek Oxstraat as streets named after Dutch resistance fighters.
facts.sourceQuote: Alle drie de straten zijn vernoemd naar verzetsstrijders (Theodorus Dobbe en Freek Ox), zo ook de enige straat waarmee de Speelmanstraat kruist, de Lex Althoffstraat (Lex Althoff).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All three streets are named after resistance fighters (Theodorus Dobbe and Freek Ox), as is the only street the Speelmanstraat crosses, the Lex Althoffstraat (Lex Althoff).

facts.text: South-facing ends kept original cladding while other blocks received new insulation.
facts.sourceQuote: De kopse zuidkant van het blok kreeg in tegenstelling tot andere identieke bouwblokken geen uitwendige isolatie, de glaspartijen werden niet vervangen door ramen met kunststof kozijnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unlike other identical building blocks, the south-facing end of the block did not receive external insulation, the glass panels were not replaced by windows with plastic frames.

features.name: Prins Bernhardplein
features.opening: The Prins Bernhardplein is a square in the Amsterdam district of Watergraafsmeer.

facts.text: During the 1973 oil crisis, only buses were allowed to drive straight across.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de oliecrisis van 1973 mocht alleen de bus wel rechtdoor over de rotonde en hoefde de omweg niet meer te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the 1973 oil crisis, only the bus was allowed to go straight across the roundabout and no longer had to make the detour.

facts.text: A statue named Beursmannetje has stood here since 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 2012 staat het beeld Beursmannetje van Pieter d'Hont aan de noordzijde van het plein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2012, the statue Beursmannetje by Pieter d'Hont has stood on the north side of the square.

features.name: Provinciale weg
features.opening: The Netherlands is both a very densely populated and a highly developed country in which transport is a key factor of the economy.

facts.text: Dedicated cycling infrastructure covers 35,000 km and is physically separated from motorized traffic.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dutch also have a well developed railway network, that connects most towns and cities, as well as a comprehensive dedicated cycling infrastructure, featuring some 35,000 km of track physically segregated from motorised traffic.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dutch also have a well developed railway network, that connects most towns and cities, as well as a comprehensive dedicated cycling infrastructure, featuring some 35,000 km of track physically segregated from motorised traffic.

facts.text: Half of all trips in the Netherlands are made by car, while a quarter use bicycles.
facts.sourceQuote: Around half of all trips in the Netherlands are made by car, 25% by bicycle, 20% walking, and 5% by public transport.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around half of all trips in the Netherlands are made by car, 25% by bicycle, 20% walking, and 5% by public transport.

facts.text: In 2013, these provincial roads covered 7,778 km, making them longer than the entire national road network.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2013, 5,191 km were national roads, 7,778 km were provincial roads, and 125,230 km were municipality and other roads.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2013, 5,191 km were national roads, 7,778 km were provincial roads, and 125,230 km were municipality and other roads.

features.name: Gooiseweg
features.opening: The Gooiseweg is part of the Amsterdam city route s112 and runs from Prins Bernhardplein near Amstel station to Gaasperdam.

facts.text: The northern section opened on May 2, 1960, ending at the Hartveldsebrug.
facts.sourceQuote: Het noordelijke deel tussen het Prins Bernhardplein en de Hartveldsebrug op de grens met Diemen (thans kruising met de ringweg A10) is op 2 mei 1960 ongelijkvloers in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The northern part between Prins Bernhardplein and the Hartveldsebrug on the border with Diemen (now intersection with the ring road A10) was put into use on May 2, 1960.

facts.text: Unused bridgeheads remain visible where the road crosses Daalwijkdreef.
facts.sourceQuote: Daar waar de Gooiseweg de Daalwijkdreef kruist is dat goed te zien aan de ongebruikte brughoofden aan de oostzijde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Where the Gooiseweg crosses the Daalwijkdreef, this can be clearly seen at the unused bridgeheads on the east side.

facts.text: The temporary road featured strange serpentine bends and poor paving because it had to be relocated repeatedly.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat het zandlichaam voor de definitieve weg al wel in aanleg was moest de hulpweg regelmatig op meerdere plaatsen worden verlegd. Hierdoor kende de weg vreemde serpetineachtige bochtenen was ook nog eens slecht bestraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the sand body was already in place for the final road, the auxiliary road had to be regularly relocated in several places. As a result, the road had strange serpentine bends and was also poorly paved.

features.name: Langbroekdreef
features.opening: The Langbroekdreef is a dike in the subdistrict Nellestein in the Gaasperdam district in Amsterdam-Zuidoost.

facts.text: Fast traffic officially opened on February 8, 1982, after a temporary resident-only period ended.
facts.sourceQuote: Het eerste gedeelte, afgezien van de tijdelijke ontsluiting voor de bewoners van de wijk Nellestein tussen 1977 en 1982, voor snelverkeer werd geopend op 8 februari 1982.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first section, apart from the temporary opening for the residents of the Nellestein district between 1977 and 1982, for fast traffic was opened on February 8, 1982.

facts.text: The road is largely elevated to match urban planning principles for the Zuid Bijlmer expansion.
facts.sourceQuote: De dreef is grotendeels hooggelegen conform de uitgangspunten van het stedenbouwkundig plan voor de destijds nog als Zuid Bijlmer benoemde uitbreiding.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The drive is largely elevated in accordance with the principles of the urban planning plan for the expansion that was then still called Zuid Bijlmer.

facts.text: A fire station called Anton has been located at number 10 since 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de noordzijde bij de Gooiseweg staat sinds 2016 op huisnummer 10 brandweerkazerne "Anton".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the north side near Gooiseweg, the fire station "Anton" has been located at house number 10 since 2016.

features.name: Europaboulevard
features.opening: The Europaboulevard is a street in Buitenveldert in Amsterdam-Zuid.

facts.text: The nhow Amsterdam RAI hotel opened on the west side in 2019, followed by the Terrace Tower in 2020.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de westkant staan de zuidelijke gebouwen van het RAI-complex met daar aan de zuidpunt sinds 2019 het hotel nhow Amsterdam RAI, aan de oostkant kwam in 2020 de Terrace Tower.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the west side are the southern buildings of the RAI complex with the nhow Amsterdam RAI hotel at the southern tip since 2019, on the east side the Terrace Tower came in 2020.

facts.text: While the naming occurred in 1958, the specific section in Buitenveldert received its name in 1961.
facts.sourceQuote: De Europaboulevard werd op 16 juli 1958 vernoemd naar het werelddeel Europa naar aanleiding van een resolutie van de Raadgevende Vergadering van de Raad van Europa 29 december 1957, waarbij iedere gemeente in Europa werd gevraagd een straat of plein hiernaar te vernoemen. Het deel dat in Buitenveldert loopt kreeg in 1961 zijn naam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Europaboulevard was named after the continent of Europe on July 16, 1958 following a resolution of the Advisory Assembly of the Council of Europe of December 29, 1957, in which every municipality in Europe was asked to name a street or square after it. The part that runs in Buitenveldert was named in 1961.

features.name: Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan
features.opening: The Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan is located in the district ("garden city") Slotermeer in the Amsterdam municipality of Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Burgemeester Vening Meineszlaan received its official name on July 9, 1952.
facts.sourceQuote: De statige laan met vleugelnootbomen aan weerskanten kreeg haar naam op 9 juli 1952 en werd vernoemd naar Sjoerd Anne Vening Meinesz (1833-1909), onder andere burgemeester van Amsterdam van 1891 tot 1901, maar eerder ook van Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stately avenue with wingnut trees on both sides was named on July 9, 1952 and was named after Sjoerd Anne Vening Meinesz (1833-1909), among other things mayor of Amsterdam from 1891 to 1901, but also previously of Rotterdam.

facts.text: A section of the lane borders Meerwaldt park, home to many special and monumental trees.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van de laan grenst ook aan het Meerwaldtplantsoen, waar tal van bijzondere en monumentale bomen staan, en het rond 1986 gebouwde woningcomplex Meerwaldt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Part of the lane also borders the Meerwaldt park, where there are many special and monumental trees, and the Meerwaldt housing complex built around 1986.

facts.text: Parking spaces near De Kandelaar were removed during a 2011 restructuring, forcing south-side residents to cross the street.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit geldt ook voor het deel van de laan waar alle bij de woningen aanliggende parkeerplaatsen tijdens de herstructurering rond 2011 werden verwijderd, schuin tegenover gebouw De Kandelaar. Bewoners van de zuidkant zijn daar sindsdien gedwongen, altijd de rijbaan over te steken als zij van of naar hun geparkeerde auto gaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This also applies to the part of the lane where all parking spaces adjacent to the houses were removed during the restructuring around 2011, diagonally opposite building De Kandelaar. Residents on the south side have since been forced to always cross the road when going to or from their parked car.

facts.text: Blue zones introduced around 2010 gradually eased parking issues, though pressure remained high near Sloterdijk Station.
facts.sourceQuote: De gefaseerde instelling van blauwe zones rond 2010 heeft deze problematiek in fases verzacht voor delen van de laan. Dichter bij de toegang naar het Station Sloterdijk (de Burgemeester Fockstraat) is de parkeerdruk groot gebleven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The phased establishment of blue zones around 2010 has eased this problem in phases for parts of the avenue. Closer to the entrance to Sloterdijk Station (the Burgemeester Fockstraat), the parking pressure has remained high.

features.name: Zeeburgerdijk
features.opening: The Zeeburgerdijk is a dike in Amsterdam-Oost.

facts.text: Zeeburgerdijk takes its name from the Seeburg fortress that stood here in the 17th century.
facts.sourceQuote: De Zeeburgerdijk is vernoemd naar de vesting Seeburg, die hier in de 17e eeuw stond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zeeburgerdijk is named after the fortress Seeburg, which stood here in the 17th century.

facts.text: From 1925 to 1944, Zeeburgerdorp housed families deemed unadapted alongside a boarding school.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de overkant van het Lozingskanaal, aan het einde van het Zeeburgerpad, lag van 1925 tot 1944 het Zeeburgerdorp, een woonschool met woningen voor "onaangepaste" gezinnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the other side of the Lozings Canal, at the end of the Zeeburgerpad, was the Zeeburgerdorp from 1925 to 1944, a boarding school with houses for "unadapted" families.

features.name: Noorder IJplas
features.opening: The Noorder IJplas is a sand mining pond in the former Noorder IJpolder in northwest Amsterdam.

facts.text: Scottish Highland cattle graze under high-voltage pylons to stop trees from growing there.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de open plekken zijn Schotse hooglanders ingezet voor begrazing om zo te voorkomen dat er bomen groeien onder de hoogspanningsmasten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scottish Highland cattle are used for grazing on the open spaces to prevent trees from growing under the high-voltage pylons.

features.name: Slotervaart
features.opening: Slotervaart may refer to: Slotervaart (neighborhood) (Tuinstad Slotervaart), a neighborhood of Amsterdam (since 1955) Slotervaart (former borough) (Stadsdeel…

facts.text: The neighborhood has existed since 1955 as Tuinstad Slotervaart.
facts.sourceQuote: Slotervaart may refer to: Slotervaart (neighborhood) (Tuinstad Slotervaart), a neighborhood of Amsterdam (since 1955) Slotervaart (former borough) (Stadsdeel Slotervaart), a former borough of Amsterdam (1990–2010), which included the neighborhood Slotervaart, now part of the borough Amsterdam Nieuw-West
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Slotervaart may refer to: Slotervaart (neighborhood) (Tuinstad Slotervaart), a neighborhood of Amsterdam (since 1955) Slotervaart (former borough) (Stadsdeel Slotervaart), a former borough of Amsterdam (1990–2010), which included the neighborhood Slotervaart, now part of the borough Amsterdam Nieuw-West

features.name: Weteringpoort
features.opening: The Water Management Lock (lock 209) is a lock in the center of Amsterdam between Lijnbaansgracht and Singelgracht.

facts.text: A commissioner's house was added in 1842 at Weteringschans 30, now a national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Om toegang te kunnen krijgen tot de stad werd in 1842 een commiezenhuis, later Weteringschans 30 en rijksmonument, gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In order to gain access to the city, a commissioner's house was built in 1842, later Weteringschans 30 and a national monument.

features.name: Westlandgrachtsluis
features.opening: The Westlandgrachtsluit, also known as Westlandgrachtsluis, is a sluice gate in Overtoomse Veld in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

facts.text: Engineers designed the structure to bridge a 1.70-meter water level difference between the city and the polder.
facts.sourceQuote: De sluis is ter overbrugging van het verschil in waterpeil ten oosten (stadsboezempeil in de Westlandgracht) en ten westen (polderpeil in de Slotervaart) van 1,70 meter.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The lock is to bridge the difference in water level east (city basin level in the Westlandgracht) and west (polder level in the Slotervaart) of 1.70 meters.

facts.text: Artist Gérard Leonard van den Eerenbeemt created a 1979 sculpture named Golf with spring tension nearby.
facts.sourceQuote: Kunstenaar Gérard Leonard van den Eerenbeemt haalde inspiratie uit de sluis voor zijn kunstwerk Golf met drukveer uit 1979, geplaatst naast de sluis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Artist Gérard Leonard van den Eerenbeemt drew inspiration from the lock for his work Golf with spring tension from 1979, placed next to the lock.

features.name: Nieuwe Keizersgracht
features.opening: The Nieuwe Keizersgracht is a canal in Amsterdam, part of the eastern Grachtengordel (canal belt).

facts.text: The section east of the Amstel was dug during a final extension.
facts.sourceQuote: With the last extension, the part east of the Amstel was dug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With the last extension, the part east of the Amstel was dug.

features.name: Heiligewegsluis
features.opening: The Heiligewegsluis is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

facts.text: The original lifting bridge vanished in 1792 before a permanent structure replaced it.
facts.sourceQuote: De oorspronkelijke ophaalbrug verdween in 1792. Er kwam een vaste brug.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The original lifting bridge disappeared in 1792. A permanent bridge was built.

facts.text: By 2017 the span exceeded 45 meters wide while its passage remained under seven meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De brug is in 2017 meer dan 45 meter breed, terwijl de doorvaartbreedte slechts nog geen 7 meter bedraagt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bridge is more than 45 meters wide in 2017, while the passage width is only just under 7 meters.

features.name: Albardagracht
features.opening: The Albardagracht is a canal in the Amsterdam district of Geuzenveld.

facts.text: A viaduct crossing the water served traffic for only fifteen years before demolition.
facts.sourceQuote: Van begin jaren zestig tot eind jaren negentig kruiste de Abraham Kuyperlaan ongelijkvloers met een viaduct de gracht. Dit viaduct lag er 20 jaar ongebruikt bij en is daarna slechts 15 jaar voor het verkeer gebruikt waarna het werd afgebroken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the early 1960s to the late 1990s, the Abraham Kuyperlaan crossed the canal at an intersection with a viaduct. This viaduct remained unused for 20 years and was only used for traffic for 15 years after that before being demolished.

features.name: Leliegracht
features.opening: The Leliegracht (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈleːliˌɣrɑxt]; Lily Canal) is a canal in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, between Herengracht (no. 148 and 169) and…

facts.text: Excavation began after 1612 when the canal belt was created south of the Brouwersgracht.
facts.sourceQuote: The canal was dug after 1612 when the canal belt was created south of the Brouwersgracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The canal was dug after 1612 when the canal belt was created south of the Brouwersgracht.

facts.text: A lock remains visible on the Prinsengracht side to manage different water levels.
facts.sourceQuote: The remains of a lock can be recognized on the Prinsengracht side. That lock was necessary because the water of the Prinsengracht (along with the rest of the Jordaan Canals) remained at the polder level, while the water level in the Leliegracht, Keizersgracht and Herengracht was at the higher city level.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The remains of a lock can be recognized on the Prinsengracht side. That lock was necessary because the water of the Prinsengracht (along with the rest of the Jordaan Canals) remained at the polder level, while the water level in the Leliegracht, Keizersgracht and Herengracht was at the higher city level.

facts.text: The Astoria building at the corner features Art Nouveau architecture built in 1905.
facts.sourceQuote: The 'Astoria' building on the corner of the Leliegracht and the Keizersgracht is an example of Art Nouveau architecture. It was built in 1905 by order of the 'Eerste Hollandse Levensverzekerings-Bank' after designs by architects Gerrit van Arkel and Herman Hendrik Baanders.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Astoria' building on the corner of the Leliegracht and the Keizersgracht is an example of Art Nouveau architecture. It was built in 1905 by order of the 'Eerste Hollandse Levensverzekerings-Bank' after designs by architects Gerrit van Arkel and Herman Hendrik Baanders.

facts.text: A pair of houses with neck gables dates back to around 1725.
facts.sourceQuote: Leliegracht 41-43 (built around 1725 ) is a twin building with neck gables in Style Louis XIV.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Leliegracht 41-43 (built around 1725 ) is a twin building with neck gables in Style Louis XIV.

features.name: IJ
features.opening: The IJ (Dutch: [ɛi] ; sometimes shown on old maps as Y or Ye) is a body of water, formerly a bay, in the Dutch province of North Holland.

facts.text: The largest part of the IJ was reclaimed between 1865 and 1876 to create new polders.
facts.sourceQuote: The Haarlemmermeer was first, falling dry in 1852, and the largest part of the IJ followed suit between 1865 and 1876, with only a small lake remaining at Amsterdam that was closed off from the Zuiderzee by the Oranje locks.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Haarlemmermeer was first, falling dry in 1852, and the largest part of the IJ followed suit between 1865 and 1876, with only a small lake remaining at Amsterdam that was closed off from the Zuiderzee by the Oranje locks.

facts.text: The Buiten-IJ hosted mixed dinghy sailing events during the 1928 Summer Olympics in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: The Buiten-IJ hosted the mixed dinghy sailing events for the 1928 Summer Olympics in neighboring Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Buiten-IJ hosted the mixed dinghy sailing events for the 1928 Summer Olympics in neighboring Amsterdam.

facts.text: Oranjesluizen locks divide the waterway into an inner section and an outer extension.
facts.sourceQuote: Today, the IJ is divided into two parts: To the west of the Oranjesluizen (Oranje Locks), the Binnen-IJ (inner IJ), or Afgesloten-IJ (closed IJ), is directly connected to the North Sea Canal, where the port of IJmuiden and the North Sea can be reached. To the east of the Oranjesluizen, the Buiten-IJ (outer IJ) is an extension of the IJmeer which is itself an extension of the Markermeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today, the IJ is divided into two parts: To the west of the Oranjesluizen (Oranje Locks), the Binnen-IJ (inner IJ), or Afgesloten-IJ (closed IJ), is directly connected to the North Sea Canal, where the port of IJmuiden and the North Sea can be reached. To the east of the Oranjesluizen, the Buiten-IJ (outer IJ) is an extension of the IJmeer which is itself an extension of the Markermeer.

facts.text: The western part connects directly to the North Sea Canal while the eastern side extends the IJmeer.
facts.sourceQuote: Today, the IJ is divided into two parts: To the west of the Oranjesluizen (Oranje Locks), the Binnen-IJ (inner IJ), or Afgesloten-IJ (closed IJ), is directly connected to the North Sea Canal, where the port of IJmuiden and the North Sea can be reached. To the east of the Oranjesluizen, the Buiten-IJ (outer IJ) is an extension of the IJmeer which is itself an extension of the Markermeer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today, the IJ is divided into two parts: To the west of the Oranjesluizen (Oranje Locks), the Binnen-IJ (inner IJ), or Afgesloten-IJ (closed IJ), is directly connected to the North Sea Canal, where the port of IJmuiden and the North Sea can be reached. To the east of the Oranjesluizen, the Buiten-IJ (outer IJ) is an extension of the IJmeer which is itself an extension of the Markermeer.

features.name: Noordhollandsch Kanaal
features.opening: The Noordhollandsch Kanaal ("Great North Holland Canal") is a canal originally meant for ocean-going ships.

facts.text: Until about 1880, ocean-going ships were towed along this route from Den Helder to Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: However, from its construction till about 1880 it had a totally different character, because it was a canal meant for ocean-going ships. Ships would sail from the Americas or East-Asia, and then be towed along the canal from Den Helder to Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, from its construction till about 1880 it had a totally different character, because it was a canal meant for ocean-going ships. Ships would sail from the Americas or East-Asia, and then be towed along the canal from Den Helder to Amsterdam.

features.name: Het Slochter
features.opening: Het Slochter is part of the North Holland Canal in North Holland.

facts.text: The waterway was straightened to the right when the North Holland Canal was dug between 1819 and 1824.
facts.sourceQuote: Wanneer het Noordhollandsch Kanaal tussen 1819 en 1824 wordt gegraven, wordt deels gebruik gemaakt van bestaande waterwegen, alhoewel Het Slochter wel is rechtsgetrokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the North Holland Canal is dug between 1819 and 1824, part of it is made use of existing waterways, although Het Slochter was straightened to the right.

facts.text: Even in the twenty-first century, this section remains wider than the canal stretches immediately north or south of it.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook in de 21e eeuw is dat deel kanaal breder dan ten zuiden van de knik of ten noorden van Het Schouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Even in the 21st century, that part of the canal is wider than south of the bend or north of Het Schouw.

features.name: Hugo de Grootgracht
features.opening: The Hugo de Grootgracht is a canal in Amsterdam-West.

facts.text: The canal and its embankments received the name Hugo de Grootgracht on March 30, 1881.
facts.sourceQuote: De gracht en bijbehorende kades werden op 30 maart 1881 vernoemd naar de humanist en rechtsgeleerde Hugo de Groot, al werd ze later nog twee keer geherdefinieerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The canal and associated embankments were named after the humanist and jurist Hugo de Groot on March 30, 1881, although they were later redefined twice.

facts.text: A curved high bridge called Katterug connects Bilderdijkpark across the canal for pedestrians and cyclists.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan diezelfde kant ligt het Bilderdijkpark (op een voormalige begraafplaats van De Liefde) ligt aan de gracht en is met een bolle hoge brug voor voetgangers en fietsen, de Katterug, over de gracht verbonden met de Van Reigersbergenstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the same side is Bilderdijkpark (on a former cemetery of De Liefde) is located on the canal and is connected to Van Reigersbergenstraat across the canal with a curved high bridge for pedestrians and bicycles, the Katterug.

facts.text: While most quays are named Hugo the Great Quay, the first southern part is called Da Costakade.
facts.sourceQuote: De kaden langs de gracht hebben de naam Hugo de Grootkade, behalve het eerste deel aan de zuidkant, dat de Da Costakade heet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The quays along the canal are named Hugo the Great Quay, except for the first part on the south side, which is called the Da Costakade.

facts.text: A block at numbers 12 to 16 was designed by architect D.H.
facts.sourceQuote: Eruit springen: Hugo de Grootkade 12-16, een blokje ontworpen door D.H.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Jump out: Hugo de Grootkade 12-16, a block designed by D.H.

facts.text: Buildings numbered 76 through 86 are listed municipal monuments within a larger complex.
facts.sourceQuote: Hugo de Grootkade 76 tot en met 86 is wel een gemeentelijk monument, maar maakt deel uit van veel groter geheel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hugo de Grootkade 76 to 86 is a municipal monument, but is part of a much larger whole.

features.name: Voorboezem
features.opening: The Voorboezem is an old watercourse along the southern sea wall of the former island of Wieringen, near the Polder Waard-Nieuwland in Hollands Kroon in the…

facts.text: The valley has largely transformed into a reed swamp.
facts.sourceQuote: Tegenwoordig is de boezem voor een groot deel verland tot een rietgebied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nowadays, the valley has largely become a reed swamp.

facts.text: Summer brings many reed warblers while winter attracts blue tits.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer zijn er veel rietvogels en in de winter zijn er blauwe kiekendieven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer there are many reed warblers and in the winter there are blue tits.

features.name: Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal
features.opening: The Amsterdam–Rhine Canal (Dutch: Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal) is a canal in the Netherlands that was built to connect the port and capital city of Amsterdam to the…

facts.text: A young engineer named Anton Mussert drafted the final plan before becoming notorious.
facts.sourceQuote: Seven different plans were produced to replace the Merwede Canal, from 1915 onward, until an eighth and final plan was created by a young (and later notorious) engineer employed by the provincial water board, Anton Mussert.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Seven different plans were produced to replace the Merwede Canal, from 1915 onward, until an eighth and final plan was created by a young (and later notorious) engineer employed by the provincial water board, Anton Mussert.

facts.text: World War II delayed the project until Queen Juliana officially opened it in May 1952.
facts.sourceQuote: The Second World War slowed work on the new canal, with it being officially opened by Queen Juliana on the 21 May 1952.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Second World War slowed work on the new canal, with it being officially opened by Queen Juliana on the 21 May 1952.

facts.text: The canal stretches 72 km, spans over 100 meters wide, and reaches a depth of 6 meters.
facts.sourceQuote: The canal is 72 km in length, over 100 meters wide and 6 meters deep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The canal is 72 km in length, over 100 meters wide and 6 meters deep.

facts.text: In 2016 alone, 91,495 vessels navigated its waters carrying over 77 million tons of cargo.
facts.sourceQuote: 91,495 vessels (including 5,541 recreational vessels) sailed through the canal in 2016, carrying a total of 77,172,454 tons of cargo.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: 91,495 vessels (including 5,541 recreational vessels) sailed through the canal in 2016, carrying a total of 77,172,454 tons of cargo.

features.name: Sluis Haarlemmervaart
features.opening: The Schutsluis Haarlemmervaart stands in the Haarlemmervaart in Amsterdam-West at Van Slingelandtstraat.

facts.text: A single structure separates two water levels at different bed heights: NAP -0.40 and NAP -0.60.
facts.sourceQuote: De sluis vormt sindsdien de scheiding tussen het oostelijke deel van de Haarlemmervaart dat op het stadsboezempeil ligt (NAP -0,40) en het westelijke deel dat op Rijnlands boezempeil ligt (NAP -0,60).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since then, the lock has formed the separation between the eastern part of the Haarlemmervaart that is at the city bed level (NAP -0.40) and the western part that is at the Rhine bed level (NAP -0.60).

features.name: Egelantiersgracht
features.opening: The Egelantiersgracht in Amsterdam is a canal in the Jordaan neighbourhood in the Amsterdam-Centrum borough.

facts.text: Original houses were built on a smaller scale specifically for artisans and skilled tradespeople.
facts.sourceQuote: The houses in this neighborhood were partly built for artisans and skilled tradespeople. The houses are built on a smaller scale than the great mansions on Herengracht, Keizersgracht and Prinsengracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The houses in this neighborhood were partly built for artisans and skilled tradespeople. The houses are built on a smaller scale than the great mansions on Herengracht, Keizersgracht and Prinsengracht.

facts.text: House number sixty-six was demolished during the Hunger Winter and later rebuilt between 1963 and 1964.
facts.sourceQuote: Egelantiersgracht 66, which was demolished in the Hunger Winter, was rebuilt between 1963 and 1964 by the Diogenes Foundation.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Egelantiersgracht 66, which was demolished in the Hunger Winter, was rebuilt between 1963 and 1964 by the Diogenes Foundation.

facts.text: Narrow corridors between houses provided access to illegally built backyards where the less fortunate lived in dilapidated shelters.
facts.sourceQuote: These narrow alleys provided access to the (often illegally) built-in backyards behind the row of houses, where the less fortunate lived in dilapidated shelters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These narrow alleys provided access to the (often illegally) built-in backyards behind the row of houses, where the less fortunate lived in dilapidated shelters.

features.name: Blauwburgwal
features.opening: The Blauwburgwal (literally: Dutch: blue fortress wall) is a canal in Amsterdam between the Singel (at Lijnbaanssteeg) and the Herengracht (at Herenstraat).

facts.text: Before 1612, this waterway was known as Blauwburgwal Lijnbaansgracht.
facts.sourceQuote: Before the city expansion of 1612, the Blauwburgwal was called Blauwburgwal Lijnbaansgracht as an extension of Lijnbaanssteeg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the city expansion of 1612, the Blauwburgwal was called Blauwburgwal Lijnbaansgracht as an extension of Lijnbaanssteeg.

facts.text: Blauwburgwal 22 features a unique raised bell gable with curved walls decorated by fruit and urns.
facts.sourceQuote: It is the only example of a raised bell gable: an extra step with a small claw piece. The gable has curved side walls ornamented with fruit and urns.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is the only example of a raised bell gable: an extra step with a small claw piece. The gable has curved side walls ornamented with fruit and urns.

features.name: Oranjesluizen
features.opening: The Oranje Locks are a group of locks and other water management facilities just east of Amsterdam.

facts.text: By 1971, the locks still required 42 employees to operate manually despite handling 80,000 vessels.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1971 80,000 vessels passed the locks, but they were still operated by hand, requiring 42 employees.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1971 80,000 vessels passed the locks, but they were still operated by hand, requiring 42 employees.

facts.text: The dam's slopes and top were covered with at least one meter of puddle clay for waterproofing.
facts.sourceQuote: The slopes, berm and top of the dam were faced with a layer of at least 1 m of puddle clay.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The slopes, berm and top of the dam were faced with a layer of at least 1 m of puddle clay.

facts.text: By October 1866, construction had already reached the future lock site in Schellingwoude.
facts.sourceQuote: By October 1866 the dam from the Waterland dike till the future location of the locks in the 'pit of Schellingwoude' and a part of south of it was under construction.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By October 1866 the dam from the Waterland dike till the future location of the locks in the 'pit of Schellingwoude' and a part of south of it was under construction.

facts.text: Two sections of the foundational ground pieces later broke, causing significant sinking.
facts.sourceQuote: In two places these grondstukken would later break, causing considerable sinkage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In two places these grondstukken would later break, causing considerable sinkage.

features.name: Korte Prinsengracht
features.opening: The Unicorn Lock (lock no. 103) is a lock in the Haarlemmerdijk between the Prinsengracht and the Korte Prinsengracht in Amsterdam.

facts.text: The name Korte Prinsengracht derives from a nearby brewery called the Unicorn.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam is ontleend aan een nabijgelegen brouwerij die de Eenhoorn heette.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name is derived from a nearby brewery that was called the Unicorn.

facts.text: Until 1872, this stretch of Korte Prinsengracht flowed openly into the Zuiderzee via the IJ.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot de bouw van de Oranjesluizen (in gebruik genomen in 1872) stond dit deel van de Korte Prinsengracht via het IJ in open verbinding met de Zuiderzee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until the construction of the Orange Locks (put into use in 1872), this part of the Korte Prinsengracht was in open connection with the Zuiderzee via the IJ.

facts.text: A second preserved level stone was discovered in 2013 during the demolition of De Nieuwe Brug.
facts.sourceQuote: Jarenlang dacht men dat alleen in deze Eenhoornsluis een Huddesteen bewaard is gebleven, tot in 2013 tijdens de sloop van De Nieuwe Brug over het Damrak een tweede overgebleven exemplaar werd aangetroffen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For years it was thought that only in this Unicorn Lock had a Huddesteen been preserved, until in 2013 during the demolition of De Nieuwe Brug over the Damrak a second remaining specimen was found.

features.name: Lozingskanaal
features.opening: The Lozingskanaal is a straight waterway in Amsterdam, which lies in the eastern extension of the Singelgracht and runs to the Zeeburg Pump Station.

facts.text: A narrow strip of land between the Lozingskanaal and Nieuwe Vaart holds the Zeeburgerpad and canal-side homes.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen deze beide kanalen is een smalle strook land, waarover langs het Lozingskanaal het Zeeburgerpad loopt, met in het kanaal woonarken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between these two channels is a narrow strip of land, over which the Zeeburgerpad runs along the Lozingskanaal, with living quarters in the canal.

facts.text: Water from this canal flows through a siphon lock beneath the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal to reach the Buiten-IJ.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Lozingskanaal eindigt, na/bij een open verbinding met de Nieuwe Vaart, bij het Gemaal Zeeburg, dat water uit het kanaal pompt naar een 'voorboezem', van waaruit het via een syphonsluis (onderleider) onder het Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal door wordt weggevoerd naar het Buiten-IJ.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Lozingskanaal ends, after/near an open connection with the Nieuwe Vaart, at the Zeeburg Pump Station, which pumps water from the canal into a 'pre-basin', from which it is carried through a siphon lock (subleader) under the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal to the Buiten-IJ.

facts.text: The entire length of the Lozingskanaal runs parallel to the longer Nieuwe Vaart channel.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Lozingskanaal loopt over zijn gehele lengte evenwijdig met de (langere) Nieuwe Vaart.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Lozingskanaal runs parallel to the (longer) Nieuwe Vaart throughout its entire length.

facts.text: The canal is crossed by railway bridges serving the Amsterdam-Utrecht line.
facts.sourceQuote: Over het Lozingskanaal voeren verscheidene bruggen: spoorbruggen van de spoorlijn Amsterdam-Utrecht, een voetbrug (Amsterdamse brug 328), brug 1965 (Panamalaan/Panamabrug), brug 261 (Veelaan/Veebrug), Ad Grimmonbrug (nr 1916).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Several bridges cross the Lozingskanaal: railway bridges of the Amsterdam-Utrecht railway line, a pedestrian bridge (Amsterdamse brug 328), bridge 1965 (Panamalaan/Panamabrug), bridge 261 (Veelaan/Veebrug), Ad Grimmonbrug (no. 1916).

facts.text: Bridge 1965, also known as Panamabrug, spans the water at Panamalaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Over het Lozingskanaal voeren verscheidene bruggen: spoorbruggen van de spoorlijn Amsterdam-Utrecht, een voetbrug (Amsterdamse brug 328), brug 1965 (Panamalaan/Panamabrug), brug 261 (Veelaan/Veebrug), Ad Grimmonbrug (nr 1916).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Several bridges cross the Lozingskanaal: railway bridges of the Amsterdam-Utrecht railway line, a pedestrian bridge (Amsterdamse brug 328), bridge 1965 (Panamalaan/Panamabrug), bridge 261 (Veelaan/Veebrug), Ad Grimmonbrug (no. 1916).

features.name: Abcouder Meer
features.opening: Lake in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Amsterdam acquired full ownership of the lake in 1904 after leasing parts since 1631.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1619 kwam de noordelijke helft van het meer in handen van de gemeente Amsterdam en sinds 1631 ook de zuidelijke helft, zij het in erfpacht. Na de opheffing van het kapittel Sint-Pieter zijn diverse particulieren eigendom van het zuidelijk deel van het meer geweest, tot Amsterdam in 1904 ook dit deel wist te verwerven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1619, the northern half of the lake came into the hands of the municipality of Amsterdam and since 1631 also the southern half, albeit on leasehold. After the dissolution of the chapter of St. Peter, several private individuals owned the southern part of the lake, until Amsterdam also managed to acquire this part in 1904.

facts.text: Plans to drain the Abcouder Meer were proposed in the 1940s for work expansion measures.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren veertig van de twintigste eeuw waren er plannen om het meer droog te leggen in het kader van werkverruimende middelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1940s of the twentieth century, there were plans to drain the lake as part of work expansion measures.

facts.text: The lake reaches a maximum depth of just four meters.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Abcoudermeer is maximaal 4 meter diep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Abcoudermeer is a maximum of 4 meters deep.

facts.text: An indoor swimming pool closed in 2016 before Abcoude got a new one next to the station in 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: Het binnenzwembad is in 2016 eveneens gesloten en de bezoekers werden verwezen naar het binnenzwembad in Mijdrecht. Sinds 2021 beschikt Abcoude weer over een eigen zwembad, maar nu vlak naast het station.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The indoor swimming pool was also closed in 2016 and visitors were referred to the indoor swimming pool in Mijdrecht. Since 2021, Abcoude has again had its own swimming pool, but now right next to the station.

facts.text: A rocky shallow zone is separated from deeper water by two rows of underwater gully valleys.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ondiepe gedeelte van het meer met een rotsachtige bodem is afgescheiden door een tweetal rijen dukdalfen, deels onder water, waarna het diepe gedeelte wordt bereikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The shallow part of the lake with a rocky bottom is separated by two rows of gully valleys, partly underwater, after which the deep part is reached.

features.name: Haarlemmertrekvaart
features.opening: The Haarlemmertrekvaart [ˌhaːrlɛmərˈtrɛkfaːrt] (Haarlem's Tow-Canal) is a canal between Amsterdam and Haarlem in the province of North Holland, the Netherlands.

facts.text: A railway built in 1839 rendered passenger transport on the canal obsolete.
facts.sourceQuote: A railway parallel to the canal was built in 1839 which rendered passenger transport on the Haarlemmertrekvaart obsolete.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A railway parallel to the canal was built in 1839 which rendered passenger transport on the Haarlemmertrekvaart obsolete.

facts.text: Barges called trekschuit were pulled by animals or people along a path beside the water.
facts.sourceQuote: Travel on such canals was historically done by barges (or trekschuit in Dutch) which were towed by animals (and sometimes by man-power) on a path along the canal's edge (towpath).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Travel on such canals was historically done by barges (or trekschuit in Dutch) which were towed by animals (and sometimes by man-power) on a path along the canal's edge (towpath).

features.name: Nieuwe Herengracht
features.opening: The Nieuwe Herengracht (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌniu.ə ˈɦeːrə(ŋ)ˌɣrɑxt]) is a canal in Centrum district of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Original stone arch bridges were swapped for movable ones to accommodate the growing shipping industry.
facts.sourceQuote: The stone arch bridges were replaced by movable bridges for the shipping industry.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stone arch bridges were replaced by movable bridges for the shipping industry.

facts.text: A cycle tunnel on the south bank dives beneath Weesperstraat to connect the Amstel with the Plantage area.
facts.sourceQuote: On the south bank, a cycle tunnel dives under the busy two-lane road of Weesperstraat, to connect the Amstel with the Plantage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the south bank, a cycle tunnel dives under the busy two-lane road of Weesperstraat, to connect the Amstel with the Plantage.

features.name: Osdorpergracht
features.opening: The Osdorpergracht is a short canal in the Osdorp district in the city of Amsterdam.

facts.text: Four bridges cross the canal, including footbridges and street crossings like bridge 753.
facts.sourceQuote: Er liggen vier bruggen over de Osdorpergracht: Voetbrug Osdorpergracht, brug 753 (straat Meer en Vaart), brug 764 (voetbrug tussen Osdorpplein en Groenpad) en brug 755 (Hoekenes).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are four bridges over the Osdorpergracht: Osdorpergracht footbridge, bridge 753 (Meer and Vaart street), bridge 764 (footbridge between Osdorpplein and Groenpad) and bridge 755 (Hoekenes).

facts.text: A planned bridge for a never-built elevated route was intended to span Osdorpplein next to the water.
facts.sourceQuote: Een geplande maar nooit gebouwde brug in het niet gerealiseerde hooggelegen tracé van het Geer Ban zou tussen brug 753 en 764 hebben moeten gelegen en naast de Osdorpergracht ook het Osdorpplein overspannen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A planned but never built bridge in the unrealized elevated route of the Geer Ban should have been located between bridge 753 and 764 and also spanned the Osdorpplein next to the Osdorpergracht.

features.name: Afwateringstocht
features.opening: A main watercourse is an important watercourse that serves for the discharge of water of more than local importance.

facts.text: Water boards maintain these channels by regularly dredging and cutting grass to keep dimensions.
